Title: Permit Specialist - 100% Remote work

Location: 100% Work from home in the Luzon region, Cebu City, Davao City and Iloilo City, Philippines

Shift: Flexible late shift - Core working hours from 8:30 PM - 1:30 AM PHT (remaining hours can be completed before or after that)

About The Role

TaxValet is looking for a permit specialist to help our clients eliminate the hassle and risk of sales tax. You’ll be using your project management and attention to detail skills to assist clients with getting set-up within state tax systems quickly. The result being that TaxValet’s filing team is able to pay each clients’ taxes accurately and on time. This will be a highly collaborative role and will involve working with clients, internal teammates, state agencies, and more.

The permit specialist will primarily be responsible for opening new sales tax accounts, closing existing sales tax accounts, preparing and sending Power of Attorney forms, and troubleshooting permit issues as they pop up. This role will be communicating with US State government agencies and US clients so really high proficiency and comfort with written and verbal English is a must!

In time, you’ll be considered an expert on state sales tax permits and someone that many will turn to when looking for advice.

Don’t worry, we’ll provide lots of training and help along the way. Your attitude and potential is much more important than your current knowledge and experience. We don’t expect anyone to come in with previous US sales tax experience.

Your Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who is ready to learn and grow professionally, and wants a career (not just a job). We can train you on a lot of things, but here are our non-negotiables:

Professional

  • Excellent English proficiency.
  • Experience with project management and / or contract application
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business courses.
  • Comfortable initiating phone calls, pressing for necessary information and following-up persistently to achieve needed result.
  • Capable of troubleshooting issues and finding solutions as they arise
  • Comfortable in using different softwares to track projects and client information
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, and keeps track of project deadlines efficiently
  • Accounting or finance background would be helpful as well, but again, not required.
  • Positive references from past supervisors.

Interpersonal

  • You have high attention-to-detail.
  • You are a self-starter and show initiative to get work done even without constant supervision.
  • Excellent at time management skills. You don’t waste time on frivolous activities.
  • Eager to learn new skills and technologies.

Please note that the final step before being hired is for you to arrange reference calls with your former managers and others.

Your Primary Responsibilities

  • Permit Process. The permit specialist is responsible for managing the new permit process and existing permit verification process. This includes reviewing client information submitted to TaxValet, applying for the sales tax permits and creating access to the Permit account to verify any information needed so the account can then be turned over to the Sales Tax Accountant for filing purposes.The permit specialist communicates between the client and the state to ensure accurate permit information.
  • Submit Power of Attorney Forms. The permit specialist sends, and submits the Power of Attorney forms for clients to give TaxValet the ability to communicate with Permits on behalf of the client.
  • Permit Closures. The permit specialist will work with the New Client Onboarding Specialist, Client Tax Specialist and Sales Tax Accountant in respect to closing out sales tax permits for new clients who are determined to no longer need a particular permit upon completing the initial nexus review.
  • Support Clients. The permit specialist communicates and provides ongoing support to new and existing clients during the permit process.
  • Support Sales Tax Accountants. The permit specialist communicates all helpful permit or account verification information to the assigned Sales Tax Accountant in order for them to effectively take on the client's ongoing filing process and any special projects.

Specific Measures of Success

No surprises here! After a year on the job, you’ll be measured by these specific outcomes:

  • Permit Process/Verification Time. The goal is to complete the permit/verification process within 39 days for 90% of clients.
  • Permit Application Turnaround Time. The permit specialist will have all sales tax permits applications submitted within less than 48 hours of notification from the Onboarding Team.
  • Permit Capacity. The permit specialist should be able to handle at least 80 permits/verifications per month along with other duties.
  • Education Hours. The permit specialist will complete 3 hours per quarter in work related education or training.
  • Quarterly Rocks (Goals). All rocks have at least an 80% completion rate for the year.

Compensation and Benefits

We believe working side-by-side with an awesome team is the greatest benefit there is, but there are other reasons why we love working at TaxValet including:

  • Monthly flat salary - 66,496 PHP
  • 43 days off per year. This includes 22 holidays per year, plus 21 days of PTO per year. Yes, seriously.
  • 3 additional days off per year to volunteer and serve your community
  • 100% Remote work with flexible working hours
  • The ability to participate in the company profit sharing program the year after your hire date (pending passing a financial literacy quiz.)

Some intangible benefits include:

  • Don't just take our word for it—see what our employees have to say:
    • We’re proud to have made the top 10 list for Best Remote Workplaces in America by Best Companies Group in 2023, 2025 & 2026
    • TaxValet has made the Inc 5000 list in 2023, 2024, and 2025
    • For the past 5 years, we've proudly maintained an impressive eNPS score of over 90!
    • Our team has consistently awarded us a 4.9-star rating on Glassdoor!
    • Come join us and find out why!
  • We encourage ongoing training, and learning and development, through munch and learns, coaching, the chance to work on diverse projects, our continuous education reimbursement program, and more!
  • We believe in and support growth opportunities. We take pride in promoting from within, and we encourage cross-department moves to explore new areas of the business and broaden your skill set.
  • We are proud to have a diverse team of employees where everyone’s voice matters. And we mean that! We have regular processes in place for everyone to share their feedback, thoughts and ideas.

Are You Our Next Teammate?

We’d love to be in touch. Please apply online with a resume and cover letter. Each application will be reviewed with intention and care. So, the more effort you put in up-front, the higher likelihood we’ll reach out. If there’s a mutual interest, we’ll reach out to you to collect additional information. Thanks, and we’re really looking forward to meeting you.

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We're actively taking steps to make sure our culture is inclusive and that our processes and practices promote equity for all, including people of color, people from working-class backgrounds, women, and members of the LGBTQ+ community. We welcome and encourage applications from people with these identities or members of other historically marginalized groups.

Research shows that women and people of color tend not to apply to jobs unless they believe they are 100% qualified and apply to fewer senior-level positions. With that in mind, we encourage you to apply if you're not sure whether you meet our qualifications. We'd love to have the opportunity to consider you.

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for an E-Commerce Copywriter who understands that great product copy is about more than describing what a product does.
jobs.description:
We're looking for an E-Commerce Copywriter who understands that great product copy is about more than describing what a product does. You understand the relationship between products, customers, messaging, SEO, and conversion—and you know how to turn product features into compelling reasons to buy.

The Role

As our E-Commerce Copywriter, you'll help shape how Zulay Kitchen's products are presented across our e-commerce channels. You'll write and optimize product listings, develop messaging for new products, research customers and competitors, and continuously look for ways to make our copy more compelling and conversion-focused.

We're looking for someone who is a strong writer, customer-focused, creative, curious, and obsessed with figuring out what makes people click—and buy.

What You'll Do

E-Commerce Copywriting

  • Write and optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, and other e-commerce content.
  • Create compelling product copy that clearly communicates what the product does, why it matters, and why customers should choose it.
  • Turn product features into customer-focused benefits and persuasive messaging.
  • Develop copy for Amazon listings, Shopify product pages, A+ Content, social media, email campaigns, product packaging, and other customer-facing marketing materials.
  • Write messaging for new product launches, promotions, and other marketing initiatives.
  • Maintain a consistent and recognizable Zulay Kitchen brand voice across product content.

Conversion & Product Messaging

  • Review existing product listings and identify opportunities to improve clarity, engagement, and conversion.
  • Analyze customer reviews, questions, feedback, and competitor listings to understand what customers care about.
  • Identify customer pain points, objections, motivations, and purchasing triggers.
  • Develop messaging that addresses customer concerns and makes the value of our products immediately clear.
  • Help identify the strongest selling points and differentiators for each product.
  • Continuously test and refine messaging based on performance and customer response.

SEO & Marketplace Optimization

  • Conduct keyword research and incorporate relevant search terms naturally into product copy.
  • Optimize listings for search visibility without sacrificing readability or persuasive messaging.
  • Stay current on Amazon and e-commerce SEO best practices.
  • Research competitors and identify opportunities to differentiate Zulay Kitchen products.
  • Keep up with changes in marketplace algorithms, customer behavior, and e-commerce trends.

Research & Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing to develop and execute product messaging and content strategies.
  • Collaborate with Category Managers, Amazon Sales Specialists, Designers, and other team members to understand products and their target customers.
  • Conduct product and market research before developing copy.
  • Partner with the creative team to make sure copy and visuals work together to tell a strong product story.
  • Take feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously improve your work.

You'd Be a Great Fit If...

You don't just look at a product and ask "What does it do?"

You ask:

"Why would someone want this?"

"What problem is this solving?"

"What would make a customer choose this over the competition?"
"What might stop someone from buying?"
"How can we communicate the value in a way that makes people want to click 'Add to Cart'?"

You're able to take a product with a list of features and turn it into copy that makes the customer understand why they need it.

You're equally comfortable researching competitors and customer reviews, analyzing an existing product listing, and sitting down to write a strong headline or product description.

You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be improved. You're constantly looking for opportunities to make our listings clearer, more compelling, and more likely to convert.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional copywriting experience, preferably in e-commerce, DTC, retail, or consumer products.
  • Proven experience writing product listings or conversion-focused copy.
  • Excellent written English, grammar, and editing skills.
  • Strong understanding of customer psychology and persuasive writing.
  • Experience with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces is highly preferred.
  • Understanding of e-commerce SEO and keyword optimization.
  • Strong research skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple products and deadlines independently.
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating on copy.
  • A strong instinct for what makes copy clear, engaging, and convincing.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Amazon A+ Content / Enhanced Brand Content.
  • Familiarity with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar tools.
  • Shopify experience.
  • Experience working with physical consumer products, particularly kitchen, home, or lifestyle brands.
  • Experience collaborating with designers, photographers, or creative teams.
  • Experience using AI tools to support research and content workflows while maintaining originality and brand voice.

This is a cold calling role, not a warm inbound role. There are no hand-raisers, no inbound leads to work, and no email sequences to hide behind. You will be dialing cold prospects all day, handling objections, and booking meetings through sheer volume and skill. If you are comfortable on the phone, resilient under rejection, and motivated by a clear and measurable output, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Pre-built prospect lists and call software provided so you can focus entirely on calling
  • Clear, measurable performance metrics with a direct line between your activity and your results

What You'll Work On

High-Volume Outbound Cold Calling

  • Make high-volume outbound cold calls to B2B prospects from pre-built lists every day
  • Open cold conversations professionally and pivot quickly to qualify interest and book a meeting
  • Handle objections confidently and keep conversations moving toward a booked outcome
  • Maintain a consistent, high call volume throughout the full working day without losing energy or quality

Meeting Booking and Pipeline Management

  • Book qualified meetings for the sales team as the primary output metric for this role
  • Log all call activity, outcomes, and follow-up notes accurately in the CRM after every call
  • Keep prospect records clean and current so the sales team has full context going into every meeting

Process and Performance

  • Follow the calling script and objection handling frameworks provided while adapting naturally to each conversation
  • Meet daily and weekly call volume and meeting booking targets consistently
  • Flag patterns in objections, prospect quality, or list performance to help improve the outbound process over time

What You Bring

  • Prior outbound cold calling experience with a track record of booking meetings from cold conversations
  • Confident, natural, and resilient phone presence with the ability to stay sharp across a high volume of calls
  • Fluent, clear, and professional spoken English — this is a phone-only role and your voice is everything
  • Comfortable with rejection and able to reset quickly between calls without losing momentum
  • Organized with clean CRM habits and accurate call logging
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet, professional calling environment
  • Available to work full-time during US business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience cold calling for a B2B SaaS, data, or technology company
  • Familiarity with sales engagement or power dialer platforms
  • Background in a high-volume outbound sales environment with daily call targets

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your cold calling experience, and giving an example of how you handle a prospect who immediately says they are not interested

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a 2-day paid trial before a full offer is extended.

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are comfortable on the phone, thrive on high activity, and want a role where your results are directly tied to how many dials you make and how well you handle objections, this role gives you the volume and the clear metrics to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.excerpt: Twin Health At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care.
jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

As a Principal Product Designer, you'll own the end-to-end experience strategy for our mobile app — the primary touchpoint where members manage their health every day. But more than that, you'll be doing something very few designers get to do: inventing the interaction language for agentic AI in healthcare from scratch.

There is no established playbook here. Agentic experiences — where AI acts autonomously on a user's behalf, surfaces proactive guidance, and adapts in real time to behavior and health data — are among the least explored frontiers in product design today. You'll be the person who figures out what these patterns look, feel, and behave like for people managing chronic conditions. That requires genuine originality, comfort with ambiguity, and the creative confidence to propose something that has never existed before.

This is the highest craft and leadership bar we hire to. You'll be a recognized thought leader internally — setting the quality standard others aspire to, shaping product roadmaps beyond your immediate scope, and leaving a design legacy that outlasts any single feature.

This isn't iteration work. It's an invention.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

  • Identify and drive mission-critical design initiatives with significant scope and long-term timelines — projects that directly shape the trajectory of the business, not just the product.
  • Pioneer agentic UX from 0 to 1 — design entirely new interaction patterns for AI systems that act proactively, make recommendations, and operate with increasing autonomy on behalf of users. You'll be defining conventions that don't yet exist, not referencing ones that do.
  • Assist stakeholders across teams in shaping their product roadmaps, bringing a design-led perspective to decisions that extend well beyond your own areas of ownership.
  • Lead design strategy across interconnected member journeys — from onboarding through long-term behavior change — defining what "great" looks like, aligning cross-functional partners around it, and seeing it through to shipped product.

Innovation & Problem Solving

  • Invent in uncharted territory — bring a high degree of creative originality to problems with no obvious solution. Concept, prototype, and validate novel design patterns that balance AI agency with user trust, transparency, and control.
  • Lead high-complexity initiatives end to end while also serving as a design consultant across smaller-scale efforts, applying your breadth of experience to raise quality across the board.
  • Drive innovation workshops and ideation exercises that push teams past familiar solutions and toward genuinely new design territory.

Craft & Execution

  • Set the quality bar for design at Twin. Your work is the standard others reference — in interaction design, visual design, copy direction, and systems thinking.
  • Translate clinical complexity and AI-generated insights into experiences that feel intuitive and motivating, designing for real health outcomes.
  • Own the full craft end to end: information architecture, interaction design, visual design, copy direction, and user validation — from early concepts to pixel-perfect specs.
  • Proactively identify visual, accessibility, and interaction issues across products and influence their prioritization and resolution.
  • Be a steward and builder of Twin's design system — identifying gaps, leading improvements, and establishing new agentic design patterns as reusable components the broader team can build on.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Operate as a mentor and guide for designers and cross-functional partners — helping them advocate for best practices and elevating the craft and standards of the entire team.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders and executive leaders, negotiating and persuading with clarity, humility, and well-crafted rationale.
  • Define and run research that uncovers unmet needs and validates direction, turning qualitative insights into clear, actionable design decisions.
  • Communicate and storytell with expert fluency — you can defend a novel design concept in front of clinicians, engineers, and executives with equal confidence.

Impact

  • Make contributions that exceed the expected boundaries of a product design role — positively influencing business health, product direction, and the design culture at Twin.
  • Evolve how design functions at Twin, continuously recalibrating the team's approach based on business needs, industry shifts, and the frontier of AI-powered product design.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product/UX design experience, with a portfolio that demonstrates the highest level of craft across interaction design, visual design, and systems thinking.
  • Demonstrated experience designing agentic AI experiences — products where AI takes action, surfaces proactive interventions, or operates with agency rather than simply responding to user input.
  • Proven ability to design 0-to-1 — you've created original interaction patterns in spaces with no prior art and can articulate the thinking and process behind how you got there.
  • Highly inventive and creatively courageous — you don't default to what's familiar. You push into genuinely new territory and have a track record of work that others in the industry reference.
  • Recognized thought leader in design — internally and externally — whose perspective carries weight beyond your immediate team.
  • Expert communication and storytelling skills — able to negotiate with and persuade leaders at all levels while consistently acting with humility and without ego.
  • High degree of independence and ingenuity when solving critical design challenges, with a track record of identifying and executing on new opportunities without waiting to be directed.
  • Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or a related field — or equivalent experience.
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with LLM prompting as part of a design or prototyping workflow — you've used AI as a creative tool, not just designed around it.
  • Experience establishing design patterns for AI transparency, explainability, or human-in-the-loop interactions.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $220,000 - $240,000 annually.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

  • A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies
  • A remote and accomplished global team
  • Opportunity for equity participation
  • Unlimited vacation with manager approval
  • 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents
  • 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
  • 401k retirement savings plan

Role Overview

The AI Lead is responsible for identifying, building, validating, and scaling AI-powered product solutions that drive real customer and business outcomes.

This role is hands-on and AI-first. An AI Lead does not operate through documents, tickets, or handoffs. They build working solutions using AI, engage directly with customers, and iterate rapidly based on real-world feedback.

The AI Lead does everything an AI Product Engineer does - plus owns customer discovery, validation, prioritization, and measurable impact.

About Us

Dockmaster is a leading provider of innovative marina software solutions, dedicated to equipping our customers with the tools that streamline operations, improve operational efficiency while driving revenue growth. Our largest customer concentration is in North America but are quickly expanding to have a global presence.

Core Responsibilities

AI-First Product Building

  • Build working product solutions using AI as the primary execution medium
  • Rapidly prototype, iterate, and refine solutions to validate ideas early
  • Use AI agents for requirements analysis, design exploration, implementation, and testing
  • Move from problem understanding to working solution without reliance on legacy SDLC rituals

Customer Discovery & Engagement

  • Engage directly with customers to understand workflows, pain points, and unmet needs
  • Use live demos and working prototypes to drive customer conversations
  • Validate solutions through real usage, not assumptions or opinions
  • Build trust by clearly explaining AI behaviour, limitations, and tradeoffs

Problem Framing & Opportunity Identification

  • Frame problems clearly and precisely before execution
  • Identify new AI-powered solution opportunities and revenue potential
  • Evaluate ideas based on impact, feasibility, and learning velocity
  • Use experimentation to discard weak ideas quickly

Outcome Ownership

  • Define success in terms of adoption, retention, efficiency, and revenue impact
  • Prioritize initiatives based on outcomes, not feature volume
  • Continuously assess whether solutions are creating real value
  • Own the full lifecycle from idea to impact

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Work closely with AI Product Engineers and AI Developers within AI Pods
  • Align engineering, design, and data efforts around outcomes
  • Communicate clearly with internal stakeholders
  • Represent the product externally with credibility and clarity

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a backlog or roadmap-only role
  • Not a handoff-based product manager
  • Not a requirements writer detached from execution

Required Skills & Experience

Core Capabilities

  • Strong ability to build working software using AI tools
  • Proven experience rapidly prototyping and iterating on product ideas
  • Deep understanding of probabilistic AI systems and guardrails
  • Ability to reason about systems end-to-end

Product & Business Acumen

  • Experience engaging directly with customers
  • Ability to identify business and revenue opportunities
  • Strong product judgment and taste
  • Comfort prioritizing under uncertainty

Communication & Leadership

  • Ability to explain complex AI behavior clearly and honestly
  • Strong storytelling grounded in real system behavior
  • Comfortable leading through influence rather than authority

Why Join Dockmaster?

At Dockmaster, you’ll have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our growth while working alongside a passionate team dedicated to transforming the marina management industry. This is a key leadership role, reporting directly to the CEO, with ample opportunity for professional growth, strategic influence, and direct impact on the company's success.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and bonus structure based on performance.
  • Health insurance, 401(k) with company match, and paid time off.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★
QuickBooks Financial Controller
Location: Remote — Canada, Central America, South America, or Europe
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
Industry: Interior Design / Professional Services
Compensation:$2,000 – $4,000 USD/month
English Proficiency:C1/C2 English Required
Schedule: Full-Time | Required overlap with U.S. business hours
Reports To: CFO


About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based luxury interior design firm specializing in bespoke, high-end environments that combine exceptional design, craftsmanship, functionality, and personalized client service.
The company is strengthening its internal finance operations and is looking for an experienced accounting professional who can bring the same level of precision and attention to detail to its financial function.
About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished QuickBooks Financial Controller with deep, hands-on QuickBooks expertise to take ownership of the company's accounting operations.
Reporting directly to the CFO, you will have full responsibility for the General Ledger, lead the transition from an outside accounting firm to a fully in-house accounting function, manage monthly close and reconciliations, prepare financial reporting, and oversee the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable team.
QuickBooks expertise is essential for this position. This role requires more than day-to-day usage. You must be comfortable configuring and optimizing QuickBooks and have experience with QuickBooks implementations.
This is a hands-on position for someone who is highly accurate, independent, comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment, and willing to support operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting when needed.
Why This Opportunity?
  • Take full ownership of the company's accounting operations and General Ledger.
  • Become the internal QuickBooks expert for the organization.
  • Work directly with the CFO and play a key role in strengthening the finance function.
  • Lead the transition from outsourced accounting to a fully in-house operation.
  • Manage and improve accounting processes, controls, and reporting.
  • Work remotely with significant autonomy and responsibility.
What You'll Do
QuickBooks & General Ledger
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks to support the company's accounting structure and reporting requirements.
  • Lead or support QuickBooks configuration and implementation initiatives.
  • Lead the transition of the General Ledger from an outside accounting firm to an in-house function.
  • Maintain, reconcile, and close the books monthly.
  • Establish and maintain the Chart of Accounts and appropriate classification standards.
Financial Reporting & Cash Management
  • Prepare accurate financial statements across the company's business divisions.
  • Prepare and review Profit & Loss (P&L) statements.
  • Oversee bank reconciliations.
  • Monitor the company's cash position.
  • Maintain accurate and reliable financial information for CFO review.
Team Leadership & Client Support
  • Supervise Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable specialists.
  • Review and approve invoices, hours reports, and client statements before distribution.
  • Review and approve payroll, vendor payments, and expense submissions.
  • Interface with clients regarding accounting-related requests when required.
  • Ensure accounting work completed by the team meets established standards.
  • Support operational and non-accounting matters that may arise within a small-team environment.
Tax & Accounting Controls
  • Coordinate payroll tax, sales tax, and 1099-related matters.
  • Execute accounting policies established by the CFO accurately and consistently.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a high standard of accuracy.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Prior experience as a Financial Controller, Senior Accountant, or similar senior accounting professional with full ownership of the General Ledger.
  • Advanced, hands-on QuickBooks expertise.
  • Professional experience with QuickBooks Online and/or QuickBooks Desktop.
  • Experience configuring QuickBooks and/or leading a QuickBooks implementation.
  • Strong experience managing the General Ledger, reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Experience preparing financial statements and P&L reports.
  • Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts structures and accounting classifications.
  • Experience overseeing or working closely with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistently low error rates.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to execute accounting policies and procedures with precision.
  • Comfortable supporting operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting.
  • C1/C2 English proficiency, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to work with required overlap during U.S. business hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience transitioning an accounting function from an external accounting firm to an in-house team.
  • Experience with BigTime or similar project accounting software.
  • Previous experience in professional services, interior design, architecture, construction, or project-based businesses.
  • Experience supervising accounting or bookkeeping professionals.
How Success Is Measured
Success in this position will be measured by your ability to:
  • Maintain an accurate and reliable General Ledger.
  • Independently execute reconciliations and month-end close.
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks according to business requirements.
  • Successfully support the transition to an in-house accounting function.
  • Deliver accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a consistently low error rate.
  • Effectively oversee AP and AR activities.
  • Work independently while executing CFO policies accurately.
  • Communicate professionally with U.S.-based colleagues and clients.
Video Presentation Required
As part of your application, please submit a short video in English introducing yourself and briefly summarizing your accounting background, followed by a 30-second to 1-minute overview of your QuickBooks experience, including how many years you have used it professionally, whether you have worked with QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop, your main responsibilities in the system, and any experience configuring QuickBooks or leading an implementation.
Why Join Us?
  • $2,000 – $4,000 USD/month, based on experience and location.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Direct exposure to the CFO and company leadership.
  • Significant ownership of the accounting function.
  • Opportunity to lead an important financial operations transition.
  • Long-term, full-time contractor opportunity.
  • Short initial trial period to ensure mutual fit.
Important Notes
Advanced QuickBooks expertise is a core requirement for this position. Basic familiarity, occasional use, or self-taught exposure without substantial professional experience will not be sufficient.
Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain their years of QuickBooks experience, versions used, responsibilities within the system, experience running monthly close, and any QuickBooks configuration or implementation experience.
C1/C2 English is mandatory. The role operates entirely in English with a U.S.-based team and, at times, directly with clients.
This is a permanent, full-time contractor opportunity with a short initial trial period.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

As a Senior Data Scientist at Kard, you will build and deploy machine learning and experimentation systems that power our card-linked offers platform. Your work will directly improve how users discover and engage with offers, and how partners measure ROI. You’ll operate across personalization, ranking, and causal measurement - partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Sales to turn behavioral transaction data into production-grade models and insights.

Responsibilities

  • Build and ship ML models that drive offer personalization, ranking, and targeting using transaction, merchant, and user behavioral data.
  • Develop features and training pipelines on top of large-scale event and transaction datasets (e.g., spend patterns, visit frequency, merchant affinity).
  • Design and analyze A/B tests and incrementality experiments to measure campaign and model impact.
  • Apply causal inference methods (e.g., matching, uplift modeling, diff-in-diff) to quantify partner ROI and user behavior changes.
  • Partner with ML and Data Engineers to productionize models, including feature stores, batch/real-time scoring, and monitoring.
  • Improve and iterate on ranking/recommendation systems to optimize engagement, conversion, and retention.
  • Contribute to attribution and measurement systems that help brands understand incremental value from Kard campaigns.
  • Translate complex modeling outputs into clear, actionable insights for internal teams and external partners.
  • Own projects end-to-end: problem framing, data exploration, modeling, deployment, and post-launch evaluation.
  • Help define best practices for experimentation, model evaluation, and data quality across the team.

Desired Skills

  • 6+ years of experience in data science, with meaningful experience in applied machine learning in production.
  • Strong experience with recommendation systems, ranking models, or personalization (e.g., propensity models, collaborative filtering, embeddings).
  • Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation, including A/B testing and incrementality measurement.
  • Experience with causal inference approaches for real-world observational data.
  • Proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch/XGBoost) and SQL; experience working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience working with event-driven or transaction-level data (fintech, ads, marketplaces, or similar domains preferred).
  • Familiarity with modern data/ML stacks (e.g., Spark, Airflow, dbt, feature stores, cloud platforms like AWS/GCP).
  • Experience collaborating with engineers to deploy models into production systems (APIs, batch jobs, real-time scoring).

About Us
Original Composites and Fibers is a global leader in glass reinforcement solutions for the composites industry. About the Role
We are seeking an SAP Basis Team Leader to lead the technical administration, operations, security, integration, and lifecycle management of our SAP landscape, including SAP S/4HANA Cloud, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Cloud Identity Services, SAP Commerce Cloud, SAP Cloud ALM, and related SAP business applications. This role will ensure SAP environments are secure, stable, scalable, integrated, and ready to support global business operations.

This position will lead the SAP Basis function and serve as a key technical partner to ERP, infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, application, and business teams. The role will coordinate with SAP, implementation partners, managed service providers, and internal IT teams to manage environments, transports, monitoring, releases, integrations, identity services, technical cutover, and operational readiness.

Original Composites & Fiberglass is a business unit of the Praana Group. Original Composites & Fiberglass was recently acquired by the Praana Group. The path ahead will be dynamic, full of change, and expected to be fast paced. The business operates from twenty (20+) locations across the globe. The information technology environment supporting our new company is being built from the ground up in terms of IT infrastructure and applications with the opportunity to leverage new technologies and new ways of thinking as we look to end a transition services agreement associated with the acquisition as soon as possible. Our Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) landscape is comprised of multiple instances across the globe. We seek to consolidate and simplify our ERP landscape to drive efficiency and effectiveness in our operations for decades ahead.

All IT team members may be assigned IT Engineering responsibilities, focused on designing, building, and maintaining technology systems that support business operations. These assignments ensure secure connectivity, scalable platforms, and reliable data flow to enable efficient production, supply chain management, and enterprise-wide digital transformation, especially during the separation from Owens Corning. Roles may be temporary or ongoing and can include direct ownership of IT service delivery for one or more manufacturing plants.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the SAP Basis team, contract and internal resources, responsible for technical operations, platform governance, and support across the SAP landscape
  • Oversee administration and support of SAP S/4HANA Cloud, SAP BTP, SAP Cloud Identity Services, SAP Commerce Cloud, SAP Cloud ALM, SAP Signavio, SAP GRC, and related SAP solutions
  • Ensure availability, reliability, performance, and security of SAP development, test, quality, training, pre-production, and production environments
  • Coordinate SAP cloud tenant provisioning, system refreshes, maintenance events, release schedules, patching, and upgrade readiness activities with SAP and service providers
  • Define and govern SAP transport, release, and change management processes, including transport sequencing, deployment controls, cutover planning, and production release support
  • Lead SAP identity and access technical enablement, including SSO, SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS/IPS), Microsoft Entra ID integration, technical users, certificates, and authentication policies
  • Partner with SAP Security, IAM, cybersecurity, and application teams to support secure role deployment, privileged access, audit readiness, and access governance requirements
  • Oversee SAP integration administration, including connectivity, API enablement, middleware coordination, certificates, RFC/OData/REST/SOAP/IDoc interfaces, and issue resolution across SAP and non-SAP systems
  • Lead monitoring and operational readiness capabilities using SAP Cloud ALM and related tools, including job monitoring, interface monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis
  • Support SAP Commerce Cloud technical operations, including environment management, deployments, configuration coordination, monitoring, integration support, and release readiness
  • Provide technical leadership for SAP implementation and transformation activities across SAP Activate phases, including environment readiness, testing support, data migration support, cutover execution, and hypercare
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, network, security, application, and business teams to design and operate secure, scalable, and reliable SAP platform services
  • Manage Basis work assigned to internal resources, implementation partners, and managed service providers, including priorities, deliverables, service levels, and issue escalation
  • Develop and maintain SAP technical standards, operational procedures, runbooks, support models, and knowledge transfer documentation
  • IT Engineering (As Assigned)
  • Own IT service delivery for assigned manufacturing sites, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring operational excellence
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver IT services aligned with business needs during organizational transitions, including separation activities
  • Participate in the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and reliable technology solutions that support core business operations and digital transformation
  • Ensure manufacturing connectivity and data flow across enterprise systems, enabling efficient production and supply chain processes
Qualifications & Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 8+ years of SAP Basis, SAP technical administration, or SAP platform operations experience in enterprise environments
  • 3+ years of team leadership, workstream leadership, or technical lead experience
  • Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA, preferably SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition or RISE with SAP
  • Experience with SAP system landscapes, client/tenant management, transport management, release coordination, and production support processes
  • Experience with SAP cloud solutions such as SAP BTP, SAP Cloud ALM, SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS/IPS), SAP Signavio, SAP GRC, SAP Business AI, and SAP Commerce Cloud is preferred
  • Experience integrating SAP environments with Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, identity provisioning, and enterprise IAM platforms
  • Strong understanding of SAP security concepts, technical users, authorization dependencies, certificates, connectivity, and segregation of duties considerations
  • Experience supporting SAP integrations through middleware, APIs, RFC, OData, REST, SOAP, IDocs, and related connectivity patterns
  • Experience with SAP monitoring, job scheduling, interface monitoring, incident management, root-cause analysis, and performance troubleshooting
  • Experience with cloud operations, managed services, vendor governance, and coordination with SAP support organizations
  • Experience supporting large-scale ERP transformation, carve-out, acquisition, or TSA exit programs is preferred
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to operate independently in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders and guide cross-functional teams, including business leaders, IT teams, implementation partners, and vendors
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical issues, risks, and decisions into business-aligned outcomes
Work Conditions

jobs.description:
Founded in 1954, North American Properties (NAP) is a privately held, multi-regional real estate operating company with a long history of acquiring, developing, and managing retail, multifamily, mixed-use, and office properties across the United States. NAP Development LLC is a venture office of NAP focused on providing Commercial Real Estate Owner’s Representative services. The team operates in a fully remote environment.
The Office and Project Administrator serves as the operational backbone of NAP Development LLC. This is first and foremost a broad administrative role, with approximately 75% of the position focused on keeping the day-to-day operations of the office organized, responsive, and running smoothly. Responsibilities include managing correspondence and records, coordinating with vendors and consultants, preparing and routing contracts and other documents, providing notary services, and supporting scheduling and documentation needs across a distributed team.
The remaining 25% of the role provides project administration support, working closely with Project Managers and Partners to help maintain budget tracking, coordinate invoicing, and keep pay application and related project workflows moving accurately and on schedule.
This role is well suited for someone who enjoys taking ownership of the systems and details that keep a small, fast-moving organization operating effectively. The ideal candidate is highly organized, resourceful, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and naturally becomes the person others rely on when they need to find something, coordinate something, send something, or get something signed.

Contributions you will make to our team

General Office Administration
Correspondence and Communications
· Retrieve, sort, digitize, and route all mail received through the office PO Box, ensuring time-sensitive items are directed to the appropriate team member promptly.
· Coordinate internal and external meetings across calendars, time zones, and project locations.
· Arrange business travel and prepare or process expense reports as needed.
· Assist with bank reconciliation and account documentation under management oversight.
Notary Services· Provide notary services for company documents, contracts, closing packages, lien-related documents, and other business needs.
· Provide mobile/remote online notarization when signers are offsite, with associated costs covered by the Company.
· Maintain required notary records and journals and ensure the notary commission remains current and in good standing.
Records and Document Management
· Own and maintain the Company’s digital filing structure, including naming conventions, folder hierarchy, version control, and access permissions.
· Maintain organized and complete project files, including contracts, change orders, certificates of insurance, permits, correspondence, and closeout documentation.
· Track document expiration dates, including COIs, licenses, W-9s, and permits, and proactively coordinate renewals.
· Implement and maintain appropriate records retention practices across entities and projects.
Vendor and Consultant Coordination
· Collect and verify vendor and consultant onboarding documentation, including W-9s, certificates of insurance, licenses, and other required compliance materials.
· Coordinate new vendor setup with the accounting team.
· Maintain an accurate and current vendor and consultant directory.
· Serve as an administrative point of contact for vendors and consultants as needed.
General Office Operations
· Manage software subscriptions, licenses, and user access for the team.
· Coordinate office, technology, and field supply needs.
· Support administrative and logistical aspects of onboarding new team members.
· Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, systems, templates, and workflows.
Project Administration Support
Contracts and Subcontracts
· Prepare draft contracts, subcontracts, and related documents using approved Company templates.
· Coordinate agreements through review, signature, and execution and track status through completion.
· Maintain the executed contract repository and monitor renewal, expiration, and other key dates.
· Assist with preparing and organizing exhibits, riders, change orders, and supporting documentation.
Budget and Cost Tracking
· Work with Project Managers to maintain current project budget trackers and cost reports.
· Assist with organizing supporting financial documentation and identifying outstanding or incomplete information.
· Help ensure project-related financial records remain current and consistent with approved budgets.
Payments and Reconciliation
· Process approved payments to vendors and other third parties in accordance with Company procedures.
· Coordinate with Project Managers, onsite staff, subcontractors, vendors, accounting personnel, and other external parties to resolve accounts payable and accounts receivable questions.
· All other responsibilities as assigned.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

· 1–3 years of experience in an administrative, project coordination, office management, or similar role; commercial real estate, construction, development, or property management experience is preferred.
· Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and changing priorities simultaneously.
· Demonstrated ability to take initiative, assume ownership of responsibilities, and work independently with limited day-to-day supervision.
· Strong written and verbal communication skills with a professional, responsive, and relationship-oriented approach.
· Comfortable working in a fully remote environment while maintaining a consistent and dependable work schedule.
· Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential company, financial, contractual, and personnel information.
· Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel, as well as Adobe Acrobat.
· Ability and willingness to learn and effectively use project management, document management, accounting, and other Company systems.
· Current notary commission preferred; willingness and ability to obtain and maintain a notary commission, including remote online notarization capabilities, may be required.
· Resourceful and solutions-oriented, with an interest in continuously improving administrative processes and workflows.

What You’ll Get In Return

At North American, we live our values of Relationships, Ownership, Agility, Strength and Stability, Courage and Creativity, Empowerment and Integrity. North American and its portfolio companies invest first in people, recognizing that our people are our greatest assets. jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Media Buyer & Creative Strategist who knows that great advertising is about more than pushing buttons in Ads Manager.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Media Buyer & Creative Strategist who knows that great advertising is about more than pushing buttons in Ads Manager. You understand the relationship between creative, data, audiences, and performance—and you know how to turn those insights into campaigns that drive sales.

The Role
As our Media Buyer & Creative Strategist, you'll own the strategy, execution, and optimization of paid advertising while also helping shape the creative direction behind our ads.
You'll analyze what's working, identify why it's working, develop new creative concepts to test, and work closely with our creative team, content creators, and other marketing partners to turn those ideas into high-performing ads.
We're looking for someone who is data-driven, creative, curious, and obsessed with finding what makes customers click—and buy.

What You'll Do
Media Buying & Campaign Management
  • Manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
  • Own campaign setup, targeting, budgets, bidding, pacing, and optimization.
  • Monitor key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM, CVR, and spend.
  • Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns and quickly address underperforming campaigns.
  • Conduct audience, placement, offer, product, and campaign structure testing.
  • Manage daily and weekly budget pacing to ensure spend aligns with revenue and profitability goals.
  • Stay current on platform updates, advertising trends, and emerging paid media opportunities.
Creative Strategy
  • Develop the creative strategy behind paid advertising campaigns.
  • Identify high-performing hooks, messaging, product benefits, offers, formats, and angles.
  • Analyze winning and losing creatives to understand why they performed.
  • Turn performance data into clear, actionable creative briefs.
  • Partner with graphic designers, video editors, content creators, and UGC creators to develop new ad concepts.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of fresh creative concepts and testing opportunities.
  • Help determine what types of content, messaging, and storytelling will resonate with different audiences.
  • Stay on top of trends in UGC, short-form video, social media, and performance creative.
Testing & Optimization
  • Develop and manage a structured creative testing strategy.
  • Test hooks, headlines, thumbnails, messaging, CTAs, offers, formats, products, and audiences.
  • Establish performance benchmarks and identify winning creative quickly.
  • Scale winning concepts across campaigns and platforms.
  • Continuously refresh creative to combat ad fatigue.
  • Use performance insights to influence future creative strategy.
Analytics & Reporting
  • Monitor campaign performance and identify trends, opportunities, and problems.
  • Analyze performance by campaign, audience, product, creative, and funnel stage.
  • Create regular performance reports and clearly communicate key takeaways.
  • Turn data into actionable recommendations—not just reports.
  • Work with the broader marketing team to identify opportunities to improve the customer journey from ad click through purchase.
  • Help develop a deeper understanding of what drives customer acquisition and conversion.
You'd Be a Great Fit If...

You don't just look at an ad and ask "Did it work?"

You ask:
"Why did it work?"
"Who did it work for?"
"What should we test next?"
"How do we turn this into 10 more winning ads?"

You're equally comfortable looking at a spreadsheet of performance data and brainstorming a killer hook for a new TikTok ad.

You don't wait for someone to tell you what to test. You're constantly looking for the next opportunity to improve performance.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionSprout Social is looking to hire a Director, Engineering - Artificial Intelligence to join our engineering team.
jobs.description:
Description

Sprout Social is looking to hire a Director, Engineering - Artificial Intelligence to join our engineering team. This leader will report to the Senior Vice President, Engineering. The key focus of this role is to help build and execute our platform-wide AI strategy. As a member of Sprout’s Engineering leadership team, this leader will also facilitate strong collaboration across the engineering, product management and product design organizations.

Why join Sprout’s Engineering team?

Sprout empowers businesses worldwide to harness the immense power and opportunity of social media in today’s digital-first world. Processing over one billion social messages daily, our platform serves up essential insights and actionable information to over 30,000 brands, informing strategic decisions that drive business growth and innovation, and fostering deeper, authentic connections to their end customers. Our full suite of social media management solutions includes comprehensive publishing and engagement functionality, customer care solutions, influencer marketing, connected workflows, and business intelligence. We're actively working to intuitively weave AI throughout our products, enabling organizations to work smarter, unleash their creativity, and maximize the business impact of social media–that’s where you come in!

With collaborative, cross-functional teams spanning front-end, back-end, applied science, and ML Ops, our team is a place to sharpen your craft and solve hard problems alongside some of the smartest people in the industry. As a Director of Engineering, you’ll operate at “tech-giant” scale, leading engineers and technical leaders while partnering closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and other teams to shape strategy and deliver against a shared roadmap. You’ll provide leadership across architecture, system design, engineering execution, and talent development, while helping define how our products, platforms, and services interconnect and scale. You’ll also join an empathetic Engineering Leadership team committed to helping each other grow, raising the bar for engineering excellence, and supporting our teams in delivering world-class products.

What you’ll do

  • As a Director, you will be a key member of the AI leadership team and be responsible for building high-functioning teams of applied AI/ML scientists and engineers and steering them to iteratively deliver quality results.
  • You’ll lead the engineering team building foundational AI/ML products that will be used across our entire product suite and customer base.
  • You will partner closely with the VP, Engineering and your leaders to chart the strategic growth of the current team, defining and building new teams and helping to steer architecture and product direction.
  • Relying on your experience in building and maintaining highly scalable, reliable, distributed AI products and leading applied science teams, you'll lead teams to iteratively deliver quality software.
  • You will guide the team through complicated product and technical roadmaps, and partner with product management and design to align on the strategy for your teams and support its execution.
  • You’ll grow your team of engineers and applied scientists by example with effective feedback, coaching, and career development.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a collaborative, pragmatic, highly motivating Engineering leader to help our AI team succeed and invest in the right capabilities to improve our customer experience and impact through AI and machine learning. If you confidently lead teams to solve hard problems, push them to learn from and teach each other, and work across functions and teams to get your teams to deliver, we'd love to talk with you!

The minimum qualifications for this role include:

  • 7+ years of experience building and supporting products in a production environment
  • 7+ years in software development, including several years leading teams and managing through leaders, with a track record of building sustainable, high-performing team structure.
  • Experience leading engineering teams building AI/ML or agentic products, including partnering with or leading applied scientists and AI/ML engineers.
  • Recent, direct experience (typically the last 2-3 years) leading or closely driving the development of modern AI products, agentic or LLM-based systems, evaluation and quality, built on foundation models. We care more about the depth and recency of your AI-product experience than the number of years.

Preferred qualifications for this role include:

  • Direct experience leading a mixed team of applied scientists and AI/ML engineers, and an understanding of how to lead research-inflected work, evaluation, model judgment, and quality, alongside product engineering.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and scaling high-performance teams through hiring and coaching of engineering leaders, applied scientists, and AI/ML engineers
  • Experience at a SaaS or product company that made a meaningful AI pivot or shift in product direction.
  • Experience aligning a team's focus and vision towards the most impactful work across a complex product suite to meet the needs of a diverse, global customer base
  • Track record of influencing and aligning stakeholders across different points of view or functions, to drive successful outcomes
  • Experience developing enterprise-level distributed applications using Python, Java, distributed queuing systems, etc.
  • Experience developing systems to deploy, manage, evaluate, and serve machine learning models and agentic products at scale
  • Experience with generative AI, including open source and third party solutions (e.g., OpenAI)

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Experiencing Sprout’s in-depth onboarding, covering everything from our company mission and values, hearing directly from executives and founders, to deep training on our products and the value that Sprout delivers to our customers
  • Learning the current state of AI and machine learning at Sprout and future product and technical roadmaps
  • Meeting your team in 1:1s to understand what’s working, what’s not, and gathering learnings to implement into your role
  • Establishing relationships with other engineering, product and design leaders and identify areas of opportunity

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Participating in architectural discussions and decisions, bringing an informed industry perspective to ask the right questions and guide your team toward successful outcomes
  • Assuming management of the AI team's engineering leaders. Meeting with them regularly and providing them with direct, constructive feedback on their work, as well as formulating career growth plans
  • Participating in quarterly planning and roadmap processes and helping your team shape the technical roadmap for long-term success
  • Getting acclimated to the hiring process and partner with your leaders to establish a staffing plan and process for the teams
  • Helping your team and leaders improve processes and team rituals
  • Building relationships with our infrastructure, product, go to market, legal, and support teams and identify ways your teams can be more proactive and effective.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Guiding and proactively evaluating your team’s execution on a major feature launch.
  • Understanding the business goals and helping the team proactively focus on the right problems while balancing technical debt, bugs, and product features with measurable results
  • Leading the performance review and career band calibration process for your team and coach your leaders through performance conversations with their direct reports
  • Partnering with the VP, Engineering, product and design teams to evangelize our AI and ML technical and product vision with internal and external stakeholders
  • Becoming an expert in our approach to AI and to confidently speak to ever-changing trends, new product features and platform enhancements to internal and external stakeholders

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Continue to develop your team, both personally and professionally, and having development plans in place for your team to hold them accountable
  • Serving as Sprout's bridge to the broader AI/ML industry by staying current on emerging trends and technologies and proactively bringing that outside perspective into the team's strategy and roadmap
  • Being recognized as a subject matter expert and leader in artificial intelligence and machine learning at Sprout
  • Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change our AI capabilities in Sprout in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleConnect is one of the premier and fastest selling products at Sutherland, providing a full omni-channel, Contact Center as a Service solution for our clients.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Connect is one of the premier and fastest selling products at Sutherland, providing a full omni-channel, Contact Center as a Service solution for our clients. We are looking for an experienced Sr. Product Delivery Manager to join our growing team and drive the delivery of Connect products and services through the full development lifecycle.

The Product Owner sets product vision and roadmap direction. From that point the product is yours through delivery: shaping requirements into a solution that can actually be built, making the trade-off calls that decide what ships and what defers, driving the build, running QA and UAT, and getting the product released and ready to deploy. Client deployments are run by the project management organization, and you support them as the product authority. At times this team carries the deployment directly. This is not a coordination role. You are expected to apply product judgment on scope, design, and release readiness, and to carry the professional standing that earns you the respect of engineering, operations, and clients.

Real contact center expertise is essential. You will make product and delivery decisions daily on omni-channel routing, telephony, agent desktop, recording, reporting, and integration behavior. You need to know how a contact center runs well enough to recognize when a design will not hold up against real routing, peak volume, or a failover, and to make that case to engineering. Candidates must have delivered products or capabilities on a contact center platform.

You will join a team of Product Delivery Managers reporting to the Head of Product Delivery. Delivery work is shared across the team, so you will coordinate with your peers on dependencies, shared components, release trains, and release order, and help shape the standards the team works to. The role has no direct reports and depends on working effectively across architecture, engineering, QA, project management, implementation, and operations. This is a remote position based in the United States. The team works US business hours, primarily Eastern Time and extending to Pacific Time, and that must be your normal business day. This role cannot be worked as an offset shift from another region.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Intake & Delivery Planning

  • Take product direction and priorities from the Head of Product Delivery and shape them into a delivery plan, including where the approach has to change to hold up in a live contact center.
  • Review requirements for clarity, completeness, testability, and feasibility. Take gaps, conflicts, and ambiguities back to the Head of Product Delivery and resolve them before work starts.
  • Break requirements into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria that development and QA can work from.
  • Size and phase the work with engineering, set milestones and release targets, and identify dependencies, assumptions, and risks up front.
  • Coordinate with peer Product Delivery Managers on cross-product dependencies, shared components, and release order.
  • Separate client-specific configuration from core product capability, and flag anything that would change product direction for the Head of Product Delivery.
  • Escalate scope, capacity, or timeline conflicts to the Head of Product Delivery with options and a recommendation.

Design & Build

  • Own execution for your assigned products and features: scope, schedule, quality, and dependencies.
  • Work with solution architects and engineering leads to turn approved requirements into functional and technical designs, and test those designs against real routing, agent workflow, telephony, recording, and reporting behavior.
  • Act as product owner for the scrum team: maintain the backlog, clarify requirements, clear roadblocks, and accept completed work against the acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain accurate delivery status and raise risks, issues, and blockers early with a recommended course of action.
  • Make the scope calls inside a release: decide what ships and what defers based on defect risk, client impact, and production readiness.

QA, UAT & Release

  • Set test scope, strategy, and entry and exit criteria with QA, and confirm coverage against the documented requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Run defect triage and prioritization, push fixes and retests, and track defect trends against the release date.
  • Plan and lead user acceptance testing with internal and client stakeholders and obtain UAT sign-off.
  • Own the product release plan with engineering and operations, including environment readiness, rollback, and go / no go criteria for putting the product into service.
  • Give the Head of Product Delivery a go or no go recommendation supported by test results, open defects, and known risk.
  • Support the project management organization on client deployments as the product authority, and lead the deployment directly when this team carries it.

Release & Deployment Support

  • Produce the release package the deployment teams work from: release notes, configuration and technical documentation, runbooks, and internal readiness sessions.
  • Hand the product to operations, support, and the project management organization with escalation paths, known issues, and supportability documentation.
  • Act as the product escalation point once deployments are in the field: answer design and configuration questions, and own resolution of product defects found during rollout.
  • Stay engaged through hypercare on the product side, working with operations and support until production issues and post-release fixes are closed.
  • Turn production performance, defect trends, and delivery lessons into roadmap direction and bring it back to the Head of Product Delivery, and manage delivery of enhancements, maintenance releases, and version upgrades.
  • 7+ years of hands-on contact center technology experience across voice, email, chat, SMS, social, web, video, and mobile.
  • 5+ years in product delivery, delivery management, product ownership, or technical project management for software products.
  • Availability to work USA EST or CST working hours
  • Hands-on delivery or configuration experience on at least one major contact center platform: Genesys, NICE, Cisco, Avaya, Five9, Amazon Connect, or Twilio Flex.
  • Working knowledge of how contact center components fit together: ACD and routing, IVR and self-service, CTI and agent desktop, dialer and outbound, call recording, screen recording, quality management, workforce management, and reporting.
  • Experience with contact center integrations: CRM and ticketing, screen pop, APIs and webhooks, SIP and carrier connectivity, and reporting feeds.
  • Experience planning and executing production releases into live 24x7 customer-facing environments, including go-live, rollback, and go / no go decisions.
  • Working knowledge of QA practice: test strategy, defect triage and prioritization, release criteria, and UAT.
  • Experience with Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery, using Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Familiarity with the regulatory environment contact centers operate in, including PCI-DSS, TCPA, GDPR, HIPAA, and call recording consent.
  • Prior experience reviewing and analyzing contact center solutions, and recommending design improvements and roadmap direction.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including reporting to leadership and translating between business and technical audiences.
  • Sound judgment under pressure: able to weigh incomplete information and make a defensible call rather than escalate every decision.
  • Strong analytical skills and the discipline to track dependencies, defects, and commitments without losing sight of the release goal.
  • Takes accountability for delivery outcomes and product quality.
  • Effective in a fast-paced hybrid Agile environment with shifting priorities.
  • Builds durable working relationships across engineering, QA, operations, and client teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Delivery experience in a BPO or outsourced contact center environment, with multi-client and multi-site deployments.
  • Experience delivering AI and automation into a contact center: virtual agents, conversational IVR, agent assist, speech and text analytics, or intelligent routing.
  • Experience delivering CCaaS capabilities in a multi-tenant, cloud-native environment.
  • Prior time inside contact center operations, such as a supervisor or workforce role, alongside technology delivery.
  • Relevant certifications such as CSPO, CSM, SAFe, or PMP, or a platform-specific contact center certification.

About Sutherland:

Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.

We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market-leading technology and business process excellence.

We’ve created over 200 unique inventions under several patents across AI and other critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as a service” model.

For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. We tailor proven and rapid formulas, to fit their unique DNA. We bring together human expertise and artificial intelligence to develop digital chemistry. This unlocks new possibilities, transformative outcomes and enduring relationships.

Sutherland

Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results
