jobs.excerpt: Transforming the Future of Enterprise PlanningAt o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach.
jobs.description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning

At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.

The Scale of Opportunity

o9 is on a trajectory that very few enterprise software companies ever reach. We are building toward a global footprint of 10,000 enterprise customers—each running complex, mission-critical supply chain and business planning operations on our platform. At that scale, AI is not a buzzword or a feature add-on; it is our core strategic differentiator.

Our ambition goes further: o9 is pursuing a neurosymbolic AI architecture—combining the reasoning power of large language models with the formal rigor of symbolic computation and constraint-based planning. The platform that emerges will be unlike anything currently available in enterprise software. The person who steps into this role will literally write the playbook and construct the foundation for this architecture.

To understand the core philosophy behind what you will be building, review the framework established by our EVP of AI, Ashwin Rao:

  • Read the fundamental thesis onThe Neurosymbolic Imperative for Enterprise AI.

  • Explore the practical application of this paradigm inDavos Insights: Turning VUCA into Value with Neuro-Symbolic AI.

The north star for our customers is the APEX operating model—a state of integrated, autonomous, AI-driven planning that eliminates the friction between insight and action across the enterprise. This role is the architectural engine that makes APEX possible.

The Talent-First Hiring Approach

We are adopting an open-pool, talent-first search to build out our global core AI team across multiple levels of seniority. Rather than fitting exceptional engineers and researchers into rigid titles upfront, candidates are evaluated holistically based on their technical depth, problem-solving abilities, and potential impact. Final roles and levels will be tailored to each candidate’s unique skillset and experience.

Core Impact Tracks

Candidates will be evaluated for placement across one or more of the following six impact domains:

  • Data Engineering: Architect high-throughput data pipelines and power our Enterprise Knowledge Graph to handle petabyte-scale enterprise operational data.

  • Software Engineering: Construct high-performance software frameworks and architectural blueprints that enable hundreds of engineers to safely and predictably ship AI capabilities.

  • Machine Learning:Benchmark, fine-tune, and deploy state-of-the-art connectionist neural networks, foundation models, and vector infrastructures at scale.

  • Forecasting: Develop predictive time-series models and statistical engines to drive high-accuracy demand planning across global supply networks.

  • Optimization: Design deterministic, constraint-based solvers and algorithmic planning engines to automate complex enterprise decisions.

  • Agentic AI:Architect state-of-the-art agentic workflows and multi-agent systems to support autonomous enterprise planning and the APEX operating model.

What we look for

  • Deep Technical Foundations: Strong engineering or research background with a proven track record of building and transforming software platforms or complex algorithms.

  • Tier-1 Tech Background: Tenure at premier technology organizations or high-growth tech platforms.

  • Algorithmic & Neurosymbolic Aptitude:Experience or strong interest in combining statistical/neural AI techniques with symbolic, rule-based, or constraint-driven planning.

  • High Autonomy: Fast-moving, comfortable operating without bureaucratic approval chains, and accountable for technical outcomes.

  • Scale & Production Focus: Passion for taking cutting-edge R&D and turning it into scalable, production-grade enterprise software.

Our Interview Process

We believe in evaluating engineering talent through meaningful conversations rather than generic, automated coding tests. Our process is designed to be candidate-centric, transparent, and tailored to your specific technical domain.

  • Talent Acquisition Screen:An initial conversation with our TA team to learn about your background, share details on our core AI vision, and align on potential impact tracks and seniority levels.

  • Technical & Architectural Discussions (3x 45-Minute Sessions): Three separate, conversation-style technical interviews with current o9 engineers. Interviewers are hand-selected for each candidate based on your specific background and technical expertise. These sessions focus on real-world problem-solving, architectural design, and deep technical discussions.

  • Final Round with CTO:A strategic discussion with Ashwin Rao, our CTO, focusing on top-level technical vision, AI architecture, culture fit, and where you can drive the highest impact within o9's AI organization.

This position at o9 Solutions has an annual salary range of $178,283-$245,140. Additionally, you may be eligible to participate in our medical, retirement, and other company-sponsored benefits.

**The above information reflects the expected base salary range, although the lower and upper bounds may vary based on location, skills, experience, certifications, licenses, or other relevant factors.

More about us…

At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.

With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.

o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

About Zuma

Zuma is pioneering the future of agentic AI and our focus is to transform the rental market experience for consumers and property manager alike. Our innovative platform is engineered from the ground up to boost operations efficiency and enhance support capabilities for property management business across the US and Canada, a ~$200B market.
Off the back of our Series-A in early 2024, Zuma is scaling rapidly. Achieving our vision requires a team of passionate, innovative individuals eager to leverage technology to redefine customer-business interactions. We're on the hunt for exceptional talent ready to join our mission and contribute to building a groundbreaking technology that reshapes how businesses engage with customers.
Zuma has raised over $17M in funding to date and has support from world-renowned investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Y Combinator, King River, Range Ventures, and distinguished angel investors like YC’s former COO, Qasar Younis.

The Role

As a Support Engineer at Zuma, you’ll be a bridge between our customers, engineering team, and product vision. You’ll ensure new customers onboard smoothly, integrations run reliably, and support operations scale as we grow. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves problem-solving, can dive into APIs and databases, and takes pride in clear documentation and communication. You’ll help property managers succeed with our AI platform while also driving continuous improvements in our internal tools and processes.

Why This Could Be Your Dream Role

  • You want to work at a company where customers feel your impact every day
  • You'll have autonomy to design and implement innovative technical solutions
  • Your work will directly impact thousands of apartment communities and millions of renters
  • You'll receive significant equity in a venture-backed company with strong traction
  • As we scale, your role and influence will grow with the company

Why You Might Want to Think Twice

  • This is a demanding role that will often require extended hours and deep commitment
  • As a founding team member, you'll need to wear multiple hats and step outside your comfort zone
  • You'll need to make thoughtful tradeoffs between innovation and immediate needs
  • You'll interact directly with customers to understand their needs and occasionally travel to their offices
  • We're a startup - priorities can shift rapidly as we respond to market opportunities and customer needs
  • If you're not comfortable getting your hands dirty with legacy code or speaking directly with customers, this isn't the job for you

Responsibilities

  • Lead critical system rewrites to transform our architecture into a highly scalable, resilient foundation
  • Own the design and performance optimization of our data storage systems, ensuring they scale with customer and AI demands
  • Build and evolve our deployment pipelines, enabling reliable, automated releases for AI-first products
  • Set up and manage modern cloud infrastructure from scratch, leveraging Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to ensure consistency, security, and scalability
  • Establish engineering best practices, including observability, incident response processes, and system hardening for an AI-first platform
  • Drive robust analytics and monitoring to track performance, reliability, and the effectiveness of our AI solutions
  • Mentor engineers and elevate the team's capabilities across infrastructure, scalability, and AI product development

Your Experience Looks Like

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 3+ years of experience building production-grade software systems, with a focus on scalability, performance, and reliability
  • Proven expertise in backend development with , including API design, system architecture, and cloud-based services
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar) and deploying production systems using Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi)
  • Hands-on experience with database design, performance tuning, and scaling high-throughput data systems
  • Familiarity with building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern DevOps practices
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a distributed, fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable operating in early-stage, high-ownership environments with evolving requirements
  • Bonus: Experience with React and TypeScript on the frontend, though this role leans backend/infrastructure
  • Bonus: Exposure to LLM-based systems, AI infrastructure, or agentic AI workflows

Guiding Principles

    Customer‑First Outcomes

    Every commit should trace back to resident or operator value. Whether it’s a new feature, infra investment, or AI capability, if it doesn’t solve a real problem, it doesn’t ship.

    Bias for Simplicity

    We favor composable primitives over clever abstractions. Open standards, clean APIs, and clear contracts win over custom complexity, even if the custom version is cooler.

    Quality Is a Gate, Not an After‑Thought

    Quality is built-in from day one. Our definition of done includes: test coverage, performance checks, basic observability, and internal docs. Shipping fast doesn’t mean skipping craftsmanship.

    Data‑Driven Choices

    We use data to guide, not paralyze, our decision-making. We track leading indicators (cycle time, defect rate, NPS) and lagging signals (retention, revenue impact). We keep instrumentation lightweight but meaningful signal over spreadsheet.

    Transparency & Written Culture

    Good ideas don’t expire in Zoom. We operate in public inside the company, TDDs, PR reviews, and Linear tickets tell the story. This keeps us async-friendly, auditable, and aligned across time zones and functions.

Other Benefits

  • Great health insurance, dental, and vision.
  • Gym and workspace stipends.
  • Computer and workspace enhancements.
  • Unlimited PTO.
  • Opportunity to play a critical role in building the foundations of the company and Engineering culture.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

Territory Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.

Strategic Account Management & Network Development

  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.

Influence & Impact

Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Minimum qualifications:

Preferred qualifications:

Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

We are looking for a Director, Medicare Advantage Strategy to bring deep Medicare Advantage expertise to Twin as we build and scale our offering for MA members and health plan partners.

This person will be Twin's internal expert on the Medicare Advantage population, ecosystem, and market. You will help us deeply understand MA members—their needs, behaviors, barriers, care experiences, and expectations—and translate that expertise into better product, clinical, operational, and commercial decisions.

You will partner closely with Product, Clinical, Operations, Commercial, Marketing, and executive leadership to help shape Twin's Medicare Advantage strategy and member experience. You will bring an informed perspective on what works, what doesn't, what health plans expect, and where the market is headed—helping Twin anticipate needs and opportunities rather than simply reacting to them.

This is an ideal role for someone who has spent significant time in Medicare Advantage and wants to use that expertise to help build a differentiated, technology- and AI-enabled model of metabolic care for the Medicare population.

You will also serve as an external voice for Twin on Medicare Advantage, representing the company with customers, partners, industry groups, panels, and conferences.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as Twin's subject matter expert on Medicare Advantage, bringing deep knowledge of MA members, health plans, care models, market dynamics, and industry best practices.
  • Develop a deep, continuously evolving understanding of the MA member, including health needs, motivations, technology comfort, accessibility needs, care-seeking behaviors, social needs, engagement barriers, and expectations of their health plan and care providers.
  • Advise Product, Design, Clinical, and Operations teams on how Twin's member experience and care model should evolve for the Medicare population.
  • Partner with the Medicare Advantage Product Lead to shape the end-to-end MA member journey, identify gaps and opportunities, and pressure-test product strategy and roadmap decisions.
  • Help Twin look around corners by monitoring changes in the MA market, CMS policy, health plan priorities, competitive offerings, emerging care models, and member expectations—and translating those changes into implications for Twin.
  • Bring expertise across key MA domains including member experience, Stars and quality, CAHPS, supplemental benefits, care management, health equity, risk adjustment, utilization, retention, and plan economics—and understand how these areas interact with Twin's offering.
  • Partner with Commercial and Product Marketing to understand health plan priorities, strengthen Twin's MA value proposition, support strategic customer conversations, and inform positioning and competitive differentiation.
  • Build and maintain Twin's internal MA knowledge base, educating teams and leadership on the Medicare Advantage ecosystem, member population, terminology, incentives, and emerging trends.
  • Establish relationships with external experts, health plans, industry organizations, and other stakeholders to keep Twin connected to evolving MA practices and perspectives.
  • Represent Twin externally as a Medicare Advantage thought leader through customer conversations, industry panels, conferences, webinars, and other forums.
  • Help identify new opportunities for Twin within Medicare Advantage, including populations, partnerships, capabilities, and care models where Twin can create differentiated member and plan value.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Deep Medicare Advantage Experience: 10+ years of experience in Medicare Advantage, Medicare, managed care, or closely related healthcare roles, with significant direct exposure to MA.
  • Member & Market Expertise: Deep understanding of the Medicare population and the practical realities of engaging and caring for older adults and other Medicare beneficiaries.
  • Health Plan Expertise: Strong understanding of how Medicare Advantage plans operate, make decisions, measure performance, and evaluate partners and solutions.
  • Broad MA Knowledge: Working expertise across multiple dimensions of Medicare Advantage, such as Stars, CAHPS/member experience, clinical programs, care management, supplemental benefits, risk adjustment, health equity, retention, and regulatory requirements.
  • Builder's Mindset: Comfortable moving beyond explaining how Medicare Advantage works to helping design what a better Medicare experience should look like.
  • Executive Presence: Strong communicator who can represent Twin credibly with senior health plan leaders, customers, partners, industry experts, and external audiences.
  • Thought Leadership: Experience presenting to executive audiences and ideally speaking at industry events, panels, conferences, webinars, or other external forums.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator (Contractor)
jobs.excerpt: Join the Rest RevolutionThe world is wired and tired.
jobs.description:
Join the Rest Revolution

The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.

So here's a bit of good news amidst all the noise: Hatch is a sleep wellness company that's betting on rest in a culture obsessed with optimization. While most technology is designed to keep you engaged, our devices use the science of habit formation to help people unplug, unwind, and recharge. Through genuinely enjoyable routines, habit building, and gentle guidance (no sleep scores or wearables here), we help people build healthier sleep habits and feel the difference in everyday life.

Ten years ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.

We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

The Gig: How You’ll Make an Impact

Our Operations team is looking for a Logistics Contractor to support omnichannel distribution while a team member is out on leave—keeping inbound freight and forwarder relationships on track, and owning the transactions, landed cost, and inventory reconciliation that keep our books accurate across every location. The contractor will be working up to 40 hours per week. This is an initial 6-month contract engagement, with the option to extend based on business needs.

This is a coverage role with real ownership. You'll be the person our forwarders and 3PLs hear from when a shipment needs to move faster or a booking decision has to be made, and the person Sourcing, Inventory Planning, and Accounting come to for shipment status, transaction accuracy, and landed cost questions. We're not looking for someone to hold the seat warm. We need someone who can read a shipment exception, decide what to do, and close the loop with the transactions and reconciliations that keep inventory accurate across every channel. You'll report to the Director of Operations and work closely with Sourcing, Inventory Planning, Channel Management, Accounting, and our forwarder and 3PL partners.

This role is remote-friendly but must be based in the U.S. or Canada. Hatch is based in California, so we ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

What You'll Do

📆 Projects:

  • Own day-to-day international inbound freight execution across Flexport and Amazon Global Logistics (AGL): create and manage bookings, review rates and surcharges, track shipments from factory to destination, and resolve exceptions with carriers and forwarders
  • Manage Amazon inbound programs end to end: FBA shipment creation and labeling, AWD placement and replenishment, inventory removals, resolving inbound creation issues by creating cases with Amazon as needed, and FC routing changes—across US and our expanding EU and UK marketplaces
  • Serve as the single source of truth on shipment status. Publish recurring shipment updates to the supply chain team so planning, sourcing, and channel partners know what's landing when, without having to chase it
  • Coordinate customs clearance and trade compliance: HTS classification support, commercial documentation accuracy, customs broker coordination, and responses to CBP requests for information
  • Access US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) ACE portal to match customs check numbers to their related entry numbers
  • Partner with Sourcing and our contract manufacturers (Luxshare, Escatec, and others) on shipping documents, labeling requirements, cargo readiness, and payment or document-release blockers that hold up freight
  • EPR maintenance: Pull monthly/quarterly reports as needed, ensure invoices are paid, request updates on pending EPR numbers, and request contracts for new territories
  • Maintain and update landed cost on a shipment and individual product basis.
  • Create and reconcile transactions in Netsuite that accompany the physical movement of goods between supplier and warehouse.
  • Own month-end inventory reconciliation process across all physical locations.
  • Escalate 3PL and forwarder SLA misses, chase credits on performance-related chargebacks, and partner with Accounting on freight invoice and deduction disputes

🚀 Wishlist:

  • Build a lightweight weekly inbound health summary so leadership sees freight risk, cost trends, and Amazon inventory position without asking for it
  • Document the recurring plays—AGL vs. Flexport routing decisions, Amazon booking workarounds, EU customs routing, CBP response process—so this knowledge doesn't live in one person's head
  • Identify freight cost savings opportunities through carrier and mode comparison, and bring a recommendation rather than a spreadsheet
  • Support peak season readiness: BFCM inventory positioning, AWD storage promotion deadlines, and Chinese New Year factory shutdown planning
  • Improve the inbound exception loop so delays surface to planning and channel teams the same day, not the same week

✨ Human:

  • Proactive communicator: you post the update before someone asks for it, and you say what you're doing about a delay in the same breath as reporting it
  • Independent operator: you own your workstream, make routing and escalation calls without daily check-ins, and know which decisions genuinely need your manager
  • Calm in exceptions: customs holds, missed vessels, withheld bills of lading, and Amazon portal glitches are the job, not the emergency. You work the problem and keep everyone informed
  • Ramps fast: You're comfortable being useful in week two of a contract engagement, in someone else's systems, on someone else's partner relationships

What You'll Bring

Must have:

  • 5+ years in international logistics, freight forwarding, or supply chain operations, ideally in consumer electronics or CPG. This is a coverage role with a short ramp, so we're looking for someone who has done this work before rather than someone growing into it
  • Hands-on experience running international ocean and air freight yourself: creating bookings, reading rate structures and GRIs, managing forwarders, and resolving shipment exceptions without waiting for someone to tell you what to do
  • Direct, personal experience with Amazon inbound programs—Seller Central, FBA shipment creation and labeling, AWD—including the operational quirks of Amazon's routing and receiving rules
  • Working knowledge of customs and trade compliance: HTS classification, commercial documentation, duties, and responding to CBP requests for information
  • ERP experience including transfer order management, receipt creation, and month-end transaction completeness audit.
  • Knowledge and experience in performing month-end inventory reconciliations.
  • Strong written communication. A real part of this role is clear, timely async updates that a cross-functional team can act on
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and something always pops up mid-day

Strong plus:

  • Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Global Logistics (AGL) and Amazon Warehousing and Distribution(AWD) experience specifically
  • NetSuite
  • Familiary with CBP’s ACE portal
  • EU and UK import experience, including customs clearance routing
  • Experience working directly with contract manufacturers in Asia on shipping documentation and cargo readiness
  • Freight cost analysis and carrier or mode comparison

Why You’ll Love Working at Hatch

  • We’re a certified Great Place to Work
  • We help people sleep better. Our products make a real, meaningful difference in our customers’ lives
  • Our team is collaborative, fun, and full of brilliant minds, and you’ll work with leadership that truly values every contribution
  • We’re backed by world-class investors (and growing fast)
  • We’re a remote-friendly work environment. We practice what we preach to give our employees better balance and more flexibility

The Perks & Benefits That Matter

  • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees (80% for dependents, including domestic partners)
  • Meaningful equity. You’re an owner here
  • 401(k) match with no vesting schedule
  • 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave
  • 16 free therapy sessions (for you and one other adult in your life)
  • Financial support for family planning
  • Remote office and monthly internet reimbursement
  • Friends and family discounts on Hatch products
  • Exclusive discounts on travel, entertainment, and top retail brands

About Hatch

Hatch was founded in 2014 by entrepreneurs (and parents themselves) Ann Crady Weiss and Dave Weiss. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, Hatch creates tech that helps you and your family get better sleep.

Hatch Sleep Clock is a contactless sleep tracker that provides actionable insights, personalized recommendations, and bedtime routines based on your unique sleep habits and preferences

  • Restore 3 helps you regulate your nervous system and tune into your circadian rhythm with unwind routines, science-backed sleep audio, and ambient lights
  • Hatch Baby helps parents soothe their little ones and create healthy sleep habits with expert sleep support, gentle sounds, and calming lights
  • Hatch Go includes ten soothing sounds in one portable package

This role will focus on building and scaling Next Best Action (NBA) frameworks and omnichannel engagement strategies to enable personalized HCP and patient journeys, improve commercial effectiveness, and drive business impact.

Responsibilities

Pharma Media Analytics & Optimization

  • Lead pharmaceutical media analytics and performance measurement across HCP and patient audiences, spanning paid media, programmatic, search, social, video/OLV, CTV, endemic publishers, point-of-care, email/CRM, and web.
  • Own in-flight campaign analytics, performance monitoring, and optimization recommendations, translating media and customer engagement signals into clear actions for Brand and Media teams.
  • Develop standardized media KPI frameworks, QBRs, executive readouts, and performance narratives connecting media delivery and engagement to downstream customer and business outcomes.
  • Lead cross-channel measurement across paid, owned, earned, field, CRM/email, and web analytics to provide an integrated view of the HCP and patient journey.
  • Analyze media performance across audience quality, reach, frequency, impressions, engagement, site visitation, conversion, cost efficiency, and downstream business impact.
  • Partner closely with Brand, Media, Agencies, Commercial Analytics, Decision Sciences, and offshore analytics teams to translate insights into next actions and optimization roadmaps.
  • Evaluate HCP and patient audience strategies, including segmentation, targeting, suppression, lookalike modeling, audience overlap, and media exposure effectiveness.
  • Partner with media agencies and publishers to establish appropriate measurement plans, data feeds, taxonomy, tagging, and campaign-level reporting requirements.
  • Connect media exposure and engagement data with claims, CRM, customer master, sales, patient services, and other commercial datasets, where privacy and data availability permit, to understand downstream impact.
  • Apply advanced measurement approaches including test/control, incrementality, attribution, marketing mix modeling, audience quality analysis, and cross-channel journey analytics.
  • Establish measurement standards for pre-campaign planning → in-flight optimization → post-campaign effectiveness → learning agenda, creating a continuous test-and-learn cycle.
  • Champion AI-enabled media analytics, including automated insight generation, anomaly detection, predictive optimization, audience modeling, and next-best-action recommendations.

Requirements

    • 10–15+ years of experience across Commercial Analytics, Omnichannel Analytics, Pharma Media Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Science, or strategic consulting, preferably within pharmaceutical/biotechnology organizations or pharma-focused agencies.
    • Significant experience in agency-side pharmaceutical media analytics or measurement is highly desirable; backgrounds from organizations such as CMI Media Group, Epsilon, or comparable healthcare media/analytics agencies are particularly relevant.
    • Demonstrated experience supporting pharmaceutical HCP and DTC media measurement, including the ability to work within privacy, consent, data-use, and regulatory constraints.
    • Proven experience delivering in-flight analytics and optimization recommendations, not solely retrospective campaign reporting.
    • Experience developing KPI frameworks, campaign measurement plans, executive/QBR readouts, and performance narratives for senior Brand and Commercial stakeholders.
    • Demonstrated experience integrating and analyzing media exposure, CRM, web, customer, claims, sales, and patient-level datasets to understand customer journeys and commercial impact.
    • Experience working directly with Brand teams, media agencies, publishers, analytics partners, and offshore delivery teams.
    • Strong understanding of advanced media measurement methodologies including attribution, incrementality, test/control, MMM, audience analytics, segmentation, and optimization.
    • Proven experience transforming analytics from static reporting into business-facing, self-service, AI-enabled decision support.

Additional Required Qualifications

    • Deep understanding of the pharmaceutical media ecosystem across HCP and DTC audiences, including endemic and non-endemic media.
    • Hands-on knowledge of media and digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics/GA4, Adobe Analytics, Google Ads, Meta, programmatic/DSP platforms, campaign/ad-server data, and BI/reporting platforms.
    • Familiarity with healthcare media and data ecosystems such as IQVIA, Crossix/Veeva Crossix, claims-based measurement, HCP identity/data, and other privacy-safe media measurement approaches strongly preferred.
    • Strong understanding of media taxonomy, campaign tagging, audience definition, exposure measurement, cross-channel measurement, and KPI governance.
    • Ability to move beyond reporting metrics such as impressions and clicks and connect media activity to audience quality, customer behavior, engagement, conversion, prescribing/patient outcomes where appropriate, and business impact.
    • Ability to turn complex media and customer analytics into concise executive-ready storytelling, optimization recommendations, and investment decisions.
    • Strong agency and stakeholder-management capabilities, with the ability to challenge media partners constructively and ensure measurement rigor.

Benefits

Significant career development opportunities exist as the company grows. The position offers a unique opportunity to be part of a small, fast-growing, challenging and entrepreneurial environment, with a high degree of individual responsibility.

ABOUT ORSINI

OUR MISSION

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a target-driven, commercially minded and proactive Sales Development Representative to join our Inside Sales team.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a target-driven, commercially minded and proactive Sales Development Representative to join our Inside Sales team.

This is not simply a calling or administration role. The successful candidate will be responsible for creating qualified sales opportunities, engaging senior decision-makers and contributing directly to pipeline growth and revenue generation.

You will need to be someone who enjoys working to targets, is comfortable picking up the phone, can handle rejection, and can think on your feet when conversations don't go according to plan.

You should be able to research an organisation, understand who the right people are, identify a potential business challenge and confidently create a reason for that person to have a conversation with Decision Inc.


Who Are We?

Decision Inc. is a global digital partner that enables businesses to reinvent themselves to realise their full potential.

We deliver agility, resilience, and intelligence to any enterprise, enabling them to adapt quickly and thrive through innovation and opportunity. Our teams have engaged with more than 400 clients globally over the past 15 years, providing them with the expertise to build, operate, and optimise their digital businesses.

We achieve this by leveraging the world's best technology to drive our client's business ambitions forward into tomorrow's reality. These technologies include but are not limited to: Microsoft, SAP, Qlik, Snowflake, Alteryx, Automation Anywhere, and Workday Adaptive Insights.

Our success is ultimately driven by our entrepreneurial culture, industry exposure, and the passion of our people. We have three key cross-functional teams – Functional and Specialist Consulting, Development, and Engineering teams. Based in four global offices, our exceptional consultants focus on delivering value to clients by keeping them at the centre of our service delivery. To find out more about our exciting fast-paced culture visit: Careers at Decision Inc.

What Will You Do?

Key Responsibility:

Pipeline & Lead Generation

  • Proactively identify and engage new business prospects across targeted industries and accounts.
  • Conduct high-quality outbound calling, email and LinkedIn prospecting.
  • Research organisations and senior decision-makers before making contact.
  • Identify business challenges, priorities and potential opportunities.
  • Generate and qualify sales opportunities for the Sales Team.
  • Consistently work towards agreed weekly and monthly meeting and pipeline targets.
  • Follow up on prospects systematically and ensure no viable opportunity is lost.

Sales Qualification

  • Engage with senior stakeholders including C-level, Directors and Heads of Functions.
  • Ask intelligent discovery questions to understand the prospect's business environment and challenges.
  • Qualify opportunities based on business need, timing, authority and potential.
  • Determine whether an opportunity is genuinely worth progressing to the Sales Team.
  • Provide clear and accurate meeting notes and opportunity intelligence to the Sales Team.

Research & Commercial Thinking

  • Research target companies, industries, business strategies and relevant market developments.
  • Understand Decision Inc.'s services and technology capabilities sufficiently to identify relevant conversations.
  • Connect a prospect's business challenge to a potential Decision Inc. solution.
  • Think creatively when a prospect does not respond to the standard approach.
  • Adapt messaging and approach depending on the industry, persona and business situation.

CRM & Sales Discipline

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date prospect and activity information in the CRM.
  • Record calls, conversations, outcomes, next steps and meeting information.
  • Ensure follow-ups are completed within agreed timelines.
  • Provide accurate reporting on activity, meetings, conversion and pipeline contribution.

We are looking for someone who is:

Target Driven

  • Enjoys working towards measurable targets.
  • Has a strong sense of ownership over their numbers.
  • Is motivated by achieving and exceeding KPIs.
  • Understands that activity must ultimately translate into quality meetings and pipeline.

Commercially Minded

  • Understands that this is a business development role, not simply a calling role.
  • Can identify potential business opportunities during conversations.
  • Understands how to speak to business problems rather than simply selling a service.
  • Can confidently engage with senior decision-makers.

A Thinker Who Can Think on Their Feet

  • Can adapt when a conversation takes an unexpected direction.
  • Is comfortable handling objections and challenging conversations.
  • Can ask follow-up questions rather than relying entirely on a script.
  • Can find alternative routes into an account when the first approach doesn't work.
  • Takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.

Resilient & Persistent

  • Comfortable with rejection and difficult conversations.
  • Maintains energy and professionalism throughout the day.
  • Doesn't give up after one or two unsuccessful attempts.
  • Understands that consistent follow-up is critical to sales success.

Curious & Fast Learning

  • Able to quickly understand new technologies, industries and business concepts.
  • Interested in learning about areas such as Data & Analytics, AI, SAP, Microsoft, Finance Transformation and Digital Transformation.
  • Can turn new knowledge into better prospect conversations.

Who Do You Need to Be?

  • 2–3+ years' experience in B2B Inside Sales, Sales Development, Business Development or Lead Generation.
  • Proven experience working towards measurable sales or activity targets.
  • Experience engaging business decision-makers is highly advantageous.
  • Experience selling technology, professional services, consulting or other B2B solutions is advantageous.
  • Experience using CRM and sales prospecting platforms such as Apollo or similar tools is advantageous.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong research and prospecting capabilities.

Personal Attributes

The successful candidate will be:

  • Ambitious
  • Competitive
  • Self-motivated
  • Resilient
  • Curious
  • Confident
  • Commercially aware
  • Organised
  • Proactive
  • Accountable
  • Comfortable speaking to senior executives
  • Able to work independently while contributing to a team

Director Strategic Accounts – Facilities Management

The Director, Strategic Accounts is responsible for developing and executing enterprise growth strategies across Smart Care's most critical Facilities Management partnerships and FM organizations. This executive-facing role serves as a trusted advisor to customer leadership, driving revenue growth, customer retention, operational excellence, and long-term strategic alignment between Smart Care and its customers. This role is responsible for a portfolio of nationally significant Facilities Management relationships that represent substantial strategic growth opportunities for Smart Care.

This person will develop and strengthen long-term strategic partnerships that create mutual value for Smart Care, its customers, and their clients. Through executive relationship management, strategic account planning, and cross-functional collaboration, this role identifies growth opportunities, drives customer retention, and delivers measurable business outcomes.

This role excels at proactive communication with internal departments and external customers and works cross-functionally across Smart Care and its affiliate companies to ensure customer issues are addressed and new opportunities are capitalized upon. This senior individual contributor role combines strategic account leadership with a focus on driving long-term profitable business growth through influence, collaboration, and cross-functional partnership.

To succeed in this position, candidates should have exceptional strategic planning, communication, problem-solving, and time management skills. You should be resourceful, analytical, adaptable, and organized, with the ability to build trust and long-term relationships with customers.

Main Responsibilities

Strategic Account Leadership

  • Own and grow a portfolio of strategic national Facilities Management accounts and key FM organizations.
  • Develop and execute multi-year strategic account plans that align customer priorities with Smart Care growth objectives and drive retention, expansion, and profitability.
  • Map customer stakeholders, decision-makers, and influencers to identify expansion opportunities and mitigate business risk.
  • Build executive-level relationships that establish Smart Care as a trusted strategic partner and create customer advocates.
  • Navigate complex customer organizations to build awareness, advocacy, and alignment across procurement, operations, facilities, and executive leadership teams.
  • Act as the voice of the customer internally while balancing organizational priorities, customer expectations, and profitability objectives.
  • Lead complex contract negotiations that deliver long-term mutual value and support sustainable business growth.

Business Growth & Financial Leadership

  • Own revenue retention, expansion, and profitability targets for assigned strategic accounts.
  • Identify and pursue enterprise-wide opportunities across Smart Care service lines, business units, and geographic markets.
  • Monitor account performance, including revenue growth, margin contribution, renewal rates, customer lifetime value, and share-of-wallet penetration.
  • Leverage customer operational, repair, and maintenance data to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and support strategic decision-making.
  • Develop growth initiatives that strengthen customer relationships while delivering measurable financial results for Smart Care and its customers.
  • Influence and align stakeholders without direct authority to achieve customer and company objectives.

  • Establish relationships with executive, procurement, operational, and account leadership stakeholders across customer organizations.

  • Serve as the primary executive point of contact for assigned accounts and ensure alignment between customer objectives and Smart Care capabilities.

Cross-Functional Sales Leadership

  • Develop national account strategies that create revenue opportunities across regional and local markets.
  • Create alignment between national account objectives and local execution plans.
  • Partner with local and regional sales teams to identify, prioritize, and pursue growth opportunities, develop account penetration strategies, and convert enterprise relationships into field-level revenue opportunities.
  • Facilitate collaboration between customer stakeholders, field sales teams, operations leaders, and support resources to drive successful expansion initiatives.
  • Work cross-functionally across Smart Care and affiliate companies to capitalize on growth opportunities and deliver a seamless customer experience.

Customer Success & Operational Excellence

  • Provide strategic guidance to operations teams to ensure compliance with customer requirements, service-level agreements, and performance expectations.
  • Work cross-functionally to resolve customer concerns, manage escalations, and implement solutions that improve customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Analyze customer feedback, operational performance, and service metrics to identify continuous improvement opportunities.
  • Navigate customer and third-party technology platforms, including facilities management and procurement systems, while coordinating support from internal teams as needed.
  • Drive organizational alignment and communication to ensure successful execution of customer commitments and strategic initiatives.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of success in Strategic Account Management, National Accounts, Enterprise Sales, Business Development, Facilities Management, or related customer-facing leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated success managing multi-million-dollar national accounts.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth, contract renewals, and customer expansion within enterprise organizations.
  • Experience leading complex negotiations and multi-year service agreements.
  • Demonstrated success selling solutions and negotiating agreements with executive, procurement, and operational decision-makers within large enterprise organizations.
  • Proven ability to drive results through influence in matrixed organizations without direct reporting authority.
  • Experience within Facilities Management, Food Equipment Service, Commercial Services, Building Services, Mechanical Services, HVAC, or related service industries preferred.
  • Deep understanding of the Facilities Management industry, including Integrated Facilities Management (IFM), self-perform service models, subcontracted service delivery models, maintenance management programs, and enterprise facility operations.
  • Existing relationships within major facilities management companies or similar organizations preferred.
  • Experience utilizing CRM, Microsoft 365, Business Intelligence platforms (Power BI, Sigma, or similar), AI-enabled productivity tools, and facilities management platforms such as ServiceChannel, Corrigo, FM Pilot, or related systems.
  • This position typically involves a mix of remote work, client visits, and attendance at industry conferences or company events. Travel required up to 50%.

Success Measures

The successful candidate will:

  • Achieve assigned revenue, retention, and profitability targets.
  • Increase share of wallet within strategic Facilities Management accounts.
  • Expand executive stakeholder relationships across assigned customers.
  • Generate qualified growth opportunities through collaboration with field sales and operations teams.
  • Develop and influence field-led pipeline and revenue growth within assigned strategic accounts.
  • Improve customer satisfaction and contract renewal performance.
  • Execute strategic account plans that drive measurable business growth.

Why Join Smart Care

  • Lead strategic relationships with some of the largest Facilities Management organizations in North America.
  • Directly influence company growth strategy and customer success.
  • Work alongside high-performing sales and operational leaders.
  • Grow your career with a rapidly expanding national service organization focused on innovation, technology, customer outcomes, and operational excellence.
  • Play a highly visible role influencing enterprise customer strategy, market expansion, and long-term company growth

About Smart Care

Smart Care is a national repair and service provider for commercial foodservice, refrigeration, and cold storage equipment. Our offering of comprehensive mechanical services includes hot side cooking equipment, stand-alone refrigeration, specialty coffee and beverage, complex rack refrigeration and HVAC.

Project Overview

The New York Climate Exchange is seeking a developer or small development team to build and/or customize a functional digital platform that enables users to submit, review, publish, browse and analyze an online repository including word documents, excel spreadsheets, presentations, and other file types. The platform is meant to facilitate content discovery. The contractor will be responsible for delivering a customized front-end platform as well as architecting the backend database with a structured submission schema that can be easily accessed by The New York Climate Exchange team. This will be a bespoke platform and is a key deliverable for a pilot project to develop a hub for climate tech knowledge sharing and exchange.

Key Deliverables

  • Design and build a clean, functional front-end platform that allows users to browse, search, and filter a repository of climate tech content. Architect a backend database with a structured submission schema that can be accessed by The New York Climate Exchange.

  • Integrate a submission portal with form fields, file support (including large files such as decks and videos), IP acknowledgement, and automated reviewer routing.

  • Implement a lightweight review routing workflow for internal administrators to track submission status, assign reviewers and permissions, and manage publication.

  • Add roles and permissions based on user type and ensure privacy on platform using secure login. Integrate a search (either tagging tools, or AI assisted) to be able to parse and browse content.

  • Outline recommendations for future development and maintenance of platform including rough cost estimates.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Experience building lightweight data platforms and web apps.

  • Ability to effectively collaborate and communicate with non-technical colleagues to describe your decision-making process, workflow, and work output.

  • Willingness to drive progress independently and iterate based on feedback.

  • Ability to design and build for future growth and integration of AI and to make recommendations for long-term technical roadmap.

  • Experience working with universities and familiarity with early-stage technologies, climate tech and startups is a plus.

Tentative Schedule of Deliverables

  • Month 1: Design the workflow and user experience by assessing sample content and developing a workplan and platform inclusions list. Platform inclusions list to include front-end platform, core library and repository of data (including PDF content, excel tables, among others), search and discovery/ submissions portal, and review workflow.

  • Month 2-3: After feedback from The Exchange team and project partners, build the front-end platform and back-end database.

  • Month 3-4: QA and testing with initial batch content; availability for periodic questions or tweaks.

  • Month 4-8: Very light engagement, on call if needed.

  • Month 8-10: Availability for further testing and tweaks as platform goes live, additional content is ingested and workflows are implemented. Deliver final set of recommendations for future build-out and maintenance.

Contract duration: 10 months total, anticipated kick off in August. Expected concentrated periods of availability (several hours per week) for the first 3 months and final 3 months with very light engagement in the months between.

Location: Remote, must be available to join occasional weekday meetings in ET time zone.

To apply please submit:

  1. Resume
  2. Portfolio showcasing relevant past projects
  3. Brief written project plan for how you would approach the scope, including flat-rate project cost.
Proposals should include a flat fixed-fee rate for the project (flat project total, NOT hourly rate). Additional context on the project and sample links can be provided upon request.

About The New York Climate Exchange:

The New York Climate Exchange is a nonprofit designed to accelerate climate solutions. By leveraging the perspectives of a cross-sector network of diverse partners and New York City’s global influence, The Exchange engages in cutting-edge research, delivers impactful education and training, hosts world-class convenings and scales climate technology solutions. The Exchange is developing a state-of-the-art climate campus on Governors Island that will bring climate scientists, educators, entrepreneurs and changemakers under one roof—sparking the collaborations and breakthrough ideas we need to build a sustainable future. Learn more at nyclimateexchange.org.

From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

Remote Work

The Review Nurse performs clinical medical record review and abstraction to support healthcare quality, compliance, and project requirements. jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: The Senior Data Modeler will design and govern the data architecture for unstructured knowledge assets across Bain's Knowledge Management (KM) ecosystem.
jobs.description:
The Senior Data Modeler will design and govern the data architecture for unstructured knowledge assets across Bain's Knowledge Management (KM) ecosystem. This role bridges data engineering discipline with KM domain expertise, translating raw unstructured content (documents, case files, informal knowledge captures, chat/email extracts, etc.) into well-defined, discoverable, and secure data products within Databricks Unity Catalog.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design logical and physical data models for unstructured and semi-structured content (documents, case artifacts, K-Slices, extracted knowledge fragments, metadata records) originating from KM pipelines such as case mining and informal knowledge capture workflows.

  • Define domain boundaries and ownership for data products — determining what constitutes a discrete, reusable data product versus a raw or intermediate asset.

  • Establish metadata standards and tagging taxonomies (content type, practice/domain, provenance, confidentiality, freshness, lineage) to ensure consistent classification across knowledge sources.

  • Assign and enforce security and sensitivity classifications on data products in line with firm data governance, privacy, and legal/risk requirements.

  • Register, document, and maintain data products in Databricks Unity Catalog, including schemas, access grants, lineage, and catalog-level metadata.

  • Partner with data engineers building Databricks pipelines to ensure ingestion, transformation, and storage patterns align to the modeled domain structure.

  • Collaborate with Knowledge Products, Research Products, and Architecture/Data/Technology stakeholders to align data product design with downstream consumption needs (e.g., surfacing in Sage/Glean, AI agent retrieval).

  • Support privacy and legal review processes by ensuring data products are classified and documented to enable timely sign-off.

  • Establish and document repeatable modeling standards/playbooks so future data products can be onboarded consistently as the KM platform scales.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in data modeling, data architecture, or information architecture, with meaningful exposure to unstructured or semi-structured data (not purely relational/transactional modeling).

  • Direct experience working in or adjacent to Knowledge Management, content management, or enterprise search domain — understands how documents, case files, or knowledge artifacts differ from standard transactional data.

  • Hands-on experience with a modern data catalog; Databricks Unity Catalog experience strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to define data domains and data product boundaries in a large, multi-stakeholder organization.

  • Practical knowledge of metadata management: tagging schemas, taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, or ontology design.

  • Understanding of data security/sensitivity classification frameworks and how they map to access control in a lakehouse environment.

  • Experience partnering with data engineering teams on ingestion and pipeline design (not required to write production pipeline code, but must speak the language).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to translate technical modeling decisions into business-readable rationale for KM stakeholders and governance reviewers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with enterprise knowledge platforms (e.g., Glean, SharePoint, ServiceNow) or AI-powered retrieval systems.

  • Familiarity with Databricks Delta Lake, Delta Sharing, or Lakehouse Federation.

  • Prior experience in professional services, consulting, or a similar document/case-intensive knowledge environment.

  • Exposure to Legal/Risk/Privacy review processes for data classification and access approvals.

  • Background in library science, information science, or applied ontology is a plus but not required.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Industry Subject Matter Expert
jobs.excerpt: At peopleworth, we support work where people and performance thrive.
jobs.description:
At peopleworth, we support work where people and performance thrive. As part of our Employer Group, we work with a variety of forward-thinking partners and are excited to share this opportunity that sits within our growing group.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Industry Subject Matter Expert to contribute practitioner expertise to the enhancement of an established professional digital marketing learning programme.

This is a remote contract role covering approximately 30 working days between September and January. The focus is not on teaching or rewriting academic content. Instead, the successful candidate will act as a practitioner authority, working closely with learning designers and academic contributors to ensure that applied activities, worked examples, assessments, supporting materials, and the use of AI reflect how digital marketing is genuinely practised today.

The role requires someone who can translate current industry practice into credible learning experiences, identify the difference between competent and high-quality professional work, and help ensure consistency in applied standards across multiple areas of the programme.

Requirements

  • Substantial current, hands-on professional experience in digital marketing across areas such as strategy, channels, campaign development, execution, optimisation, and measurement.
  • Deep and current subject matter expertise, with the professional credibility to act as a practitioner authority on contemporary digital marketing practice.
  • Demonstrated ability to distinguish strong professional work from work that is merely competent, and to explain that difference clearly to people who may not be marketing specialists.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing strategy, customer journeys, campaign planning, channel selection, content, performance measurement, experimentation, optimisation, and commercial decision-making.
  • Practical experience using generative AI and other emerging tools within digital marketing workflows, with the ability to critically evaluate output and apply professional judgement to improve the result.
  • Experience reviewing, developing, or contributing to professional content such as case studies, assessment briefs, worked examples, learning materials, capability frameworks, or industry guidance would be advantageous.
  • Ability to review existing materials for accuracy, credibility, relevance, consistency, and alignment with current industry practice.
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to translate complex professional judgement into concise, practical, and usable guidance.
  • Confidence collaborating with learning designers, academic contributors, senior stakeholders, and other subject matter specialists.
  • The judgement and diplomacy to present a practitioner perspective clearly, including where professional practice and academic perspectives may differ.
  • Demonstrated ability to work productively within established curriculum, project, and content constraints rather than requiring a blank-slate approach.
  • Experience mentoring, developing, assessing, or evaluating marketing professionals would be advantageous.
  • Experience across both B2C and B2B digital marketing environments would be advantageous.
  • Previous experience leading a marketing team, contributing to professional education, or maintaining a recognised professional profile through speaking, writing, mentoring, or advisory work would be advantageous.

    Key Responsibilities
  • Work collaboratively with learning designers to translate established curriculum frameworks into applied learning content that accurately reflects contemporary professional practice.
    Review and contribute to existing storyboards, learning materials, activities, assessment briefs, case studies, and worked examples, ensuring they remain current, credible, and grounded in real digital marketing practice.
  • Participate in collaborative design and review sessions with academic contributors and learning specialists to refine the sequencing, applied scope, practitioner expectations, and intended outcomes of learning activities.
  • Act as a practitioner authority when reviewing learning materials, providing guidance on accuracy, credibility, professional relevance, and alignment with current digital marketing standards.
  • Develop and refine practical source material, worked examples, case studies, activity guidance, and assessment content that demonstrate how experienced marketers approach real-world decisions and challenges.
  • Advise on assessment design, including what remains valuable to assess as digital tools and generative AI increasingly support the production of first drafts and routine marketing outputs.
  • Define and articulate the difference between technically competent work and strong practitioner work, helping translate professional judgement into clear assessment criteria and learner guidance.
  • Develop practical guidance for the appropriate use of AI within digital marketing activities, including how marketers should evaluate, challenge, refine, contextualise, and improve AI-generated outputs.
  • Record concise practical walkthroughs demonstrating how an experienced digital marketer approaches selected tasks, tools, decisions, or workflows.
  • Provide practitioner insight into the realities of digital marketing work, including common mistakes, trade-offs, constraints, decision points, and factors that influence successful outcomes.
  • Review proposed changes to learning activities and advise where simplifying or removing content may save learner time but reduce the strength of an intended professional outcome.
  • Maintain consistency in practitioner expectations, terminology, applied examples, assessment standards, and professional relevance across the different areas of the programme.
  • Participate in selected discussions with senior academic and learning stakeholders where a practitioner perspective is required, communicating recommendations clearly and constructively.
  • Contribute expert insight to knowledge-sharing or related learning activities where specialist practitioner input is required.
  • Work effectively within established curriculum boundaries and existing materials, identifying where subject matter expertise can add the greatest value without unnecessarily redesigning content outside the agreed scope.

Benefits

  • Collaborative, people-centred performance culture.
  • Opportunities to contribute specialist expertise in a fast-paced, intellectually engaging environment.
  • The opportunity to apply current industry knowledge to the development of professional learning experiences.
  • Remote contract structure with work spread across the agreed project period.

Our Recruitment Process

The peopleworth Employer Group follows a fair, transparent, and multi-stage recruitment process designed to ensure mutual fit.

  1. Application Submission: Complete the online form and answer brief application questions.
  2. Initial Screening: Your application is reviewed for role alignment; successful candidates move to the longlist.
  3. Video Interview Stage: You’ll be invited to record short responses to 3–4 role-specific questions.
  4. Live Interviews: Shortlisted candidates join first-round interviews (and, where applicable, second or third rounds depending on the role).
  5. Final Shortlist & Verification: Reference and background checks are completed.
  6. Offer & Contracting: Successful candidates receive formal offers and contract documents.
  7. Pre-boarding & Onboarding: Once accepted, you’ll complete a pre-boarding process before officially joining your employing organisation within the Employer Group.

Throughout every stage, we value clear communication, respectful engagement, and timely feedback.

Job Description

IHME has an outstanding opportunity for a Managing Research Scientist to join their team.

About this Opportunity

Reporting to Faculty Team Leader, the Managing Research Scientist is responsible for the following: As a Managing Research Scientist, you will independently perform quantitative analyses, contribute to research design and dissemination, and supervise members on your research team. You will be responsible for managing the scope, timeline, and resources required to deliver high-quality study results, while coordinating with collaborating research sites and partners.

We are looking for someone to join a new initiative within the Program in Cardiovascular Health Metrics focused on heart disease in women. The project links gold-standard clinical registry data with large-scale administrative datasets to investigate the burden of coronary microvascular disease burden and its risk factors. This position is contingent on project funding

Key Responsibilities

Supervisory Responsibilities: 20%

  • Supervise employees to include hiring and training, leading workflow; priority setting; reviewing work and establishing quality standards; conducting regular performance assessments, providing mentorship and professional development for employees, and making recommendations for disciplinary action as needed.
  • Identify training needs and opportunities for team members to grow their skills and advance their careers; Ensure that the team has the necessary resources to complete their tasks effectively.
  • Promote positive morale and positive progress towards objectives across the team; lead effective and efficient team meetings that are structured, inclusive of consultation and constructive feedback, and result in identifiable next steps for team members.
  • Keep team members motivated and engaged, recognizing their achievements, and addressing any issues that may affect morale.
  • Monitor individual and team performance, providing feedback, and helping to resolve any performance issues; assist the team in overcoming obstacles, making decisions, and resolving conflicts.
  • Ensure that the team adheres to company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Attend required trainings about team leadership, management, and related topics as designated by team and organizational leaders.

Project Management: 20%

  • Define, scope, and document the work for the assigned research project to deliver timely, high-quality results.
  • Identify key priorities while balancing competing project objectives; propose work-plan adjustments, and proactively raise risks to delivery along with recommendations for mitigation.
  • Set and meet deadlines for the project team and for direct reports; maintain central tracking mechanisms to communicate progress on research outputs to internal and external stakeholders.

Research Dissemination 60%

  • Independently carry out quantitative analyses, including person-level longitudinal data analysis, interpret and vet results from your own results and from other team members, formulate conclusions, and inform team leaders.
  • Develop and implement new computational and statistical methods. Write, test, and maintain code in R, the primary language for the team’s analytic pipelines; experience with Python as a second language is a plus. Maintain, modify, and execute analytic machinery that generates results.
  • Contribute to research design and identify innovative solutions to issues.
  • Draft presentations and manuscripts and contribute to funding proposals. Lead and co-author scientific articles in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Maintain scientific awareness and intellectual agility with data, methods, and analytic techniques; manage and anticipate change and guide others to adapt effectively in the iterative research process.
  • Grow a peer network where sought out as having solid command of disease and risk factor modelling methods, key indicators, and the related data sources and scientific underpinnings.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.

Minimum Qualifications

Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Department.

  • Master’s degree in public health, epidemiology, statistics, biostatistics, math, economics, quantitative social sciences, or related discipline plus four years’ related experience.

Additional Qualifications

  • Previous supervisory experience with hiring, developing employees, priority setting, setting quality standards, and performance coaching.
  • Excellent analytic, critical thinking, and quantitative disease modelling skills.
  • Intermediate knowledge of and experience with project management methods, including scoping work, setting deadlines, and tracking and reporting progress for self and supervisees.
  • Results- and detail-oriented; initiate and complete tasks under tight deadlines and changing priorities both independently and in a team environment.
  • Experience devising and executing statistical modeling techniques.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly recognize problems in results, identify root causes in data, methods, and code, and implement solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency in designing, executing, and troubleshooting code in R.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills required, including track record of success in co-authorship on multiple scientific papers, presenting results, and representing research at meetings.
  • Demonstrated ability to contribute to and sustain collaborations with external research teams, and to coordinate work across interdependent teams.
  • Experience in working with large datasets, including devising strategies for reliable data management, computationally efficient modeling techniques, and critical evaluation of highly multidimensional model outputs.
  • Experience with small-area or geospatial epidemiologic models.
  • Ability to work both independently and in collaboration with a team.
