jobs.excerpt: Job Description A bit about this role: At Devoted, our mission is to dramatically improve the health and well-being of our members by treating each of them like family.
jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

At Devoted, our mission is to dramatically improve the health and well-being of our members by treating each of them like family. Getting a member’s record right is part of that promise. When we carry the wrong primary payer, miss a hospice election, or have a stale address on file, the member feels it before it shows up in a report. Doing this work well is an important part of making sure members can rely on us for the care they need

We are seeking a leader to serve as the Director of Membership Status Operations. This role owns the member status conditions that determine what CMS and our state partners pay us once enrollment is complete,along with the reconciliation and controls that make those determinations reliable. The role pairs regulatory expertise with financial and operational discipline, managing these conditions as a dynamic portfolio in which an undetected or late determination can create downstream disruption for the member and keep us from delivering the seamless experience we expect.

Membership Operations has built real capability in reconciliation: confirming that every member we are responsible for is enrolled correctly and at the right effective date and rate given the information available at point of application. You will own the next stage of that work. Several of these areas are still immature, and your first job is to be honest about which ones and to build the durable, monitored, auditable operation they require. The objective is accuracy in both directions — payment that reflects the member’s true status, whether that means we are owed more or owe money back. You will directly engage with AI-enabled tools to optimize signal detection, document review, and investigation triage.

This is foundational work - and there is a meaningful opportunity for this leader to leave their fingerprints all over how we do it.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

Member Status Determinations

  • Own the end-to-end operation for each area: from identifying a potential issue, to investigating it, making the right determination, submitting any required updates, checking the work for accuracy, and making sure any follow-up action gets completed.

  • Manage these areas with clear daily and weekly checks so we catch important status changes as they happen, rather than finding them after the fact.

  • Take direct ownership of the workflows that are not yet mature, and prioritize improvements based on member impact, financial risk, and compliance risk - not just what is easiest to fix.

  • Keep the operation current with CMS technical guidance, including Medicare Secondary Payer rules, hospice and ESRD payment treatment, and county-based rate structures.

  • Maintain the policies that define what makes a suspect, what evidence substantiates a determination, and how it is documented, so any determination can be reproduced on demand for a CMS program audit, state review, or internal audit. Report accuracy misses that reduce revenue with the same rigor as those that increase it.

  • Use AI and other tools to make these workflows more efficient, including identifying potential issues earlier and reducing manual review where it makes sense.

  • Set, monitor, and enforce SLAs and KPIs across internal teams, offshore partners, and external vendors.

Reconciliation and Controls

  • Define and deliver the KPIs that measure the operation — detection coverage, open inventory aging, signal-to-determination cycle time, rework, retroactive adjustment rates — and make them visible in executive-facing dashboards alongside recovered and at-risk revenue and outstanding variances.

  • Run expected-vs-actual analysis to flag macro-level payment degradation early and direct remediation to the conditions driving it.

  • Convert manual detection and correction into documented, owned controls with defined thresholds, aging limits, and escalation paths, so the operation does not depend on individual heroics or tribal knowledge.

  • Partner with Data Science and Engineering to identify key measurement points and prioritize platform improvements, writing the business cases and holding delivery partners to committed outcomes.

  • Work closely with Finance, Actuarial, Risk Adjustment, Compliance, and Legal to make sure the work is accurate, well documented, and ready for review — and to help partners understand the impact of issues when they arise.

  • Build, develop, and retain the team, and bring an end-to-end perspective to policy and procedure decisions across Membership Operations.

Required skills and experience:

  • Proven operator with a track record of turning complex operational problems into scalable, practical business processes.

  • Demonstrated experience building operational controls where none existed, not only running a mature process at scale.

  • Proven ability to take new cross-functional initiatives from idea to launch across multiple stakeholder groups.

  • Able to digest intricate regulatory or technical guidance and translate it into determination criteria, evidence standards, and daily workflow.

  • Fluency working with data: you can specify requirements, interrogate a dataset, and challenge a number without waiting for analyst support.

  • High ethical standards and sound judgment under revenue pressure, including the willingness to surface and correct an error that goes against our financial interest.

  • Comfortable owning an ambitious goal in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment — you own the determinations, the standards, the controls, and the roadmap, and you build the case when the work needs new investment.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience managing multiple teams and vendors, including offshore partners.

  • Prior experience in Medicare Advantage, D-SNP, or integrated Medicare-Medicaid experience, including state file reconciliation and deeming administration.

  • Experience operating under CMS program audit or comparable regulatory examination.

  • Proven organizational, communication, and leadership skills.

Remote with onsite expectations multiple times per year.

Salary Range: $182,000-$216,000 / year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

jobs.title: Operations Manager - Medium Voltage
jobs.excerpt: Ameresco, Inc.  (NYSE:AMRC) is a leading energy solutions provider dedicated to helping customers reduce costs, enhance resilience, and decarbonize to net zero in the global energy transition.
jobs.description:
Ameresco, Inc. (NYSE:AMRC) is a leading energy solutions provider dedicated to helping customers reduce costs, enhance resilience, and decarbonize to net zero in the global energy transition. We are a trusted, full-service partner to public sector and government entities, K-12 schools, higher education, utilities, and healthcare customers across the U.S., Canada, the U.K., and Europe.

At Ameresco, we show the way by developing, constructing and operating tailored smart energy efficiency solutions, distributed energy resources, and infrastructure upgrades that drive cost savings, resilience, decarbonization, and innovation. Our comprehensive portfolio is built to address the challenges of today and adapt the future, ensuring long-term sustainability and success for our customers.

The Operations Manager – Medium Voltage is a newly created position and the first hire for Ameresco's Medium Voltage Operations & Maintenance Department. This role is responsible for building the department from the ground up, including hiring and developing crews, establishing operating procedures, and managing day-to-day execution across the company's national Solar PV and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) portfolio. The Operations Manager – Medium Voltage will lead the phased internalization of medium voltage preventative and corrective maintenance work currently performed by third-party contractors, with a goal of internalizing 95–100% of this scope over five years. This individual will also serve as Ameresco's internal subject matter expert for all things medium voltage, including oversight of third-party MV subcontractors performing work not yet internalized. This position reports directly to the Senior Director of Operations and holds accountability for department.

This is a Remote position, but preferably the candidate will live in the Northeast to provide adequate coverage of Ameresco's Medium Voltage projects.

Responsibilities:

Department Buildout & Strategy

  • Lead the phased hiring plan from the initial three-person crew through the full 21-person department over five years.

  • Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Method of Procedures (MOPs), Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), and quality management systems for all medium voltage work types.

  • Manage the phased transition of medium voltage work from third-party contractors to internal crews, ensuring no degradation in client service levels.

  • Develop and manage relationships with preferred third-party MV contractors retained for surge capacity and specialty work.

Subcontractor Management & Technical Oversight

  • Serve as Ameresco's internal subject matter expert for all things medium voltage, providing technical guidance to Operations, Asset Management, and field teams.

  • Manage and evaluate the performance of third-party MV subcontractors performing work not yet internalized, including scope, quality, and responsiveness.

  • Remotely review and assess subcontractor-reported issues, testing reports, and deliverables (e.g., DGA results, relay test reports, infrared scans, cable test results) to validate findings and identify discrepancies.

  • Make professional recommendations on next steps based on subcontractor findings, including repair versus replace decisions, escalation of critical issues, and prioritization of corrective action.

  • Serve as the technical point of escalation for complex or ambiguous MV issues identified by internal crews or subcontractors.

Operations Management

  • Oversee scheduling, dispatch, and execution of all medium voltage preventative maintenance (PM) and corrective maintenance (CM) service requests nationwide.

  • Ensure compliance with OSHA, NFPA 70E, and site-specific safety and regulatory requirements across all crews and regions.

  • Manage crew travel logistics and regional coverage optimization as the department expands from the Eastern and Mid-Atlantic region to nationwide coverage.

  • Own all department Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) (see Measures of Success).

  • Maintain accurate, timely records of all work orders, inspections, findings, and recommendations within Ameresco's CMMS platform, AssetPlanner.

Inventory Management

  • Perform initial onboarding and quarterly review of all operating MV equipment across Ameresco-owned and client-owned projects to identify critical MV spare parts required to support system operation.

  • Source, procure, and stock components which are common across the fleet

  • Update IMS

  • Safety & Compliance

  • Establish and enforce a zero-tolerance safety culture across all crews, targeting zero recordable incidents.

  • Conduct quarterly safety reviews and unannounced field PPE and lockout/tagout (LOTO) compliance audits.

  • Ensure all technicians maintain current certifications, PPE compliance, and training requirements.

Training & Development

  • Design and manage the department's training roadmap in partnership with AVO Training Institute, SEL University, and OEM training providers.

  • Oversee the structured apprenticeship program, including required on-the-job training hours for advancement.

  • Conduct annual skills matrix assessments and competency evaluations across all technician tiers.

  • Develop succession plans and mentor Lead Technicians and other high-potential team members to build a leadership pipeline within the department.

Financial Management

  • Own the department's annual operating budget.

  • Track and report third-party cost avoidance and net savings against the department's financial plan.

  • Manage fleet, tooling, and consumable budgets, including vehicle procurement and replacement planning.

  • Additional Duties

  • Participate in or oversee an on-call rotation to support 24/7 emergency corrective maintenance response, including availability on weekends and holidays as needed.

  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Senior Director of Operations.

The anticipated salary range for this role is $111,000-$161,500 per year (presented in good faith). In addition to base pay, employees receive a comprehensive benefits package, such as health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off, and may be eligible for performance incentives, bonuses, commissions, or equity, depending on the role.

Actual pay will depend on factors such as internal equity, skills, experience, education, certifications, and location. This range supports our commitment to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. Compensation may vary by work location, including remote arrangements.

We disclose salary ranges and benefits in all required external and internal postings and will provide further details upon request at any stage of the hiring process. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

Ameresco challenges the brightest, most talented, and creative individuals in the industry by providing an environment that fosters initiative and achievement. We are proud of our comprehensive and competitive employee benefits, including people-oriented insurance, investment, and incentive plans.

All official communications from Ameresco will originate from an @ameresco.com email address. Any correspondence from other domains should be regarded as fraudulent. Please report any suspicious activity to the platform where the issue was encountered. For further inquiries or concerns, please contact us at 1-866-AMERESCO

Ameresco is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

  • Develop future leaders and technical SMEs.
  • Establish a culture focused on customer value, innovation, accountability, quality, and commercial performance.
  • Balance utilization, employee development, and business growth.
  • Promote collaboration across Sales, Delivery, Technology, Quality, and other business functions.

5. Innovation & Digital Transformation

  • Define the organization's Manufacturing Informatics innovation roadmap.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, analytics, digital twins, cloud technologies, and intelligent manufacturing.
  • Develop reusable accelerators, frameworks, and intellectual property.

    • Manufacturing deviation analysis
    • Manufacturing knowledge assistants
    • Electronic batch record intelligence
    • Process analytics
    • Predictive maintenance
    • Manufacturing data contextualization
    • Automated documentation
    • Manufacturing investigation support
  • Ensure emerging technologies are evaluated for business value, cybersecurity, GxP compliance, data integrity, and operational risk.

6. Financial & Business Management

  • Own or contribute to the Manufacturing Informatics P&L.
  • Establish and manage revenue, bookings, margin, utilization, and profitability targets.
  • Develop annual operating plans and budgets.
  • Monitor sales pipeline, backlog, revenue forecast, and resource demand.
  • Drive improvements in gross margin and delivery efficiency.
  • Evaluate investments in people, technology, partnerships, and accelerators based on ROI.
  • Provide regular business performance updates to executive leadership.

Key Performance Indicators

Success in this role will be measured through a balanced set of commercial, operational, and customer metrics, including:

Growth

  • Revenue growth
  • New bookings
  • Sales pipeline and pipeline coverage
  • New logo acquisition
  • Existing account expansion
  • Average deal size

Profitability

  • Gross margin
  • EBITDA / contribution margin
  • Revenue realization
  • Delivery productivity
  • Resource utilization

Customer

  • Customer satisfaction / NPS

  • Account penetration

  • Referenceable customers

Requirements

  • 15+ years of experience in Manufacturing Informatics, MES, Digital Manufacturing, Life Sciences IT, Manufacturing IT, or related consulting/services environments.
  • Demonstrated experience working with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other regulated manufacturing organizations.
  • Significant experience in MES/EBR and manufacturing digital transformation.
  • Proven track record in business development and consultative selling.
  • Experience managing large and complex manufacturing technology programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and manage senior customer relationships.
  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams and global delivery models.
  • Experience with financial management, forecasting, utilization, margins, and P&L/business-unit management is strongly preferred.

Preferred Technical Knowledge

jobs.description:
At MyFitnessPal, we believe good health starts with what you eat. We provide tools, resources and support to enable users to reach their health goals.

We are looking for a Security Engineer II with a focus on Application Security to join the MyFitnessPal Security team. Our users rely on MyFitnessPal to power their health and fitness journeys every day, and you will leverage your technical skills to secure the code, applications, and development processes that create the MyFitnessPal product experience. In addition to technical expertise, you'll find that your teammates value collaboration, mentorship, and inclusive environments.

About the team:

The Productivity Engineering: Automation & Self-Service (PEAS) team is responsible for the automation, CI/CD, and self-service platforms that product teams rely on to build, test, and ship features quickly and safely.

The PEAS team is part of the Technology Operations (TechOps) organization, which includes IT, Infrastructure, Security, Reliability, and DevOps/DevEx disciplines. TechOps seeks to enable MyFitnessPal to "ship with confidence" by delivering a secure, reliable, and low-friction runway to build and operate software at scale. Within TechOps, you'll represent the Security discipline — protecting the applications and development processes that keep our mobile and backend software safe for millions of users.

Essential Duties:

As a Security Engineer II, you will own the day-to-day operation of our application security vulnerability management program and act as a trusted security partner to product engineering teams. You'll triage what our tooling and researchers find, drive it to remediation, and build the automation that makes the whole program run with less manual effort. This is a hands-on technical position with real ownership and substantial opportunity for growth.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own day-to-day application security vulnerability management: triage findings from SAST, SCA, DAST, and mobile security tooling, assign severity and due dates, propose remediations, and drive tickets through our SVM process to resolution
  • Operate and grow our bug bounty program — scoping engagements, triaging researcher submissions, validating findings, and coordinating with vendors
  • Leverage AI and agentic tooling (for example, Claude Code and agentic pipelines) to accelerate security workflows — from vulnerability triage and enrichment to automated remediation support — and help ensure our AI-assisted development practices remain secure
  • Build and maintain security automation (for example, in our SOAR platform and with Python) that normalizes vulnerability intake, drives notifications and SLAs, and produces the metrics and reporting that keep the program transparent
  • Partner with product engineering teams on remediation — joining triage and refinement discussions, answering questions, and representing security as a business enabler rather than a blocker
  • Perform security reviews of new features, services, and third-party integrations, providing pragmatic, risk-based guidance
  • Advocate secure coding practices and contribute to developer-facing security documentation and training
  • Administer and tune application security tooling across the SDLC, and help evaluate and implement new security technology
  • Support identity and access management workflows and the automation behind them

Qualifications to be successful in this role:

  • 2-4 years of experience in security engineering, application security, software engineering, or a closely related role
  • Understanding of application security assessment techniques (e.g., SAST, DAST, SCA, penetration testing) and the steps to remediate findings
  • Knowledge of secure development practices for web and mobile applications (e.g., OWASP Top 10, OWASP MASVS)
  • Experience working with AI/agentic-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude Code or similar AI coding assistants, LLM-powered workflows, or agentic automation) and enthusiasm for applying it to security work
  • Experience performing security triage, investigation, and vulnerability management, including communicating findings and remediation guidance to engineers
  • Familiarity with auto-scaling cloud microservices and associated technologies (e.g., containerization, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code)
  • Strong communication skills, enabling collaboration across cross-functional teams, and the judgment to raise a security finding and land it as a shared problem to solve, not a fight to win
  • Ability to create documentation that describes technical details clearly, including for non-technical audiences
  • Ability & desire to learn new product lines and technologies quickly & efficiently
  • Education and/or certifications equivalent to BS in Computer Science or IS related field; GIAC (e.g., GWEB, GCIH), OSCP, CSSLP, Security+, or vendor-specific certifications are a plus

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience automating security processes (e.g., Python, SOAR platforms, workflow automation) is strongly preferred
  • Experience with security scanning in CI/CD pipelines and orchestration tools (e.g., GitHub Actions) is a plus
  • Experience operating or triaging for a bug bounty program is a plus

Values you’ll model

  • Be Kind and Care — build with empathy; assume positive intent; support teammates and members.
  • Live Good Health — champion healthy habits and balance in how we work and what we ship.
  • Be Data-Inspired — ground decisions in research and data; measure what matters.
  • Champion Change — lean into ambiguity; iterate, learn, and improve continuously.
  • Leave it Better than You Found It — raise quality, clarify systems, and document as you go.
  • Make It Happen — bias to action; deliver impact with craft and accountability.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★
QuickBooks Financial Controller
Location: Remote — Canada, Central America, South America, or Europe
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
Industry: Interior Design / Professional Services
Compensation:$2,000 – $4,000 USD/month
English Proficiency:C1/C2 English Required
Schedule: Full-Time | Required overlap with U.S. business hours
Reports To: CFO


About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based luxury interior design firm specializing in bespoke, high-end environments that combine exceptional design, craftsmanship, functionality, and personalized client service.
The company is strengthening its internal finance operations and is looking for an experienced accounting professional who can bring the same level of precision and attention to detail to its financial function.
About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished QuickBooks Financial Controller with deep, hands-on QuickBooks expertise to take ownership of the company's accounting operations.
Reporting directly to the CFO, you will have full responsibility for the General Ledger, lead the transition from an outside accounting firm to a fully in-house accounting function, manage monthly close and reconciliations, prepare financial reporting, and oversee the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable team.
QuickBooks expertise is essential for this position. This role requires more than day-to-day usage. You must be comfortable configuring and optimizing QuickBooks and have experience with QuickBooks implementations.
This is a hands-on position for someone who is highly accurate, independent, comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment, and willing to support operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting when needed.
Why This Opportunity?
  • Take full ownership of the company's accounting operations and General Ledger.
  • Become the internal QuickBooks expert for the organization.
  • Work directly with the CFO and play a key role in strengthening the finance function.
  • Lead the transition from outsourced accounting to a fully in-house operation.
  • Manage and improve accounting processes, controls, and reporting.
  • Work remotely with significant autonomy and responsibility.
What You'll Do
QuickBooks & General Ledger
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks to support the company's accounting structure and reporting requirements.
  • Lead or support QuickBooks configuration and implementation initiatives.
  • Lead the transition of the General Ledger from an outside accounting firm to an in-house function.
  • Maintain, reconcile, and close the books monthly.
  • Establish and maintain the Chart of Accounts and appropriate classification standards.
Financial Reporting & Cash Management
  • Prepare accurate financial statements across the company's business divisions.
  • Prepare and review Profit & Loss (P&L) statements.
  • Oversee bank reconciliations.
  • Monitor the company's cash position.
  • Maintain accurate and reliable financial information for CFO review.
Team Leadership & Client Support
  • Supervise Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable specialists.
  • Review and approve invoices, hours reports, and client statements before distribution.
  • Review and approve payroll, vendor payments, and expense submissions.
  • Interface with clients regarding accounting-related requests when required.
  • Ensure accounting work completed by the team meets established standards.
  • Support operational and non-accounting matters that may arise within a small-team environment.
Tax & Accounting Controls
  • Coordinate payroll tax, sales tax, and 1099-related matters.
  • Execute accounting policies established by the CFO accurately and consistently.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a high standard of accuracy.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Prior experience as a Financial Controller, Senior Accountant, or similar senior accounting professional with full ownership of the General Ledger.
  • Advanced, hands-on QuickBooks expertise.
  • Professional experience with QuickBooks Online and/or QuickBooks Desktop.
  • Experience configuring QuickBooks and/or leading a QuickBooks implementation.
  • Strong experience managing the General Ledger, reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Experience preparing financial statements and P&L reports.
  • Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts structures and accounting classifications.
  • Experience overseeing or working closely with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistently low error rates.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to execute accounting policies and procedures with precision.
  • Comfortable supporting operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting.
  • C1/C2 English proficiency, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to work with required overlap during U.S. business hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience transitioning an accounting function from an external accounting firm to an in-house team.
  • Experience with BigTime or similar project accounting software.
  • Previous experience in professional services, interior design, architecture, construction, or project-based businesses.
  • Experience supervising accounting or bookkeeping professionals.
How Success Is Measured
Success in this position will be measured by your ability to:
  • Maintain an accurate and reliable General Ledger.
  • Independently execute reconciliations and month-end close.
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks according to business requirements.
  • Successfully support the transition to an in-house accounting function.
  • Deliver accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a consistently low error rate.
  • Effectively oversee AP and AR activities.
  • Work independently while executing CFO policies accurately.
  • Communicate professionally with U.S.-based colleagues and clients.
Video Presentation Required
As part of your application, please submit a short video in English introducing yourself and briefly summarizing your accounting background, followed by a 30-second to 1-minute overview of your QuickBooks experience, including how many years you have used it professionally, whether you have worked with QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop, your main responsibilities in the system, and any experience configuring QuickBooks or leading an implementation.
Why Join Us?
  • $2,000 – $4,000 USD/month, based on experience and location.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Direct exposure to the CFO and company leadership.
  • Significant ownership of the accounting function.
  • Opportunity to lead an important financial operations transition.
  • Long-term, full-time contractor opportunity.
  • Short initial trial period to ensure mutual fit.
Important Notes
Advanced QuickBooks expertise is a core requirement for this position. Basic familiarity, occasional use, or self-taught exposure without substantial professional experience will not be sufficient.
Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain their years of QuickBooks experience, versions used, responsibilities within the system, experience running monthly close, and any QuickBooks configuration or implementation experience.
C1/C2 English is mandatory. The role operates entirely in English with a U.S.-based team and, at times, directly with clients.
This is a permanent, full-time contractor opportunity with a short initial trial period.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

Dental Insurance Specialist Position Summary

As part of our Dental Billing Services (DBS) team, the Insurance Specialist will provide Revenue Cycle Management to dental practices across the country by completing client-elected services such as claim submission, claim follow up, payment posting, and benefit verification with data entry.

Why does this role matter?
DBS provides revenue cycle management for dental practices across the country, so this person has a direct hand in whether our clients get paid accurately and on time. Claim submission, follow-up, payment posting, and benefit verification are the work that keeps a practice financially healthy and doing that work well is a big reason clients stay with us. It's a client-facing role at the center of how DentalXChange simplifies the business of dentistry.

What impact will the new hire have in their first 6 months?
The new hire will start as an Insurance Specialist, learning the DXC core values, our client relationships, and systems. Most importantly, they will learn how we deliver excellence daily, across all scopes of our services which impact our client experience. They will then move into an Account Manager role , where they own the client relationship, oversee the accuracy and timeliness of the work on their accounts, and deliver the monthly ROI reporting and Quarterly Business Reviews that our clients count on. By month six they should be the trusted point of contact for their book of accounts, helping onboard new clients, run audits, and bring newer team members up to speed.

What's the growth trajectory for this position?
Growth is built into the role. The Insurance Specialist role moves to an Account Manager role within a couple of months rather than after a year of tenure.

What You'll Be Doing As Our Dental Insurance Specialist

  • In serving our dental practice clients, complete a variety of dental services within multiple dental practice management software while maintaining PHI and HIPAA standards. Services may include claim submission, claim follow up, payment posting, and benefit verification with data entry.
  • Manage day-to-day client communication and ongoing relationships as it relates to client satisfaction and retention, optimizing practice operations and enhancing profitability.
  • Document all work in forms, spreadsheets and client software, as outlined in our standards.
  • Contact insurance companies to obtain and record accurate and timely information.
  • Send daily summary of tasks completed to dental office staff.
  • Prepare and deliver monthly ROI statistics.
  • Consistently meet company and department policies and expectations including those surrounding attendance.

  • Proficient in all MS Office applications, fluid with technology, and use of the internet.

jobs.description:
TechOps Engineer - Senior

About the Role?

We're hiring a Senior TechOps Engineer to own the reliability, security, and automation backbone of our contact center technology platform. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role for someone who thinks architecturally, moves decisively, and takes genuine pride in the systems they build. You'll set the technical direction for our infrastructure, mentor a growing team, and be the person who prevents problems before they become incidents.

What do we do?

ACD Direct, Inc. is an innovative, virtual company that thrives on brokering solutions for our non-profit clients. ACD’s heartbeat and competitive edge is powered by our people. Our company has grown from providing routine call center services to providing high-level, full-scale donor support resources and products. Our proprietary scripting engine, web forms and custom-built reporting enable clients to successfully conduct large-scale fundraising campaigns with accuracy and creativity. ACD is a B2B Contact Center Technology company building and operating the infrastructure that keeps modern contact centers running at scale. Our platform is cloud-native, security-first, and built by a fully distributed team spread across the United States. We move fast, document everything, and treat operational excellence as a core value - not an afterthought.

Limitations:

Applicant preferred to be located within a 50 mile radius of Salt Lake City, Utah. Although position is remote employee will be required to visit data center on a quarterly basis. It is not required for the employee to be located in the state of Utah.

What will you do?

  • Design and implement robust CI/CD frameworks for serverless and containerized (Kubernetes/Docker) applications.
  • Lead the transition to fully versioned infrastructure - owning IaC strategy using Terraform, Pulumi, or Bicep to ensure environment parity and rapid recovery.
  • Own the availability, performance, and survivability of production environments; define and monitor SLOs/SLIs to maintain 99.9%+ uptime targets.
  • Serve as the primary owner of the organization's security posture - implement automated vulnerability scanning, IAM least-privilege policies, and audit logging for strict PCI DSS compliance.
  • Partner with QA and Software Engineering leads to embed DevSecOps practices into the early stages of the SDLC.
  • Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) for complex system failures and drive implementation of preventative automations to eliminate repeat incidents.
  • Architect and improve monitoring, alerting, and observability tooling across all production and non-production environments.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level TechOps engineers - conducting code/config reviews, sharing expertise, and contributing to team capability development.
  • Champion TechOps best practices across the team; set the documentation and process standards others follow.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate new technologies and deliver infrastructure roadmap items on time.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Systems Engineering.
  • Deep expertise with CI/CD pipelines and release automation across complex, multi-environment systems.
  • Strong cloud platform mastery (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - you can architect a solution and then build it.
  • Expert-level Kubernetes experience; comfortable designing and troubleshooting production container workloads.
  • Advanced IaC proficiency using Terraform, Pulumi, Bicep, or equivalent - you treat infrastructure like software.
  • Demonstrated experience owning PCI DSS compliance for a production environment.
  • Strong background in security engineering: IAM, vulnerability management, automated scanning, and audit logging.
  • Ability to define and track SLOs/SLIs and translate reliability data into infrastructure improvements.
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and raising the overall skill level of a team.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you can explain trade-offs to engineers and business stakeholders alike.
  • Self-directed and highly organized - thrives in a fully remote, async-first environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with contact center platforms (Genesys, Five9, Amazon Connect, Twilio, or similar).
  • Exposure to SMS/telecom infrastructure and carrier APIs.
  • Background in B2B SaaS or telecom infrastructure environments.
  • Contributions to open-source DevOps or infrastructure tooling.
  • Certifications in AWS, Azure, GCP, or Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD).

Leadership and Scope

As our Senior TechOps Engineer, you'll have broad scope and genuine ownership - not just execution tickets. You'll drive architectural decisions, define standards the rest of the team follows, and be an active voice in shaping our infrastructure roadmap. We're a lean team, which means your fingerprints will be on everything. That's a feature, not a bug. This role reports directly to the Technology Operations Manager and works closely with Engineering and Security leadership. You will be the go-to infrastructure authority for the organization.

How we will support you?

  • $86,000-100,000/yr depending on experience level

All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate based on any status protected under federal, state, or local law. We are a fully remote company. TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. This is a backend engineering internship on the systems that carry real product workflows. The work is a good fit for someone who enjoys correctness and reliability: designing a schema that will still make sense in six months, making a background job idempotent, or tracing a bad record back through three services to its source. Because the team is small, you will own services rather than tickets, and your work will be in production quickly.

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The University of Connecticut School of Social Work seeks qualified applicants to be hired as a Senior Public Policy Analyst (Research Associate I) to be part of the Innovations Institute at the University of Connecticut’s School of Social Work.

The position will be part of the School of Social Work’s growing portfolio of public policy, technical assistance, financing, and evaluation activities in partnership with local, state, and federal government agencies and organizations on behalf of children, youth, and families. Positions with Innovations Institute are fully remote with expected travel to UConn’s Hartford Campus twice annually. Innovations Institute will be hiring up to two (2) candidates.

The selected candidate(s) will apply knowledge, concepts, principles, and skills to multiple projects across the Innovations Institute. These projects will include working with federal, state, and/or local governments to support sustainable financing and integrated and customized policy approaches in public child- and family-serving systems. The senior public policy analyst(s) will engage in document and literature reviews; participate in and, depending on expertise, facilitate meetings, stakeholder interviews, and/or focus groups; prepare briefs, white papers, technical reports, presentations, and overview documents and analyses; and apply expert knowledge and skills related to public policy, financing, and implementation, particularly related to Medicaid financing and children’s behavioral health services.

The position is open for up to two senior public policy analysts who will work under the direction of Deborah Harburger, Assistant Extension Professor and Director of Policy and Financing at Innovations Institute. The selected candidate(s) may mentor or supervise other policy or program staff depending on qualifications. The selected candidate(s) is expected to collaborate across the Innovations Institute and the School of Social Work, as well as with consultants and organizations partnering with the Innovations Institute.

  • Apply senior, in-depth knowledge, concepts, principles, and skills related to public policy, financing, and implementation, including related to Medicaid State Plans, amendments, and waivers and federal policy document development.
  • Participate in and lead substantial portions of meetings, including with state and local leadership.
  • Draft and review meeting notes. Be responsible for key action steps and assist the team with implementing action steps.
  • Conduct or review cost-benefit analysis of proposed recommendations.
  • Monitor key changes in children’s behavioral health, Medicaid, child welfare, and juvenile justice policy at the local, state, and national levels.
  • Review literature and research on current behavioral health topics. Summarize key policy topics for consumption by peers, senior leadership, or external entities.
  • Prepare and review proposals and contracts for actions.

Write reports, white papers, position papers, briefs, presentations, strategies, toolkits, testimonies, legislation, regulations, policy directives, implementation guidance, and impact statements for internal and external audiences.

  • Work cooperatively with others and demonstrate professional, ethical, respectful, and courteous behavior when interacting with others. Comfortable with developing consensus across stakeholders.

  • Engage in and facilitate strategic planning, internally and with external stakeholders, to achieve short- and long-range planning goals.
  • Serve as an expert resource to others internally and externally.
  • Work on ambiguous matters generally without precedent or structure and independently develop standardization and protocol.
  • Edit reports, white papers, position papers, briefs, presentations, strategies, toolkits, testimonies, legislation, regulations, policy directives, implementation guidance, and impact statements for internal and external audiences.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert related to financing strategies and policy options.
  • Use substantial latitude in decision-making.
  • Set and monitor goals and objectives to align with the defined strategy.
  • Depart from traditional approaches to develop and present novel solutions.
  • Supervise other policy or program staff.
  • Present work to a variety of audiences, including work at meetings and academic conferences.
  • Co-author academic manuscripts in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Contribute to the development and writing of federal, state, and private grant proposals.
  • Perform other duties as needed.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated record of scholarship, including authoring or co-authoring high-quality reports, toolkits, and briefs related to public child- and family-serving systems.

Pandoblox is building the future of data consulting by leveraging an elite team of practitioners amplified by AI to deliver enterprise-quality data platforms (Signal OS) to mid-market companies.   • To be expert-level capabilities with dbt Core, building production projects from scratch, managing layers, and setting up automated testing frameworks.

jobs.description:
About Scale

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

About The Role

We're looking for a Regulatory Affairs Specialist to support compliance across our dietary supplement product lines. Reporting to the Regulatory Affairs Manager, you'll help ensure our labels, claims, and promotional materials meet FDA and FTC requirements — reviewing and interpreting regulatory standards, keeping documentation organized, and flagging risk before it reaches the market.

This is a hands-on, detail-driven role for someone who already knows their way around the dietary supplement space. You understand that claims have to be substantiated — that we can't just say things — and that supplements operate under real regulatory constraints. You'll work closely with Marketing, R&D, Product Development, and Quality as part of a small, high-trust regulatory team, with room to deepen your expertise over time.

What You'll Do

Claims & Promotional Review

  • Review and approve promotional materials — commercial scripts, social media content, email, and marketplace listings — for compliance with FDA and FTC standards.
  • Apply structure/function and advertising requirements to flag risky language and recommend compliant alternatives.
  • Help ensure product claims are properly supported before they go live.

Substantiation Support

  • Support the claims substantiation process by reviewing and organizing supporting evidence and maintaining substantiation records.
  • Understand and apply the "competent and reliable scientific evidence" standard to assess whether a claim is adequately backed.

Labeling, SOPs & Compliance

  • Review supplement labels to ensure packaging and ingredient disclosures meet applicable requirements.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining regulatory SOPs, processes, and internal guidance.
  • Conduct or assist with Serious Adverse Event Reporting (SAER) investigations and documentation.

Monitoring & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Monitor evolving FDA, FTC, and NAD developments — including warning letters and relevant industry litigation — and translate them into practical takeaways for the business.
  • Prepare and present industry updates at recurring team meetings (e.g., a monthly regulatory round-up), keeping cross-functional partners aware of what's happening and why it matters.
  • Partner with Marketing, R&D, Product Development, and Quality to provide practical regulatory guidance throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Manage the company’s trademark program: conduct initial trademark searches, maintain records, and coordinate with legal counsel for USPTO submissions.

Who You Are

You care about getting the details right, and you understand that good compliance protects the brand and the customer. You're a partner to the business, not a gatekeeper.

  • Detail-Oriented: You care about the details — because you know they add up to better, more trustworthy outcomes.
  • Clear Communicator: You express ideas clearly and make regulatory concepts easy to understand for non-regulatory teammates.
  • Organized & Deadline-Driven: You keep meticulous records and juggle competing priorities with ease, knowing that timely, well-organized documentation often gates product release.
  • Proactive: You anticipate needs, take ownership, and ask for support when needed.
  • Empowered Collaborator: You work across teams with trust and respect, and move projects forward through collective effort.

What You'll Need

  • 2–3 years of regulatory affairs experience in dietary supplements — this is our top priority. Not a first regulatory job, but not a senior-level tenure either.
  • A working understanding that product claims must be substantiated and that supplements operate under FDA and FTC regulation.
  • Experience reviewing labels and/or promotional materials for compliance.
  • Familiarity with DSHEA, 21 CFR Part 111, and structure/function claim basics.
  • Bachelor's degree in a life science, food science, or related field.

Preferred

  • Exposure to adjacent categories — cosmetics (MoCRA) or food/beverage — is a plus, though dietary supplement experience matters most.
  • DTC or eCommerce experience, including online marketplace (e.g., Amazon) compliance.
  • Comfort with quality or product documentation basics — reviewing specifications or Certificates of Analysis (COAs) and meeting the documentation timelines that gate product release.
  • Experience assisting with SOP development or regulatory process improvement.
  • Prior experience working within AI systems (Claude, Notion AI, etc.).

What We Offer

  • Salary: $75,000- $85,000
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Fully remote, full-time position
  • Monthly work-from-home stipend
  • Generous paid time off program
  • Discounted products
  • An amazing team to work alongside

Accounting Manager

Counterpart is the first Agentic Insurance™ platform, combining trusted insurance expertise with cutting-edge AI to deliver tailored management and professional liability solutions. By integrating Agentic Underwriting™, Agentic Broker Services™, Agentic Risk Mitigation™, Agentic Claims Management™, Agentic Coverage™, and Agentic Capacity™ into one powerful platform, Counterpart empowers brokers - and the businesses they serve - to do more with less risk. Backed by A rated carriers, Counterpart has been recognized by CB Insights as a 2025 “Top 50 Insurtech,” by Great Place to Work, and by Business Insurance as one of its 2025 “Best Places to Work.”

As Accounting Manager, you run the day-to-day financial operations within Agentic Finance - bordereau and premium reconciliation, carrier and claims payments, premium accounts receivable, accounts payable, expense management, financial reporting, audit administration, and tax filings - that keep Counterpart, Agentic Programs™, and Counterpart Insurance Company running. You own accounts receivable, accounts payable, expense management, and vendor administration outright, and you support the Controller on bordereau, carrier payment operations, audit administration, and financial reporting - with a path to taking ownership of bordereau and carrier payment operations as those processes stabilize. You build and run the agents that make this execution more efficient as the company scales. You report to the Controller.

YOU WILL:

Own Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Expense Management, and Vendor Administration

  • Own premium accounts receivable from brokers end-to-end - invoicing and installment billing, cash application against policies and endorsements, and aging and collections follow-up - so premium owed to Counterpart is collected on time and applied accurately.
  • Own the reconciliation of broker premium remittances into the premium trust account, clearing unapplied cash before it ages and escalating past-due balances and write-off candidates to the Controller.
  • Own execution of Counterpart's spend-management automation - full accounts payable automation, invoice coding, and card-spend policy enforcement.
  • Own employee expense reimbursement administration, setting the standard for review before sign-off by Controller.
  • Own vendor records and documentation, including W-9 collection, and manage the relationships behind recurring vendor and brokerage-fee payments.
  • Own recurring program-level reimbursement invoicing end-to-end, from calculation through submission.

Support Bordereau, Carrier Payment Operations, and Claims Payments

  • Prepare bordereau assembly and the premium reconciliation process across all carrier and reinsurance relationships, resolving discrepancies before they reach the Controller.
  • Maintain the carrier payment calendar, prioritizing and resolving issues against each carrier's timing requirements for the Controller's approval.
  • Prepare monthly loss fund reporting to carrier partners - bank-to-book reconciliation, top-up requests, and check registers - resolving variances directly with carrier contacts.
  • Execute claims payments from loss fund accounts under the Controller's payment authority, partnering directly with the Claims team on payment timing and exceptions.

Support Audit Administration

  • Administer the response process for the annual company audit, carrier audit financial requests, and the R&D tax credit - compiling documentation, drafting responses, and managing the deadline calendar, while the Controller leads the auditor and tax-advisor relationships.
  • Support Counterpart Insurance Company's statutory (STAT) reporting cadence and regulatory filings, providing the underlying data and documentation the Controller needs for CIC's STAT close.
  • Maintain and continuously improve the accounting due dates calendar.

Support Financial Reporting

  • Prepare and distribute the recurring carrier partner reporting package - unaudited financials, cash position summaries, and other standard deliverables on a monthly and quarterly basis, for the Controller's review and sign-off.
  • Partner with the Controller on evaluating and coordinating contractor, vendor, or offshore support for these processes as the accounting function grows.

Drive Agentic Automation Across Accounting Operations

  • Build and use agents to automate premium receivable cash application, bordereau assembly, premium reconciliation, and claims payment processing.
  • Feed clean, structured financial data and workflows into Counterpart's Intelligence System.
  • Decide where agents replace manual work versus where judgment is still required, and partner with the technical platform team to build and continuously improve those workflows.

YOU HAVE:

  • 5-7 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, ideally at a high-growth company; insurance, insurtech, or fintech experience is a plus but not required.
  • A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Working knowledge of GAAP and STAT (Statutory Accounting Principles), and comfort operating within a regulated, multi-entity insurance business.
  • A track record of owning and improving accounting processes end-to-end - not just executing tasks.
  • Hands-on experience with an accounting system or ERP (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or similar) and an AP/spend platform (Ramp, Bill.com, or similar).
  • A demonstrated track record of using AI tools or agents to redesign reconciliations, payment processing, and routine bookkeeping.
  • Comfort managing recurring payments, reconciliations, and deadline-driven filings across multiple systems and counterparties - including direct communication with banks, brokers, carriers, tax agencies, and auditors.
  • High attention to detail and a bias toward getting the numbers right the first time.
  • Clear written and verbal communication - you can represent Counterpart directly with broker, carrier, and audit contacts.
  • Progress toward or interest in pursuing a CPA is a plus, not required.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH:

  • Rob Hamilton, Controller
  • Dave Fanger, VP of Finance
  • Stanley Wang, Director, Pricing Analytics

COUNTERPART'S VALUES

  • Conjoin Expectations - it is the cornerstone of autonomy. Ensure you are aware of what is expected of you and clearly articulate what you expect of others.
  • Speak Boldly & Honestly - the only failure is not learning from mistakes. Don't cheat yourself and your colleagues of the feedback needed when expectations aren't being met.
  • Be Entrepreneurial - control your own destiny. Embrace action over perfection while navigating any obstacles that stand in the way of your ultimate goal. Leverage AI ruthlessly. We measure success by outcomes, not lines of code written. Use every available AI tool to ship faster and think more strategically.
  • Practice Omotenashi ("selfless hospitality") - trust will follow. Consider every interaction with internal and external partners an opportunity to develop trust by going above and beyond what is expected.
  • Hold Nothing As Sacred - create routines but modify them routinely. Take the time to reflect on where the business is today, where it needs to go, and what you have to change in order to get there.
  • Prioritize Wellness - some things should never be sacrificed. We create an environment that stretches everyone to grow and improve, which is fulfilling, but is only one part of a meaningful life.

WE OFFER

  • Fully remote workplace
  • Unlimited Vacation: We offer flexible time off, allowing you to take time when you need it.
  • Work from Anywhere: Counterpart is a fully distributed company, meaning there is no office. We allow employees to work from wherever they do their best work, and invite the team to meet in person a couple times per year.

  • No working birthdays: Take your birthday off, giving you the opportunity to relax, enjoy your special day, and spend time with loved ones.

We are committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported and connected at work - regardless of who you are or where you come from. MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
  • Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
  • Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
  • Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.

Strategic Account Management & Network Development

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
  • Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
  • Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
  • Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
  • Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.

Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement

  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.

Influence & Impact

  • Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.

Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Insights

  • Work seamlessly across field roles to coordinate account strategy, align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and ensure consistent follow-through while respecting functional boundaries.
  • Capture and communicate timely, objective, and actionable field insights that can inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, customer experience, and execution priorities.
  • Contribute actively to business reviews, training programs, team meetings, launch readiness, and cross-functional initiatives; share best practices and support the success of the broader organization.

Entrepreneurial Drive, Resilience & Culture

  • Create appropriate engagement opportunities in underdeveloped accounts and markets, test new approaches, learn quickly, and translate insights into action.
  • Maintain sustained drive, discipline, and performance through pressure, uncertainty, obstacles, delays, and discouragement; recover quickly and remain focused on long-term goals.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning; actively seek feedback and apply coaching to strengthen clinical, strategic, and selling capabilities.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Account Executive – Influencer Marketing

Location: Remote — Mexico

Experience: 2+ years

Travel: Occasional travel for key brand meetings
Start Date: As Soon As Possible

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing influencer marketing and creator technology company helping consumer brands across Latin America manage creator partnerships and campaigns more efficiently.

Its technology brings the influencer marketing workflow into a single platform, supporting areas such as creator discovery, campaign management, content review, contracts, payments, CRM, and performance analytics. The company combines technology, AI-powered capabilities, and a curated creator network to help brands execute UGC and influencer campaigns from initial brief through final delivery.

Operating in the rapidly evolving creator economy, the company is building a more scalable and technology-driven way for brands to work with creators across Latin America.

About the Role

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Brand Partnerships Lead to become the company's first dedicated sales hire and help build its commercial engine across Spanish-speaking Latin America.

This is a true full-cycle sales role. You will prospect, qualify, run discovery, develop proposals with operations, negotiate, close, and manage your accounts through their first renewals and early expansion.

You'll also work directly with the founder to build the commercial playbook from the ground up. This is not a role for someone waiting for inbound leads or a finished sales process. You'll be expected to create pipeline, close business, experiment, document what works, and use AI to automate repetitive parts of your workflow.

What You'll Do

Build & Own Your Pipeline

  • Build your own pipeline of consumer brands, particularly across beauty, personal care, and CPG.

  • Prospect brand managers, marketing directors, and other relevant decision-makers across Spanish-speaking Latin American markets.

  • Own outbound prospecting and consistently generate your own meetings.

  • Use email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and other relevant channels to move opportunities forward.

Run Full-Cycle Sales

  • Conduct consultative discovery to understand each brand's objectives and marketing needs.

  • Work with operations to design the right creator seeding or influencer marketing program.

  • Prepare proposals, present solutions, negotiate contracts, and close new business.

  • Own accounts through their initial renewals and early expansion before transitioning consolidated relationships.

Build an AI-Native Sales Process

  • Use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar AI platforms as part of your daily sales workflow.

  • Build your own automations for account research, call preparation, follow-ups, reporting, and other repeatable processes.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to automate administrative work so you can focus on high-value sales conversations.

Build the Commercial Playbook

  • Work directly with the founder to develop the company's sales methodology.

  • Document objections, outbound sequences, follow-up strategies, call learnings, and best practices.

  • Help create the commercial foundation that future sales hires will use.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience selling media, agency services, influencer marketing, martech solutions, or similar services to brand teams in Latin America.

  • Proven sales performance against quota, with the ability to discuss previous results using specific numbers.

  • Strong experience self-sourcing pipeline and personally prospecting for new business.

  • Experience managing a full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and closing.

  • Experience selling directly to brand managers, marketing leaders, or similar decision-makers.

  • Native Spanish.

  • Professional English for working with tools and documentation in both languages.

  • Strong understanding of WhatsApp as a professional sales channel, including follow-up and deal progression.

  • Genuine daily use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar platforms.

  • Ability to demonstrate real examples of how you have automated or improved parts of your sales process using AI.

  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling to beauty, personal care, CPG, or other consumer brands.

  • Background in influencer marketing, creator economy, UGC, digital media, or marketing technology.

  • Existing relationships with marketing decision-makers in Latin America.

  • Experience working in an early-stage startup or entrepreneurial environment.

This Role Is NOT for You If...

  • You depend on someone else to fill your calendar with meetings.

  • You haven't personally prospected for new business within the last year.

  • You're looking to manage a sales team before proving you can personally sell.

  • You expect to receive a finished sales playbook instead of helping build one.

  • You're uncomfortable experimenting with AI and automation as part of your daily workflow.

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

During the selection process, we will pay particular attention to:

  • Verifiable quota attainment and sales results.

  • Ability to consistently generate self-sourced pipeline.

  • Full-cycle closing experience.

  • Experience selling marketing-related solutions to LATAM brands.

  • Consultative selling and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to sell naturally through WhatsApp.

  • Practical, demonstrable use of AI and automation in sales.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, and independence.

What Success Looks Like

  • You consistently generate qualified opportunities without relying on inbound leads.

  • You build relationships with relevant consumer brands across target markets.

  • Opportunities progress effectively from discovery through proposal and close.

  • New accounts successfully reach their first renewals and expansion opportunities.

  • Repetitive sales activities are increasingly automated.

  • Your documented processes become the foundation of a scalable commercial playbook.

Why Join Us?

  • Become the first dedicated sales hire and have a direct impact on how the commercial organization is built.

  • Work closely with the founder throughout the sales process.

  • Join a technology-driven company operating at the intersection of AI, influencer marketing, and the creator economy.

  • Build processes rather than simply inherit them.

  • Fully remote work across Latin America.

  • Base salary plus uncapped variable compensation, with OTE structured approximately 50/50.

Important Notes

As a Solutions Engineer, you'll architect and implement custom solutions using the Canvas SDK, build reusable plugins and integrations, and extend our platform's capabilities to meet complex healthcare automation challenges. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to prototype rapidly, validate technical approaches, and deliver production-ready solutions that delight customers. This is a builder role where you'll directly impact how healthcare providers leverage our EMR platform while contributing to the evolution of our developer tools and SDK.
The ideal candidate brings strong engineering fundamentals, passion for healthcare technology, and exceptional ability to navigate between rapid prototyping and production-quality code. You'll thrive in collaborative environments, balance customer urgency with engineering excellence, and drive technical decisions that scale.   • Strong problem-solving skills with ability to navigate ambiguous technical challenges
  • Technical Skills & Capabilities

  • JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (React preferred) are a bonus.

  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, testing practices, and code maintainability
  • Comfort with rapid prototyping while maintaining production-quality standards

  • Personal Attributes

What Success Looks Like at 90 Days

Growth Path

Solutions Engineers at Canvas have multiple growth trajectories. Within 12-18 months, high performers evolve into senior solutions engineers who architect our most complex customer implementations and drive platform strategy. Many transition into core platform engineering roles, bringing deep customer context to shape product development. Others grow into technical leadership positions, building and scaling our solutions engineering practice. This role offers unique exposure to both customer challenges and platform internals, positioning you to influence Canvas's technical direction and healthcare impact.

Location
