jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Construction Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, monitoring, and updating project schedules to support the successful delivery of construction projects. This position works closely with project managers, superintendents, engineers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients to establish realistic project timelines, track progress, identify potential delays, and support timely project completion.

The Construction Scheduler plays a key role in providing accurate schedule information to the project team and management, identifying schedule risks, and supporting recovery plans when projects fall behind schedule.

Key Responsibilities

Project Scheduling

  • Develop detailed baseline schedules for construction projects in accordance with contract requirements and project objectives.
  • Create and maintain project schedules covering engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout activities as applicable.
  • Develop activity sequences, durations, logic relationships, milestones, and critical path activities.
  • Coordinate schedule development with project managers, superintendents, engineers, subcontractors, and other project stakeholders.
  • Ensure schedules accurately reflect project scope, contract requirements, and planned construction methods.
  • Establish and maintain appropriate schedule coding, calendars, work breakdown structures, and activity classifications.

Schedule Updates & Progress Tracking

  • Update project schedules regularly based on actual field progress and information provided by the project team.
  • Collect and verify progress information from field personnel, subcontractors, vendors, and other stakeholders.
  • Track actual start and finish dates, remaining durations, percentage complete, quantities, and milestones.
  • Compare planned progress against actual progress and identify variances.
  • Maintain accurate records of schedule changes, revisions, and project milestones.

Schedule Analysis

  • Monitor the critical path and near-critical activities.
  • Identify potential delays, schedule risks, and impacts to project milestones.
  • Perform schedule variance and trend analysis.
  • Evaluate the impact of changes, RFIs, submittals, procurement issues, design changes, weather events, and other factors affecting the schedule.
  • Provide recommendations to the project team regarding schedule mitigation and recovery strategies.
  • Assist with time-impact analysis and extension-of-time evaluations when required.

Coordination & Reporting

  • Work closely with project management and field operations to ensure schedule information reflects current project conditions.
  • Participate in project coordination, progress, and scheduling meetings.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly schedule reports for project management and clients.
  • Provide schedule updates, look-ahead schedules, milestone reports, and critical-path analyses.
  • Communicate schedule changes and potential impacts to relevant project stakeholders.
  • Assist project managers and superintendents with short-term planning and sequencing.

Look-Ahead Planning

  • Develop and maintain detailed short-term and look-ahead schedules.
  • Coordinate upcoming activities with field supervision and subcontractors.
  • Identify constraints that could prevent planned work from progressing.
  • Track required materials, manpower, equipment, inspections, approvals, and other prerequisites.
  • Assist the project team in developing recovery schedules when required.

Change Management

  • Incorporate approved change orders, design changes, scope changes, and other modifications into project schedules.
  • Assess schedule impacts associated with changes and delays.
  • Maintain a clear record of schedule revisions and changes to key milestones.
  • Coordinate with project controls and commercial teams regarding schedule impacts on cost and contract requirements.

Project Closeout

  • Track completion of outstanding construction activities, inspections, punch-list items, commissioning, and turnover requirements.
  • Maintain the schedule through project completion and closeout.
  • Support the preparation of final schedule reports and project documentation.
  • Assist with collecting schedule information for lessons learned and historical project data.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Project Management, Business, or a related field is preferred.
  • 3–7 years of experience in construction scheduling, project controls, construction management, or a related field.
  • Experience developing and maintaining construction schedules for commercial, industrial, civil, infrastructure, or other construction projects.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, project execution, and scheduling principles.
  • Experience with scheduling software such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or equivalent scheduling platforms.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, contracts, and project documentation.
  • Understanding of critical path methodology and schedule logic.
  • Experience with progress measurement and schedule performance reporting.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Project or Primavera P6 is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Oracle Primavera Cloud, or similar construction/project management platforms.
  • Experience with earned value management or other project controls methodologies.
  • Experience preparing baseline schedules and schedule narratives.
  • Experience with delay analysis, time-impact analysis, and recovery scheduling.
  • Experience working on large-scale or complex construction projects.
  • Professional certifications such as PSP (Planning & Scheduling Professional), PMI-SP, PMP, or CCM are a plus.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong understanding of construction activities and sequencing.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to analyze large amounts of project data and identify trends.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with project management, field personnel, subcontractors, engineers, and clients.
  • Ability to identify potential schedule issues before they affect major milestones.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects or priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of critical path and schedule logic.
  • Ability to work independently while supporting a collaborative project team.
  • Strong presentation and reporting skills.

Working Conditions

Performance Measures

Hello! ✨

Our secure, web-based and AI-powered solutions help companies around the world collaborate smarter, serve customers better and grow stronger — and we want you to help shape what’s next.

In 2005, brothers Dimitri and Steve Osler set out to reimagine how businesses communicate, and that vision became Wildix. Today, from our headquarters in Tallinn, Estonia, Wildix is one of the world’s fastest-growing UCaaS companies, with 300+ team members from 15+ nationalities, working across Europe, the UK, the Americas and beyond. We serve businesses in 135+ countries through a partner-first ecosystem, delivering secure, intuitive solutions that keep companies connected, productive and ready for what’s next.

At Wildix, we don’t just build technology, we live it. As a remote-first company, we rely on our own platform every day to collaborate globally and innovate fast. At Wildix, our mission is clear: Empower companies worldwide with seamless communication solutions that drive productivity, efficiency, and growth.

jobs.description:
Job Description

  • Position Title: Clinical Skills & Group Practice Instructor – Distance Learning
  • Department: Academic Faculty
  • Reports To: Campus Director / Academic Director
  • Institution: Vancouver College of Counsellor Training (VCCT)

Position Summary

The Clinical Skills & Group Practice Instructor facilitates interactive clinical skills training sessions for students enrolled in VCCT's distance-learning counselling programs. The role focuses on helping students develop applied counselling competencies through role-play exercises, group supervision, ethics discussions, and simulated counselling scenarios.

The instructor supports students in translating theoretical knowledge into practical counselling skills including reflective listening, empathy, emotional attunement, ethical decision-making, and therapeutic communication. The role also includes facilitating group therapy simulations and preparing students for practicum placements, ensuring students are professionally prepared for real-world counselling environments.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Skills Training

  • Facilitate live online clinical skills practice sessions for distance-learning students.
  • Conduct role-play simulations of counselling scenarios.
  • Teach and demonstrate counselling micro-skills including reflective listening, empathy, rapport building, and therapeutic communication.

Provide constructive feedback to support student skill development.

  • Group Therapy Simulation & Supervision
  • Facilitate group counselling role-play sessions to help students practice group facilitation techniques.
  • Act as Group Supervisor, observing student-led group sessions and providing reflective feedback.
  • Support student understanding of group dynamics, participation management, and therapeutic group processes.

Ethics & Professional Practice

  • Facilitate case discussions and ethical scenario analysis relevant to counselling practice.
  • Guide students in applying ethical frameworks, confidentiality standards, and professional boundaries.

Practicum Preparation

  • Support students in preparing for practicum placements.
  • Respond to student questions related to practicum expectations and readiness.
  • Guide students on professional behaviour, client interaction, documentation practices, and ethical conduct in counselling environments.

Interactive Learning & Student Engagement

  • Use virtual learning platforms to facilitate breakout room discussions and supervised practice sessions.
  • Create experiential learning activities that strengthen counselling competencies.
  • Foster a safe, respectful, and inclusive learning environment that supports meaningful learning.

Qualifications

Education

  • Master's degree in Counselling, Psychology, Social Work, or a related field preferred.
  • Diploma in Counselling with significant professional experience may be considered.

Professional Credentials

Active professional designation such as Registered Clinical Counsellor (RCC) with the BC Association of Clinical Counsellors or equivalent (e.g., CCC with the Canadian Counselling and Psychotherapy Association).

Must hold a recognized Clinical Supervisor designation or supervisor training enabling supervision of counselling students.

Must be in good standing with their professional association.

Experience

  • Experience providing counselling or psychotherapy services.
  • Experience facilitating group counselling or group therapy sessions.
  • Experience mentoring or supervising students or trainees.
  • Experience facilitating skills-based training for adult learners.
  • Familiarity with online teaching platforms and breakout-room facilitation.

Core Competencies

  • Strong interpersonal and facilitation skills
  • Ability to guide experiential learning and counselling practice
  • Competence in group counselling facilitation
  • Ability to provide constructive supervision and feedback
  • Strong ethical awareness and professional judgment
  • Ability to create psychologically safe learning environments

Working Conditions

  • Remote instructional delivery through VCCT's virtual learning platform.
  • Sessions conducted in an interactive online format.
  • Scheduling based on program cohort requirements.

Growth Opportunity

VCCT is a growing institution committed to developing strong faculty members. Instructors who demonstrate exceptional teaching quality, student engagement, and alignment with VCCT's academic standards may be considered for expanded responsibilities and increased teaching hours, with the potential to transition into a full-time instructional role as program needs grow.

jobs.excerpt: ¿Qué es? Un CFO Service Designer es un profesional especializado en la definición, autoría, mantenimiento y gobierno de requisitos a nivel de cliente para programas de vehículos actuales y futuros.
jobs.description:
¿Qué es?

Un CFO Service Designer es un profesional especializado en la definición, autoría, mantenimiento y gobierno de requisitos a nivel de cliente para programas de vehículos actuales y futuros. Su rol es clave para garantizar que las necesidades del cliente y del negocio se traduzcan en requisitos claros, verificables, trazables y alineados con los objetivos del programa, las restricciones arquitectónicas, los estándares aplicables y las expectativas del cliente.

¿Cómo lo hace?

Colabora con equipos multifuncionales (Planificación de Producto, Ingeniería de Sistemas, HMI, Software, Hardware y Validación) para descomponer necesidades de clientes y stakeholders en requisitos funcionales y no funcionales a nivel de plataforma.

Analiza y valida requisitos para asegurar que sean completos, consistentes, factibles, no ambiguos y alineados con los objetivos del programa.

Gestiona la trazabilidad bidireccional desde las necesidades del cliente hasta los requisitos de sistema, subsistema, software, hardware y validación.

Facilita revisiones cruzadas para resolver conflictos, brechas, suposiciones y dependencias de interfaz con stakeholders globales.

Utiliza herramientas como IBM DOORS Next Gen para autorizar, trazabilidad, revisión y reporte de requisitos.

Incorpora estándares de seguridad (ISO 26262), ciberseguridad, regulatorios e industriales en los requisitos del producto.

Trabaja con equipos de validación para definir criterios de aceptación, métodos de verificación y confirmar la cobertura de requisitos.

Importancia:

Su trabajo es esencial para asegurar que los productos automotrices (como sistemas eléctricos, de propulsión o autónomos) cumplan con los requisitos del cliente, los estándares de calidad y los plazos corporativos, minimizando riesgos técnicos, de tiempo y costos.

Requirements

Habilidades Técnicas Obligatorias:

Conocimiento en Ingeniería de Sistemas Automotrices:

Nivel: Intermedio (5-8 años de experiencia)

Incluye: Descomposición funcional, interfaces, arquitecturas y la interacción entre software, hardware, red y componentes físicos.

Gestión de Requisitos:

Nivel: Intermedio (5-8 años de experiencia)

Incluye: Definición, autoría, análisis, revisión y gestión del ciclo de vida de requisitos.

Conocimiento de ISO 26262:

Nivel: Intermedio (5-8 años de experiencia)

Incluye: Implicaciones para la definición, asignación, trazabilidad y verificación de requisitos relacionados con la seguridad.

Interpretación de Requisitos Regulatorios y Estándares:

Nivel: Intermedio (5-8 años de experiencia)

Incluye: Traducción de requisitos regulatorios, estándares y mejores prácticas de la industria en requisitos de producto claros y trazables.

Prácticas de Ingeniería de Requisitos (INCOSE):

Nivel: Intermedio (5-8 años de experiencia)

Incluye: Elicitación, descomposición, asignación, análisis, trazabilidad, verificación, validación y gestión de cambios.

Comunicación Técnica:

Nivel: Intermedio (5-8 años de experiencia)

Incluye: Redacción de requisitos técnicos precisos, facilitación de revisiones multifuncionales y explicación de contenido técnico a audiencias no técnicas.c

About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

As a Staff IT Engineer, you will be a technical leader responsible for driving efficiency and scale across the entire corporate IT infrastructure and enterprise ecosystem. You will design, build, and maintain mission-critical automation solutions that eliminate manual processes, enhance security posture, and improve the employee experience globally. This role requires deep engineering expertise, an IT product mindset for automation, and the ability to mentor junior team members while tackling the organization's most complex integration and scaling challenges. You will work directly with IT leadership, Security leadership, and department heads across the company.

Operating at the intersection of healthcare AI and enterprise IT, you will be expected to architect and enforce automation standards that meet the rigorous demands of a HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2-audited environment.

What You'll Do

  • Workflow Automation: Develop scalable, resilient workflow automation solutions to streamline critical business processes, including onboarding/offboarding, access requests, compliance enforcement, and self-service IT support.

  • API and Integration Development: Serve as the subject matter expert for integrating disparate systems by building robust, fault-tolerant connections using APIs and event-driven architectures.

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM): Drive automation within the IAM infrastructure, focusing on automated role assignment, least-privilege policy enforcement, and audit-friendly logging of authentication and authorization events.

  • Enterprise Data Engineering: Architect and engineer robust data platforms for IT, ensuring efficient collection, normalization, and secure storage of high-volume enterprise data for reporting, audit, and advanced analytics.

  • Technical Leadership: Act as a force multiplier for the team — establishing engineering best practices, leading code reviews, documenting architectures, and mentoring engineers in automation principles.

  • Business Systems & Custom Application Deployment: Own the end-to-end deployment and lifecycle management of business-critical systems and custom-built applications, from architecture and vendor evaluation through implementation, integration, and ongoing support — ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise IT standards.

What You'll Need

  • Experience: 10+ years in IT Engineering, IT Apps Development, or DevOps, with at least 5 years dedicated to large-scale enterprise automation.

  • Cloud & Platform Expertise: Deep hands-on experience automating complex operations and governance across GCP, AWS, and/or Azure. You will bring an ability to build and modularize infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (i.e. Terraform).

  • Programming Proficiency: Highly proficient in at least one modern programming language; strong preference for Python.

  • Systems Integration: Proven experience with REST/GraphQL APIs and querying and managing relational databases (SQL strongly preferred).

  • Automation Platforms: Extensive experience designing and managing centralized automation platforms (e.g., n8n, SOAR, Ansible, Workato, or custom frameworks).

  • Compliance Context: Experience operating in regulated industries (healthcare, finance, or similar) with exposure to SOC 2, HIPAA, or equivalent compliance frameworks.

  • Communication: Able to communicate effectively across a wide range of audiences — from engineers to GTM stakeholders, from individual contributors to executives.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with agentic AI or ML models applied to IT automation (proactive issue detection, intelligent routing, NLP).

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

jobs.excerpt: Work ArrangementRemote position with periodic travel to AEVEX facilities (Tampa, FL; Solana Beach, CA; other locations) as needed for implementation workshops, go-lives, and team events.
jobs.description:
Work Arrangement

Remote position with periodic travel to AEVEX facilities (Tampa, FL; Solana Beach, CA; other locations) as needed for implementation workshops, go-lives, and team events. Estimated travel: 10–20%. May require occasional work outside standard business hours for deployments, upgrades, or critical incident resolution.

Job Overview

This is a platform ownership role focused on the continued development, maturity, and expansion of ServiceNow across the organization. The successful candidate should think beyond individual tickets and enhancements and focus on process efficiency, automation, data integrity, user adoption, scalability, and long-term platform value.

The ServiceNow Architect will own assigned solutions and modules end-to-end, from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, deployment, documentation, and continuous improvement in production.

The role will initially support ServiceNow development and platform initiatives based on defined projects, enhancements, and organizational priorities, with the opportunity to assume greater platform ownership as ServiceNow capabilities and adoption continue to expand.

Essential Functions

Platform Development & Ownership

  • Serve as a primary technical resource for the ServiceNow platform across the enterprise environment.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and continuously improve ServiceNow solutions based on business and IT requirements.
  • Develop and maintain Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, Scheduled Jobs, and other platform components using JavaScript and Glide APIs.
  • Build and manage Flow Designer flows, subflows, actions, approvals, notifications, and other automation.
  • Manage Update Sets and controlled promotion of changes across Development, Test, and Production environments.
  • Support platform upgrades, testing, release management, and ongoing platform health.
  • Evaluate existing configurations and recommend opportunities to simplify, standardize, or improve solutions.

ITSM & Service Experience

  • Develop and mature ITSM capabilities including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Catalog.
  • Configure and improve Change Management capabilities including change models, approvals, CAB workflows, risk assessment, and supporting automation.
  • Design and maintain Service Catalog items, Record Producers, approval workflows, SLAs, and self-service capabilities.
  • Improve agent workspaces, assignment processes, queues, forms, and other experiences that increase technician efficiency.
  • Continuously improve the end-user experience through portal improvements, self-service, automation, and feedback-driven iteration.
  • Identify unnecessary manual processes and develop practical solutions that improve service delivery.

HAM / SAM & Asset Lifecycle

  • Develop and mature Hardware Asset Management (HAM) and Software Asset Management (SAM) capabilities within ServiceNow.
  • Configure and improve hardware asset lifecycle processes including receiving, assignment, inventory, refresh, return, retirement, and disposal.
  • Improve asset ownership, inventory visibility, normalization, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Develop software asset and license management capabilities including software inventory, entitlement and license visibility, utilization, and lifecycle management.
  • Develop automation between asset management, request fulfillment, procurement, onboarding/offboarding, and other applicable processes.
  • Maintain appropriate relationships between assets and Configuration Items within the CMDB.

ITOM, Discovery & CMDB

  • Mature and maintain the CMDB with an emphasis on accuracy, completeness, ownership, relationships, and data integrity.
  • Configure and optimize Discovery schedules, MID Servers, Service Mapping, reconciliation rules, normalization, and CI relationships.
  • Support ITOM capabilities that improve infrastructure and service visibility.
  • Develop processes and automation to identify and remediate stale, duplicate, incomplete, or inaccurate CMDB data.
  • Partner with infrastructure and application teams to establish appropriate CI ownership and data governance.

Integration & Automation

  • Design, develop, and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, and other supported integration methods.
  • Design and deploy IntegrationHub spokes, spoke actions, and reusable automation components.
  • Integrate ServiceNow with enterprise identity, endpoint management, monitoring, security, business, and other platforms as requirements evolve.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IT and business processes and reduce manual intervention.
  • Design integrations with scalability, maintainability, security, and appropriate error handling in mind.

Reporting, Analytics & Platform Visibility

  • Develop dashboards and operational reporting that provide meaningful visibility into service performance.
  • Provide reporting around workload, ticket aging, SLA performance, trends, ownership, asset inventory, CMDB health, and other operational metrics.
  • Work with IT leadership and process owners to identify meaningful KPIs and translate them into actionable ServiceNow reporting.
  • Improve data quality where necessary to ensure ServiceNow reporting can be relied upon for operational and management decisions.

Acquisition & Business Process Integration

  • Support the onboarding of newly acquired organizations, teams, users, assets, and business processes into the ServiceNow environment.
  • Assess existing processes and workflows—including SharePoint-based or other legacy workflows—and determine appropriate ServiceNow solutions.
  • Translate business processes into scalable ServiceNow workflows, catalog items, approvals, integrations, and automation.
  • Work with stakeholders to gather requirements, validate designs, conduct testing, and coordinate production implementation.
  • Look for opportunities to standardize acquired processes while avoiding unnecessary customization.

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Maintain ServiceNow roles, ACLs, RBAC, and other security configurations to appropriately protect platform data.
  • Follow established development, testing, documentation, peer review, change management, and production deployment processes.
  • Support SOX, SOC, CMMC, NIST 800-171, and other applicable compliance requirements where ServiceNow workflows, access controls, reporting, or audit evidence are involved.
  • Develop and maintain workflows supporting access requests, approvals, access reviews, change management, and other controlled processes as required.
  • Ensure platform solutions are designed with auditability and appropriate separation of duties in mind.

Continuous Improvement & Platform Adoption

  • Maintain a platform ownership mindset, proactively identifying opportunities to improve ServiceNow rather than relying solely on submitted enhancement requests.
  • Recommend capabilities that maximize the value of existing ServiceNow licensing and identify when additional modules or capabilities may provide measurable value.
  • Partner with IT leadership, technical teams, process owners, and business stakeholders to establish priorities and deliver scalable solutions.
  • Promote adoption through intuitive workflows, self-service capabilities, documentation, and user feedback.
  • Maintain technical documentation, integration architecture, configuration documentation, and operational runbooks.
  • Provide knowledge transfer for significant configurations and enhancements.
  • Serve as an escalation resource for complex ServiceNow platform issues when required.

Standard Essential Functions

  • Regular and reliable attendance on a full time basis [or in accordance with posted schedule].
  • Responsible for exhibiting professional behavior with both internal and external business associates that reflects positively on the company and is consistent with the company's policies and practices.
  • Embodies AEVEX’s cultural values and aligns daily actions with department goals and company culture.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development and administration experience.
  • Strong proficiency with JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Flow Designer.
  • Demonstrated experience with ServiceNow ITSM including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Catalog.
  • Experience with HAM, SAM, or broader IT Asset Management capabilities.
  • Experience with CMDB, Discovery, MID Server, Service Mapping, reconciliation, and CI relationships.
  • Practical experience developing automation using Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, or comparable ServiceNow capabilities.
  • Experience developing REST/SOAP integrations and understanding ServiceNow integration patterns.
  • Experience developing operational dashboards and reporting within ServiceNow.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL practices and their application within ServiceNow.
  • Ability to translate technical and business requirements into practical, scalable platform solutions.
  • Ability to independently scope, design, develop, test, document, deploy, and support ServiceNow solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with Integrated Risk Management (IRM/GRC), IT Operations Management (ITOM), and Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)

Education / Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) preferred
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) or Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS ITSM) preferredPreferred Qualifications
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD).
  • CIS-ITSM, CIS-HAM, CIS-SAM, or other applicable ServiceNow certifications.
  • Experience with ServiceNow HAM Pro and/or SAM Pro.
  • Experience with ITOM, Service Mapping, Performance Analytics, IntegrationHub, or other advanced ServiceNow capabilities.
  • Experience integrating newly acquired organizations or migrating business processes into ServiceNow.
  • Experience translating legacy or SharePoint-based workflows into ServiceNow.
  • Experience supporting defense, aerospace, government contracting, or other regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with SOX, SOC, CMMC, NIST 800-171, or similar compliance frameworks.

Experience

  • 6+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience with a focus on ITSM and ITOM.
  • Experience with ServiceNow integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and MID Server.
  • Experience configuring and administering Service Catalog, Change Management, Incident, Problem, and Request Management modules.
  • Hands-on experience with CMDB, Discovery, and Service Mapping.
  • Experience with ServiceNow GRC, SecOps, or HR Service Delivery modules preferred
  • Experience with ServiceNow in FedRAMP or GovCloud environments preferred
  • Experience in defense, aerospace, or government contracting environments with knowledge of SOX, SOC, CMMC, and NIST 800-171 compliance preferred
  • Experience with Performance Analytics, reporting, and executive dashboards in ServiceNow preferred
  • Experience migrating from Zendesk, Jira Service Management, or other ITSM platforms to ServiceNow preferred

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties the employee is:

  • Constantly required to sit, and to reach to use computers and other office equipment For the purpose of this summary, occasionally is used to represent up to 1/3 of the time given to the work day, frequently represents 1/3 to 2/3 of the time and constantly represents 2/3 or more of the time.
  • For the purpose of this summary, occasionally is used to represent up to 1/3 of the time given to the work day, frequently represents 1/3 to 2/3 of the time and constantly represents 2/3 or more of the time.

Security Clearance

Ability to obtain/maintain a Secret DoD clearance, U.S. Citizenship required.

About AEVEX

AEVEX, headquartered in Solana Beach, California, supports the U.S. national security mission and partner nation needs around the world by providing full-spectrum aviation, remote sensing, and analysis solutions. The company's capabilities include custom design and engineering; rapid prototyping; sensor integration and sustainment; aircraft modification and certification; flight test instrumentation and support; mission operations service; advanced intelligence data processing, exploitation, and dissemination solutions; and tailored hardware and software mission-system tools. AEVEX uses agile and customized approaches to rapidly define, develop, and deliver specialized solutions for airborne special mission needs for the U.S. Government, partner nations, and commercial businesses. AEVEX has major offices in California, Florida, North Carolina, Ohio, and Virginia.

AEVEX provides a full suite of comprehensive benefits, including a 401(k)-retirement plan, comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability and Life insurance group coverage with a portion of the premiums paid by the company, professional development funds, and an Employee Assistance Plan (EAP) with counseling, legal help, child and elder care support, among other benefits for qualified employees.

jobs.title: Senior Product Data Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are: Clearwave Corporation is an innovative healthcare technology company based in Atlanta, Georgia that provides a complete patient-engagement platform for specialty practices.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Clearwave Corporation is an innovative healthcare technology company based in Atlanta, Georgia that provides a complete patient-engagement platform for specialty practices. Our solutions simplify patient experiences and help practices grow and scale in our ever-changing healthcare environment, all to create a better all-around healthcare experience. With proven ROI, Clearwave improves practice revenues, reduces staff workload, and enhances the patient experience. Through self-service scheduling and check-in, patient communication, and insurance verification, Clearwave helps practices provide a digital-first, convenient, compliant, and safe experience that patients have come to expect from healthcare providers. With 95% client retention, we understand that we’re stronger when we support our customers. Clearwave is committed to superior client onboarding and ongoing client success with an unsurpassed client-partner relationship.

About the Role

The Senior Product Data Analyst will be the analytical backbone for active product initiatives around Eligibility AI, Revenue Analysis and Client Outcomes. You will also support the broader Product team's move toward outcome-based measurement across Scheduling, Registration, Intake and Payments.

This role sits at the intersection of healthcare operations and data. Strong SQL and BI skills are essential, but so is a working understanding of how patients actually move through scheduling, eligibility, intake and payments — and how that journey drives revenue, staff time and patient satisfaction for our clients. We are looking for someone who can speak both languages: query the data and explain what it means for a practice's front desk, billing team and bottom line.

Clearwave's Product Management team operates under a Product Operating Model, which means every product manager is expected to lead with continuous discovery, define success metrics before building and report on business outcomes rather than just features shipped. This Data Analyst role supports turning scattered exports, portal reports and Salesforce data into the metrics, dashboards and analysis our business needs to prove value and make evidence-based prioritization calls.

Key Responsibilities

Eligibility AI

  • Analyze insurance eligibility and coverage data across the scheduling, pre-registration and visit stages of the patient journey to track active coverage rate, plan identification accuracy and eligibility flag clearance.
  • Monitor accuracy and performance of AI-driven eligibility checks (e.g., Code 42 non-response, flag resolution), and surface trends by payer, location and client.
  • Partner with the Eligibility AI product manager to define and track success metrics before development begins, and report on outcomes (clean-claim impact, staff time saved, denial reduction) after launch.

Revenue Analysis

  • Support revenue and opportunity modeling for initiatives, including attach-rate assumptions, unit economics and renewal risk analysis.
  • Pull and validate Salesforce data (strategic renewals, new-logo run-rate) feeding the opportunity model, flagging data-mapping issues before they reach leadership reporting.
  • Help quantify and track initiative adoption and revenue contribution against goals set by the product and revenue teams.

Client Outcomes Data

  • Build and maintain recurring client-facing and internal outcome reporting (usage, adoption, satisfaction, business impact) across product areas, in the spirit of the outcome-measurement goals every PM on this team is held to.
  • Consolidate exports from the Clearwave Provider Portal and other internal sources into consistent, reusable data models so reporting doesn't have to be rebuilt from scratch each cycle.
  • Help Product Managers document ROI for completed initiatives (e.g., Payment at Pre-Reg, Voice AI, Reschedule Assist) using adoption rates, transaction/revenue volume and customer satisfaction data.
  • Occasionally present outcome data directly in client business reviews or renewal conversations, alongside CS/Sales

Cross-Team Analytics Support

  • Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting that let Product Managers track their product area's P&L, feature usage and client adoption without a one-off analysis request each time.
  • Translate ambiguous business questions from Product, CS and leadership into clean data pulls, clear visualizations and a defensible recommendation — grounded in how the finding affects patients, staff workflow or revenue, not just the numbers themselves.
  • Maintain data quality and documentation for the metrics and definitions this team relies on, so numbers stay consistent across PMs and reporting cycles.
  • Participate in discovery and prioritization conversations to make sure decisions are grounded in usage and outcome data, not just anecdote.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year

  • Eligibility AI, Revenue Analysis and Client Outcomes each have a standing set of metrics, defined with their product owners, that are tracked and reported on a regular cadence rather than assembled ad hoc.
  • Product Managers can pull adoption, usage and revenue-impact data for their product area without waiting on a custom analysis.
  • Initiatives have a documented before/after outcome story (e.g., ROI, time saved, adoption growth) built from your reporting — written so both a PM and a client's billing or front-desk lead can follow it.

Technical Environment

This role works hands-on across our modern data stack and product platform. Familiarity with the following technologies, or the ability to ramp quickly, is central to success in this position.

Data & Analytics

  • Snowflake (medallion architecture) – enterprise data platform and system of record for analytics.
  • AWS Glue and Kafka – data ingestion and pipeline infrastructure feeding the warehouse.
  • Legacy SQL Server EDW (15TB+)
  • Tableau
  • Power BI

Required Qualifications

Healthcare & Business Acumen

  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare, health-tech or another patient-facing industry, with hands-on exposure to patient engagement, eligibility, scheduling, registration or revenue cycle workflows.
  • Practical understanding of how patients move through the scheduling, eligibility, intake and payment journey, and how that journey affects collections, denials and patient satisfaction.
  • Business acumen: the ability to connect a data finding to its operational or financial impact, and explain that connection in plain language to product, revenue cycle and clinical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to present findings to non-technical, client-facing, or executive audiences (not just internal PM stakeholders)
  • Comfort working with EHR, PM System or patient-scheduling data, and familiarity with payer/provider dynamics such as eligibility, claims and denials.

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or product analyst role, ideally supporting a product or SaaS organization.
  • Strong SQL skills and comfort working directly with relational databases or a data warehouse.
  • Experience building dashboards and reports in a BI/visualization tool (e.g., Power BI, Tableau or Looker) or in spreadsheet-based tooling at scale.
  • Working knowledge of data structures, indexing, querying and data retrieval concepts.
  • Ability to turn a loosely defined business question into a structured analysis and communicate the findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to translate and present CRM data; Salesforce reporting experience preferred.
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • HIPAA training, certification or hands-on experience handling sensitive patient data in a regulated environment.
  • Experience in Big Data tools and languages (Python, R, Go or Spark) for data cleaning and analysis at scale.
  • Exposure to product analytics concepts (adoption funnels, cohort analysis, activation/retention metrics) and to empowered product-team operating models.
  • Exposure to streaming and batch data pipeline tooling (Kafka, AWS Glue or similar) and to large-scale transactional datasets (millions of records per day).
  • Familiarity with AI/ML-driven analytics – evaluating model or rules-engine output (e.g., Drools), monitoring accuracy and drift, and translating AI performance into business metrics.
  • Experience supporting a platform migration (e.g., SQL Server to Snowflake, Power BI to Tableau) while maintaining reporting continuity.

The Role

The L2 Service Desk Engineer is accountable for resolving complex incidents that exceed L1 scope and for restoring service where deeper technical analysis is required. The role exists to diagnose root causes, apply advanced troubleshooting, and stabilise client environments while maintaining clear communication and accurate technical records.

The role strengthens the service system by mentoring L1 engineers, improving resolution approaches, and building high-quality knowledge that reduces repeat incidents and unnecessary escalation. Decisions made at L2 directly influence service stability, team capability, and client confidence.

Key Accountabilities

Operational Service Delivery

v Restore client service by resolving incidents requiring advanced diagnosis across multiple systems, deeper technical knowledge beyond documented procedures, or changes with elevated risk/impact to services.

v Ensure complex incidents leave behind clear, reusable technical records that enable knowledge transfer and reduce repeat investigation.

v Contribute to service reliability by prioritising work effectively and coordinating with peers to meet service commitments.

v Maintain operational stability of supported systems through proactive monitoring, preventative actions, and timely response to alerts.

v Actively participate in major incident response by providing technical investigation, implementing fixes within scope, maintaining clear status updates, and supporting the Incident Manager without requiring direction for standard L2 activities.

v Exercise sound escalation judgement by resolving all issues within L2 scope and escalating to L3 only when platform-level change or deeper expertise is required, providing full technical context.

v Ensure clients understand the issue, actions taken, and expected outcomes through clear, accurate, and professional communication.

v Achieve personal performance outcomes defined in Goals & Objectives plan, demonstrating consistent delivery against L2 standards.

v May be required to participate in on-call rotation to provide after-hours support for escalated incidents and maintain service continuity.

Process Adherence

v Execute work in line with established ITIL-based service management processes for incident management, service requests, and escalation protocols, ensuring consistent, auditable service delivery.

v Improve the quality and effectiveness of knowledge by refining resolution approaches based on advanced troubleshooting and lived incident experience.

v Protect service integrity by ensuring compliance with documentation standards, security protocols, and audit requirements for advanced technical work including vendor interactions and system modifications.

v Build service desk capability by coaching L1 engineers and reducing avoidable escalation through guidance and knowledge transfer.

Skills & Qualifications

v Proven experience (3-5 years minimum) in technical support roles with demonstrated progression from frontline to advanced troubleshooting, including handling of escalated incidents requiring deeper technical knowledge and systematic diagnostic approaches

v Advanced technical knowledge including Windows Server basics, Active Directory administration (Group Policy, DNS, DHCP troubleshooting), Azure/M365 administration beyond fundamentals, networking troubleshooting (connectivity issues, VPN, basic firewall concepts), and security awareness.

v Strong understanding of ITSM frameworks (ITIL required) with practical experience in incident management processes, including participation in major incident response, escalation management, and contribution to problem identification.

v Demonstrated mentoring capability with evidence of successfully coaching junior team members, providing technical guidance, and contributing to team capability development through knowledge sharing and patient instruction.

v Vendor engagement experience including ability to effectively escalate to and coordinate with third-party vendors, articulate technical issues clearly with complete diagnostic information, and drive vendor cases to resolution.

v Advanced certifications demonstrating deeper technical knowledge: Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102) OR Azure Administrator (AZ-104) OR equivalent advanced platform knowledge, plus ITIL 4 Foundation as minimum baseline.

v Preferred certifications or experience include CompTIA Network+, Security+, Microsoft certified tracks (Azure, M365, Security), or demonstrable equivalent expertise through practical troubleshooting experience in MSP environments.

jobs.title: Therapeutic Account Manager, Liver - Indianapolis
jobs.excerpt: MISSIONMirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases.
jobs.description:
MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
  • Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
  • Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
  • Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.

Strategic Account Management & Network Development

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
  • Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
  • Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
  • Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
  • Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.

Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement

  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
  • Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
  • Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
  • Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.

Influence & Impact

  • Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
  • Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
  • Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries

Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact

  • Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
  • Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
  • Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
  • Identify recurring customer, access, and patient-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Insights

  • Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, Analytics, and Advocacy.
  • Work seamlessly across field roles to coordinate account strategy, align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and ensure consistent follow-through while respecting functional boundaries.
  • Capture and communicate timely, objective, and actionable field insights that can inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, customer experience, and execution priorities.
  • Contribute actively to business reviews, training programs, team meetings, launch readiness, and cross-functional initiatives; share best practices and support the success of the broader organization.

Entrepreneurial Drive, Resilience & Culture

  • Operate with a high degree of ownership, self-motivation, resourcefulness, and initiative in an unstructured, rapidly evolving rare disease environment.
  • Create appropriate engagement opportunities in underdeveloped accounts and markets, test new approaches, learn quickly, and translate insights into action.
  • Maintain sustained drive, discipline, and performance through pressure, uncertainty, obstacles, delays, and discouragement; recover quickly and remain focused on long-term goals.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning; actively seek feedback and apply coaching to strengthen clinical, strategic, and selling capabilities.
  • Model Mirum's values and the highest standards of ethical conduct, compliance, transparency, inclusion, and respect in every internal and external interaction.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive sales experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently delivering business results in a complex specialty, rare disease, orphan drug, or high-science market.
  • Rare disease experience is highly preferred; experience in hepatology, gastroenterology, pediatric specialty care, or another complex specialty market is highly desirable.
  • Strong clinical aptitude and demonstrated ability to learn, retain, and communicate complex disease-state, diagnostic, mechanism-of-action, clinical-data, and product information.
  • Experience with account-based selling across health systems, centers of excellence, multidisciplinary care teams, referral networks, and influential healthcare professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to use insight-led or challenger-style selling to constructively challenge the status quo, influence behavior, and advance customer decision-making.
  • Working knowledge of access and reimbursement dynamics, patient support pathways, and the role of patient services in rare disease markets.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to interpret performance data, identify insights, develop territory and account strategies, and translate plans into consistent field execution.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, communication, presentation, judgment, and ability to build trust with diverse and highly sophisticated customers.
  • Proven self-motivation, resourcefulness, resilience, organization, and ability to prioritize and perform independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
  • Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, and Analytics.
  • Commitment to ethical conduct, compliance, and approved promotional practices, with sound judgment in complex customer and patient-related situations.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 70%, including frequent overnight travel and occasional weekend commitments.

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all Federal, State and Local laws that prohibit employment discrimination on the basis of race, age, national origin, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship, genetic disposition or characteristics, disability, veteran’s status or any other classification protected by applicable State/Federal/Local laws.

Mirum Pharmaceuticals provides reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in job application procedures.

jobs.description:
The Academic Coach serves as the primary contact for learners from matriculation (orientation) through the completion of their program. The Academic Coach manages a pipeline of learners by coaching, motivating, mentoring, removing barriers, issue ownership through resolution, strategies for completion, and progress. They help learners clarify key decision-points and identify solutions and alternatives which align with the learners’ motivations and goals. The Academic Coach utilizes strong relationship-building and influencing skills resulting in positive learner behaviors and outcomes, contributing to overall learner success and persistence.
The Academic Coach is responsible for providing personalized interactions to assist learners in successfully navigating the path to achieve their educational goals. The Academic Coach will provide outreach at key milestones and based on identified behaviors throughout learners’ programs to help keep them on track and to assist with overcoming obstacles they encounter. Each interaction includes exploration of needs and provides personalized solutions to learners to effectively prepare them for long-term success.
The Academic Coach also works with faculty and other University partners to address learner concerns and to collaboratively define options to help learners overcome obstacles and achieve academic success.

Essential Duties

  • Academic Planning & Engagement
  • Assist learners in developing an academic plan that includes all program requirements, enables most direct path to completion, and aligns with their educational and career goals
  • Leverage tools, systems and software applications to optimize advising engagement.
  • Build a relationship with the learner to encourage learner success and engagement
  • Utilize program analytics and outreach protocols to drive purpose-driven and transformational conversations.
  • Help learners navigate changes in their programs and plans and understand and respond to Capella-initiated changes
  • Explore alignment of learner’s educational and financial plans in relation to degree completion
  • Provide resources and refer learners to university support services
  • Assess learner needs in order to help them make fully informed decisions about their pathways as well as challenging them to make progress toward their goals.
  • Progress Monitoring & Academic Risk Mitigation

  • Highlight and address potential barriers that may impact persistence, success and completion

jobs.title: Analyste financier(ère) de projets/Financial Project Analyst-Canada
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionThe Financial Project Analyst has for objective to track and report on the profitability of projects.
jobs.description:
Description

The Financial Project Analyst has for objective to track and report on the profitability of projects. This role involves collaboration with project teams, clients and internal departments to ensure the financial performance and high quality of clinical research project management services.

This role will be perfect for you if:

  • You have a solid understanding of complex enterprise processes and wish to help shape a growing finance and accounting department.
  • Working with internal and external stakeholders comes easily to you.
  • You want to learn all about the life science industry and clinical trials operations

RESPONSABILITIES

More specifically, the Project Financial Analyst must:

Project and budget set-up

  • Review and understand the client agreements and convert them into the Innovaderm internal cost structure
  • Create and configure projects in the project management and financial systems
  • Prepare and upload the project budget and related amendments impacting scope and/or timeline in the project management tool
  • Participate in the identification and the price assessment of the out-of-scope services.

Revenue / Expenses recognition and project reconciliation

As per month end schedule:

  • Ensure revenue and expenses are recognized based on Canadian GAAP and contractual requirements (including creation of journal entries for accruals and project allocation)
  • Review actual project revenues and costs compared to budget and forecast, identifying variances and their causes
  • Prepare and present detailed project financial reports, including but not limited to; profit and loss statement, financial projections (ETC and accrual report), invoicing status for internal and external stakeholders
  • Monitor and ensure accuracy of projects balance sheet accounts
  • Maintain accurate and organized financial records of project data

Invoice management

  • Review project invoicing and provide expertise as needed
  • At the end of the study, ensure all invoices were produced and paid
  • Act as the main point of contact for clients on any questions related to the invoicing

Collaboration with project team

  • Work closely with project managers to understand project requirements and financial implications
  • Provide financial guidance and support to project teams, helping them manage budgets and control costs
  • Facilitate regular financial review meetings with project managers and clients to discuss budget status, invoicing and other financial items

Internal presentations and special projects

  • Support internal and external audits by providing necessary financial documentation
  • Identify opportunities for process enhancements to increase efficiency and accuracy
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of improved financial processes and tools

Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting of related field
  • CPA certification, an asset

Experience

  • minimum of 4 years of experience in project accounting

Knowledge and skills

  • Excellent knowledge of spoken and written English
  • Professional judgment and proven interpersonal skills
  • Excellent analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Critical thinking and proactive problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines
  • Proficiency with financial management tools and office software (Excel, Power BI, ERP)
  • Comfortable working in an environment in constant evolution

Our company

﻿The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Company benefits package
  • Ongoing learning and development

﻿About Indero

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale..

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Canada

Description de poste

L'objectif principal de l'Analyste financier(ère) de projets est d'assurer le suivi et la production de rapports sur la rentabilité des projets. Ce rôle implique une collaboration étroite avec les équipes de projet, les clients et les différents services internes afin de garantir la performance financière et la qualité élevée des services de gestion de projets de recherche clinique.

Ce poste est idéal pour vous si :

  • Vous possédez une solide compréhension des processus complexes d'entreprise et souhaitez contribuer à l'évolution d'un département des finances et de la comptabilité en pleine croissance.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans vos interactions avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.
  • Vous souhaitez approfondir vos connaissances du secteur des sciences de la vie et des opérations liées aux essais cliniques.

RESPONSABILITÉS

Plus précisément, l'Analyste financier(ère) de projets doit :

Mise en place des projets et des budgets

  • Examiner et comprendre les ententes conclues avec les clients et les convertir dans la structure interne des coûts d'Innovaderm.
  • Créer et configurer les projets dans les systèmes de gestion de projets et les systèmes financiers.
  • Préparer et intégrer le budget du projet ainsi que les modifications connexes ayant une incidence sur la portée ou l'échéancier dans l'outil de gestion de projets.
  • Participer à l'identification et à l'évaluation des coûts des services hors mandat.

Comptabilisation des revenus et des dépenses et rapprochement des projets

Selon l'échéancier de clôture mensuelle :

  • S'assurer que les revenus et les dépenses sont comptabilisés conformément aux PCGR canadiens et aux exigences contractuelles, y compris la préparation des écritures de journal liées aux régularisations et aux répartitions par projet.
  • Examiner les revenus et les coûts réels des projets par rapport au budget et aux prévisions, en identifiant les écarts et leurs causes.
  • Préparer et présenter des rapports financiers détaillés sur les projets, incluant notamment l'état des résultats, les projections financières (ETC et rapports de régularisation) ainsi que le statut de la facturation, à l'intention des parties prenantes internes et externes.
  • Assurer le suivi et l'exactitude des comptes de bilan associés aux projets.
  • Maintenir des dossiers financiers précis, complets et bien organisés concernant les données des projets.

Gestion de la facturation

  • Réviser la facturation des projets et fournir son expertise au besoin.
  • À la fin de chaque étude, s'assurer que toutes les factures ont été émises et payées.
  • Agir à titre de personne-ressource principale auprès des clients pour toute question relative à la facturation.

Collaboration avec l'équipe de projet

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de projets afin de comprendre les exigences des projets et leurs implications financières.
  • Fournir des conseils et un soutien financiers aux équipes de projet afin de les aider à gérer leurs budgets et à contrôler les coûts.
  • Animer des rencontres périodiques de revue financière avec les gestionnaires de projets et les clients afin de discuter de l'état des budgets, de la facturation et de toute autre question financière.

Présentations internes et projets spéciaux

  • Soutenir les audits internes et externes en fournissant la documentation financière requise.
  • Identifier des occasions d'amélioration des processus afin d'accroître l'efficacité et l'exactitude des opérations.
  • Contribuer à la conception et à la mise en œuvre de processus et d'outils financiers optimisés.

L'employé(e) peut également se voir confier d'autres responsabilités ne figurant pas dans la présente description de poste, pourvu qu'il ou elle possède l'expérience requise, les qualifications nécessaires ou ait reçu la formation adéquate.

Profil recherché

Formation

  • Baccalauréat en comptabilité ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Titre professionnel CPA, un atout.

Expérience

  • Minimum de 4 ans d'expérience en comptabilité de projets.

Connaissances et compétences

  • Excellente maîtrise de l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.
  • Bon jugement professionnel et excellentes habiletés interpersonnelles.
  • Excellentes capacités d'analyse et grand souci du détail.
  • Esprit critique et aptitude à résoudre les problèmes de façon proactive.
  • Capacité à gérer simultanément plusieurs projets et à respecter des échéances serrées.
  • Maîtrise des outils de gestion financière et des logiciels de bureautique (Excel, Power BI, ERP).
  • Aisance à travailler dans un environnement en constante évolution.

Notre entreprise

L’environnement de travail

Chez Indero, vous travaillerez avec des collaborateurs compétents et dynamiques. Nos valeurs sont la collaboration, l’innovation, la fiabilité et la réactivité. Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant et des possibilités d’avancement intéressantes.

Dans ce role, vous bénéficierez des avantages suivants :

  • ﻿Horaire de travail flexible
  • Poste permanent à temps plein
  • Avantages sociaux complets (soins médicaux, soins dentaires, soins de la vue, REER, vacances, jours personnels, clinique médicale virtuelle, rabais sur le transport en commun, activités sociales)

À propos Indero

jobs.excerpt: About The Lawyering Project Founded in 2017, the Lawyering Project is a legal advocacy organization that blends traditional impact litigation with movement lawyering to promote reproductive health, rights, and justice throughout the United States.
jobs.description:
About The Lawyering Project 

Founded in 2017, the Lawyering Project is a legal advocacy organization that blends traditional impact litigation with movement lawyering to promote reproductive health, rights, and justice throughout the United States. Laws that undermine reproductive health, rights, and justice deprive people of moral agency, rob us of control over our bodies, and compound other forms of oppression like racism, sexism, and poverty. Our mission is to eliminate these laws and the harmful impacts they have on people’s lives. We are especially focused on laws that limit the availability or affordability of abortion care; contribute to disparities in reproductive health outcomes; embody gender-based stereotypes; or discriminate against people based on their reproductive decisions.

We have three legal programs: Litigation, Access & Innovation, and Pro Bono Initiatives. Our Litigation Program leverages the courts to eliminate barriers to reproductive health services and promote equity in access to care. Our Access & Innovation Program provides legal advice and technical assistance to healthcare providers, researchers, abortion funds, and organizations that facilitate access to abortion care.

Our Pro Bono Initiatives Program operates the Abortion Defense Network, a collaborative effort by nonprofit organizations, private law firms, and government officials aimed at ensuring everyone threatened with liability for providing or supporting abortion care in post-Roe America has access to high-quality, values-aligned lawyers. 

For further information, visit and .

About The Internship

The Lawyering Project is seeking legal interns to support its legal programs during the summer of 2027. The legal internship is remote, and legal interns may choose to work from a minimum of ten weeks to a maximum of twelve weeks from May-August 2027.

We are looking for individuals who possess strong research, writing, and analytical skills. Ideal candidates will be able to effectively manage multiple tasks, collaborate with colleagues, and contribute to a positive and supportive work environment. All interns will have the opportunity to gain practical experience in a variety of legal tasks.

The essential duties and responsibilities for this internship include, but are not limited to:

  • Conducting legal and factual research, analysis, and writing; 
  • Cite-checking and copy-editing legal documents; 
  • Assisting with court filings; 
  • Assisting with client advising;
  • Providing additional support to the Lawyering Project’s legal programs, as needed; and
  • Cultivating an organizational culture that aligns with the Lawyering Project’s core values 

Requirements

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 

The summer legal intern must be currently enrolled in a law school located in the United States.  Current 2Ls (students who will be rising 3Ls in the summer of 2027) are strongly encouraged to apply.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES 

The summer legal intern must have:

  • A demonstrated commitment to social justice and an interest in reproductive health, rights, and justice
  • Skill in legal research, writing, and analysis
  • Ability to analyze complex legal issues, meet deadlines, work well under pressure, and contribute to a collaborative team environment and a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work culture

APPLICATION DEADLINE

Applications will be accepted and reviewed on a rolling basis, with a priority deadline of October 1.

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Resume

    • As part of your application for the summer legal intern position, please include a cover letter that describes your experiences with legal research, writing, and analysis.
