Backed by private equity from people-focused Alpine Investors, Ascend is building a modern platform for regional accounting firms that enables them to stay independent while having access to resources of a large firm. These resources include growth capital, robust talent acquisition, best-of-breed technology, a catalytic leadership system, shared back-office services, and modernized equity incentives.

Founded in January 2023, Ascend has already attained revenues sufficient to qualify as a Top 30 U.S. accounting firm. Explore Ascend, where your career soars without sacrificing your quality of life.

The Role

TSS serves clients in the automotive retail, construction, manufacturing, distribution, and other for-profit industries, and many of them rely on us as their accounting department — closing their books, producing their financial statements, and giving their owners a clear read on the business.

This is a hands-on supervisory role. You will own a portfolio of client relationships, review the work of the accountants supporting them, and act as the escalation point when something does not tie out. Our ideal candidate is someone who is equally comfortable in the general ledger and in front of a business owner, and who wants to shape how a growing practice runs rather than just work inside it.

  • Working knowledge of GAAP as applied to closely held businesses
  • Proficiency with QuickBooks Online and Excel
  • Strong attention to detail and the judgment to know when something needs escalation
  • Integrity within a professional environment

Preferences

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or related field
  • QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification
  • Experience with CCH Axcess and cloud accounting workflow tools
  • Experience with payroll platforms and multi-state sales tax compliance
  • Active CPA or CMA

Location

At TSS, we’ve designed a flexible work structure that enables both teamwork and independence, enhancing our employees’ work experience while promoting personal well-being.

What We Offer

We hire good people and give them a good place to work. We truly believe that when you succeed, the firm succeeds, and we make sure you have whatever tools you need to make that success possible.

jobs.description:
OPEN DATE: September 1, 2026
CLOSING DATE: September 5, 2026
POSITION TYPE: Trust Fund
APPOINTMENT TYPE: Trust Indefinite
SCHEDULE: Full Time
DUTY LOCATION: REMOTE
Position sensitivity and risk: Low Risk
Who May Apply:
Open to all qualified applicants

What are Trust Fund Positions?
Trust Fund positions are unique to the Smithsonian. They are paid for from a variety of sources, including the Smithsonian endowment, revenue from our business activities, donations, grants and contracts. Trust employees are not part of the civil service, nor does trust fund employment lead to Federal status. The salary ranges for trust positions are generally the same as for federal positions and in many cases trust and federal employees work side by side. Trust employees have their own benefit program, which may include Health, Dental & Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Transit/Commuter Benefits, Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance, Annual and Sick Leave, Family Friendly Leave, 403b Retirement Plan, Discounts for Smithsonian Memberships, Museum Stores and Restaurants, Credit Union, Smithsonian Early Enrichment Center (Child Care), Flexible Spending Account (Health & Dependent Care).
Conditions of Employment
  • Pass Pre-employment Background Check and Subsequent Background Investigation for position designated.
  • Complete a Probationary Period.
  • Maintain a Bank Account for Direct Deposit/Electronic Transfer.
  • The position is open to all candidates eligible to work in the United States. Proof of eligibility to work in U.S. is not required to apply.
  • Applicants must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement.

OVERVIEW

This position is in the Center for Folklife and Cultural Heritage (CFCH), a research center of the Smithsonian Institution (SI). The Center connects communities across cultures—cultivating curiosity, understanding, and belonging for all people. The Center works collaboratively with local communities and cooperates closely with scholars, professional organizations, government agencies and others in the research, maintenance, and presentation of these cultures. The purpose of the position is to provide support for project management, aiding in the planning, implementation, management, and documentation of digital storytelling projects and initiatives. The incumbent works with staff within CFCH and the wider Institution under the direct supervision of the Director of Strategic Initiatives & External Affairs.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Coordination, Evaluation and Budget Administration Support
Under the direction of the Director of Strategic Initiatives & External Affairs, incumbent provides support with developing project work plans including, but not limited to, budgets, spending plans, schedules, milestone charts, goals, and/or objectives. Specifically, the incumbent performs the following functions.
  • Budget development and monitoring:Develops budgets and spending plans which includes building and maintaining budget templates. Occasionally and with supervision, creates and updates monthly budget monitors; calculates budget projections and burn rates; analyzes project activities and estimates staff level of effort. On a regular and recurring basis, communicates with contractors to determine appropriate pricing; reviewing contractor proposals to evaluate pricing against proposed activities; and calculating travel costs based on foreign per diem rates. Provides support with budget planning, data entry of financial information into budget management tools developed for digital storytelling projects, and oversight of project spending. This includes managing records of financial commitments and transactions and monitoring spending in ERP. Serves as fiscal manager for a range of project requests including training, local miscellaneous reimbursements, and/or general office supplies.
  • Project management assistance:Works closely with project managers and other CFCH staff engaged in projects, assists with developing, coordinating and updating project-related briefing materials, including, but not limited to concept notes, status reports, and briefing books. Maintains the CFCH filing system for set project documents.
  • Meeting and travel coordination: Participates in team meetings for assigned projects. Records key discussion points and decisions for distribution to team members and key staff. Conducts desk research and maintains project files and information regarding potential digital storytelling project opportunities. Supports the project teams, both in Washington, DC and in the field, in the day-today logistical coordination of project activities by organizing meetings and preparing travel authorizations and vouchers for local, national and international travel. Travels nationally and internationally to support administrative and technical aspects of assigned projects and critical activities, as necessary.
  • Internal relationships for project coordination:Establishes and builds relationships with project partners and support units within SI dealing with issues related to grants, contracting, office management, and finance. This involves coordinating with multiple project partners and units simultaneously, ensuring that all parties have the information necessary to solve complex problems. The incumbent serves as a project liaison with the Office of Sponsored Projects to assure compliance with grant guidelines and that CFCH respects the various clauses and conditions of our external grants. S/he also coordinates with Office of Contracting to prepare Statements of Work for contracts and with our internal admin team as well as with SI’s finance office.
  • Project evaluation: Works with project managers to support the development of program evaluation plans and impact evaluation tools, including identifying indicators and measures of impact. Gathers and manages evaluation data, including assistance in analysis and interpretation of data, and reporting on findings and learnings. Assists in development and upkeep of evaluation data management system. Develops and manages partners and participants Excel database.

Research and Technical Support
  • Research: Conducts research in support of digital storytelling using library and/or online resources. Assists in the identification of relevant research materials; reports and white papers published by government agencies and NGOs; and other academic works in the field of communications, digital media, anthropology, and folklore.
  • Supporting and leading trainings: Provides technical support in research-based fieldwork and inleading trainings related to assigned projects in the United States as well as in foreign countries, which may involve developing training workshops for non-English speakers. This includes managing contracts in the country where local expectations relating to schedules, performance, and payments may be quite different than in the United States.
  • Supporting capacity building: Works with SI project team and partners to support general capacity building for communications and digital storytelling efforts of national and international cultural heritage organizations.
  • Digital media content preparation: assists with collecting and updating project-related, public facing materials for publication on project web pages, including, but not limited to announcements, teaching materials, participant bios and news items. Develops communication plans and social media content to share on CFCH platforms.
Procurement
  • Provides input on product specifications and Statements of Work for contract services by contacting vendors to obtain necessary bids. Verifies the availability of funds, initiates contracts and purchase orders, and ensures that all vendors are enrolled in the System for Acquisition Management (SAM) and PeopleSoft database. Responds to vendor inquiries regarding the status of payments. Accesses PeopleSoft computer database to review payment history information, track payments through the processing cycle, and verify that all payment information is available, etc.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Experience required for this position is as follows:
1. Knowledge of standard communications and digital storytelling practices and procedures.
2. Knowledge of project management principles and techniques.
3. Knowledge of administrative procedures in an automated office environment sufficient to process forms and support project activities.
4. Knowledge of basic budget and grant administration procedures.
5. Knowledge of qualitative and/or quantitative evaluation design.
6. Ability to communicate orally to a range of audiences, including but not limited to cultural practitioners, academic institutions, and governmental and non-governmental organizations.
7. Ability to communicate in writing to a range of audiences, including but not limited to, cultural practitioners, academic institutions, and governmental and non-governmental organizations.
8. Ability to conduct research and produce written reports.
Education completed outside the United States must be deemed equivalent to higher education programs of U.S. Institutions by an organization that specializes in the interpretation of foreign educational credentials. This documentation is the responsibility of the applicant and should be included as part of your application package.
Any false statement in your application may result in rejection of your application and may also result in termination after employment begins.
Join us in "Inspiring Generations through Knowledge and Discovery."

Resumes should include a description of your paid and non-paid work experience that is related to this job; starting and ending dates of job (month and year); and average number of hours worked per week.

What To Expect Next: Once the vacancy announcement closes, a review of your resume will be compared against the qualification and experience requirements related to this job. After review of applicant resumes is complete, qualified candidates will be referred to the hiring manager.
Relocation expenses are not paid.

jobs.description:
Overview

The Staff Gen AI Scientist will apply knowledge and experience to real world problems and seek to improve health quality outcomes and reduce the cost of healthcare. With access to dedicated on premise and cloud based big data solutions, the team can work with a vast amount of structured and unstructured data including claims, membership, physician demographics, medical records and others to begin to solve some of the most pressing healthcare issues of our time. A Data Scientist at Cotiviti will be given the opportunity to work directly with a team of healthcare professionals including analysts, clinicians, coding specialists, auditors and innovators to set aggressive goals and execute on them with the team. This is for an ambitious technologist, with the flexibility and personal drive to succeed in a dynamic environment where they are judged based on their direct impact to business outcomes.

Please note: We are currently hiring multiple positions at various levels for our Artificial Intelligence teams. Please use the chart below as a general guide for the amount of experience required for each level, and apply to the req(s) that are most appropriate for your level of experience.

Responsibilities

As a Staff Gen AI Scientist within Cotiviti you will be responsible for delivering solutions that help our clients improve the quality of healthcare outcomes, reduce the cost of healthcare processes, and/or identify payment integrity issues. You will work as part of a team and will be individually responsible for the delivery of value associated with your projects. You will be expected to follow processes and practices that allow your models to be incorporated into our machine learning platform for production execution and monitoring, however, initial exploratory data analysis allows for more flexible experimentation to discover solutions to the business problems presented.

  • Work with key stakeholders within Research and Development as well as Operations, along with product management to assess the potential value and risks associated with business problems that have the potential to be solved using machine learning and Artificial Intelligence techniques.
  • Develop an exploratory data analysis approach to verify the initial hypothesis associated with potential Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning use cases.
  • Document your approach, thinking and results in standard approaches to allow other data scientists to collaborate with you on this work.
  • Prepare your final trained model and develop a validation test set for QA.
  • Work with production operations to deploy your model into production and support them in monitoring model performance.
  • Participate in other data science teams collaborating with your peers to support their projects.
  • Participate in knowledge sharing sessions to bring new insights and technologies to the team.
  • Participate in design sessions to continuously develop and improve the Cotiviti machine learning platform.
  • Provide End to End value-based solutions, including data pipeline, model creation and application for end user consumption.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science/Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research covering Advanced Statistics, Machine learning and AI.
  • Experience with the latest techniques in natural language processing including transformers, fine-tuning LLMs, measuring/benchmarking and deploying LLMs with tools such as HuggingFace, Langchain, Llama/Mistral and OpenAI, vector databases.
  • 7+ years of hands-on data science/AI experience, using typical machine learning and data science tools including pandas, scikit-learn, keras, nltk, and TensorFlow/PyTorch, GPU's.
  • Experience building production-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience working with Apache Spark™ and large-scale distributed datasets.
  • Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences is a plus.
  • Passion for collaboration, learn it all mindset and driving value with AI.

Mental Requirements:

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaborate as a team with a sense of urgency.
  • Professional with ability to properly handle confidential information.
  • Be value-driven, understand that success is based on the impact of your work rather than its complexity or the level of effort.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks, prioritize and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work within a matrixed organization.
  • Proficiency in all required skills and competencies above.
  • Communicating with others and teamwork.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Flexibility to work with global teams as well geographically dispersed US based teams.
  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.

Base compensation ranges from $171,000 to $197,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.

Date of posting: 9/1/2027

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 12/1/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionCapsLock builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry.
jobs.description:
Description

CapsLock builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

﻿Role Overview

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

Responsibilities

﻿

﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
  • Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

2. User Needs & Automation

  • Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
  • Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

3. Product Development & Delivery

  • Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
  • Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration

  • Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
  • Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

5. Experimentation & Optimization

  • Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
  • Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
  • Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.
  • Skilled in KPI design, event taxonomy, dashboarding, and turning numbers into decisions.
  • Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. (Examples will be requested).
  • Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.
  • Comfortable running multiple workstreams at once and making confident calls on what to ship first.
  • Strong track record of launching small, frequent releases rather than big-bang updates.
  • Excellent written/verbal English—creates clear specs, explicit trade-offs, and transparent status updates.
  • Experience collaborating effectively across global time zones.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok), rules engines, budget pacing, or creative testing workflows.
  • Computer Science, Computer Engineering degree, or experience managing complex SaaS products with multi-platform API integrations.
  • Hands-on experience with A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, or staged rollout systems for spend-affecting logic.

﻿Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

Job Summary:

The Digital Marketing Specialist will support the execution and optimization of digital marketing initiatives that drive lead generation and brand visibility across Sola Salons’ national and local markets. This role works across paid media, SEO, website optimization, and analytics, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and data-driven decision-making.

This position is ideal for a hands-on digital marketer who enjoys working across channels, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and wants to continue building expertise in performance marketing for a multi-location brand. This role reports to the Director of Digital Marketing and collaborates closely with internal teams and external partners.

Primary Responsibilities:

Paid Media & Campaign Management

  • Execute and optimize paid digital campaigns across channels including Google and Bing Ads, Meta, TikTok, Performance Max, and emerging platforms, in alignment with established strategies.
  • Monitor campaign performance and optimize toward lead generation and conversion goals.
  • Assist with audience targeting, campaign builds, creative testing, budget pacing, and reporting.
  • Partner with agencies and vendors to ensure campaigns align with business objectives.
  • This role is both hands-on in-platform while collaborating closely with agency partners for scale, testing, and specialized execution.
  • Improving marketing efficiency through testing and ongoing optimization.

SEO & Website Optimization

  • Execute on-page, off-page, local, and technical SEO initiatives in partnership with internal stakeholders and external agencies.
  • Partner with technical and marketing teams on website enhancements and content development.
  • Manage local business listing updates, publish Google Business Profile content, and support online reputation management efforts.
  • Monitor and analyze website performance, identifying opportunities to improve user experience, conversion rates, and overall site effectiveness.
  • Support keyword research, landing page creation, A/B testing, and ongoing optimization efforts to drive organic traffic and lead generation.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Track and analyze digital marketing performance across channels.
  • Build reports and dashboards to communicate insights and recommendations.
  • Monitor KPIs including lead volume, cost per lead, conversion rates, organic traffic growth, and engagement metrics.
  • Translate performance data into actionable insights to inform ongoing optimization and testing.
  • Support monthly budget forecasting and vendor invoice reconciliation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with franchise marketing teams, creative partners, agencies, and web development partners.
  • Support local marketing initiatives and new salon opening campaigns.
  • Stay current on digital marketing trends, platform updates, and emerging opportunities.

Experience, Skills and Abilities:

  • 3–5+ years of hands on digital marketing experience.
  • Strong understanding of paid media platforms with an emphasis on Google Ads and Meta Ads.
  • Experience with SEO and website optimization best practices.
  • Proficiency with core ad platforms, Google Analytics, Looker Studio, Google Search Console.
  • Strong creative instincts and a knack for developing, testing, and optimizing high-performing ad content.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and project management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting franchise, multi-location, or local marketing environments.
  • Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience working with agencies or external partners.
  • Understanding of lead generation funnels and conversion optimization.
  • Beauty, wellness, retail, or lifestyle brand experience.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $70,000-$80,000 annually, commensurate on experience. This role is bonus-eligible and is based on company and individual performance; all bonuses are subject to board and CEO approval.

You are a recognized subject-matter expert who reviews and elevates the work of other senior engineers and drives complex, cross-team designs to completion.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own and evolve the architecture of the self-hosted platform across multiple teams — backend services, data pipelines, control logic, and the deployment topology shipped to customers (containerized microservices on bare metal, delivered as an appliance/OVA) — and implement improvements to existing architecture.

  • Define scalability and capacity-planning strategies that hold across a wide range of customer scale and hardware, and establish frameworks for performance, observability, and operational excellence in constrained and air-gapped environments.
  • Lead the translation of SaaS/cloud-native capabilities into on-prem architecture, refine vaguely specified complex requirements into robust, future-proof end-to-end designs, and define coding patterns and standards that span multiple teams.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering, or equivalent experience, with roughly 8+ years of related experience and deep hands-on expertise in Go and/or Python across technologies such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Docker, and Linux.
  • Extensive, proven experience designing and delivering on-prem / self-hosted / customer-deployed software, including packaging and lifecycle for customer-controlled environments (appliance/OVA, bare-metal or containerized deployments, upgrades, and air-gapped or restricted networks).
  • A strong track record architecting distributed systems for high availability and fault tolerance in on-prem / customer-controlled deployments — replication, clustering, failover, consensus/leader election — and being recognized as a subject-matter expert in one or more of these areas.
  • Deep command of scalability and performance in on-prem deployments: horizontal/vertical scaling, sharding/partitioning, load balancing, capacity planning, and evaluating technology trade-offs and costs across customer-controlled hardware and environments.
  • The ability to take vaguely specified, complex requirements and create efficient, robust, future-proof end-to-end designs across teams; experience influencing a roadmap and leading multi-team designs; and excellent communication and mentoring skills. Experience with security products is a strong advantage.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. jobs.title: Chef d'équipe d’ingénierie (IAM)
jobs.excerpt: Rejoignez nesto — fièrement nommée Canadian Rocketship 2025.
jobs.description:
Rejoignez nesto — fièrement nommée Canadian Rocketship 2025. Une entreprise du classement Deloitte Fast 50 qui transforme l'industrie hypothécaire de 2,1 billions de dollars — en bâtissant l'écosystème hypothécaire de demain.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Hypercroissance : Deloitte Fast 50 — 3 années consécutives
  • Crédibilité dans la communauté techno : TechTO Canadian Rocketship 2025*
  • Leader de l'industrie : Société de prêt de l'année au CLA — 4 années consécutives
  • Aimant à talents : Meilleur employeur hypothécaire CMP 2025
  • Technologie de confiance : Nous propulsons les plus grandes institutions financières du Canada
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale fondée sur la confiance, la rapidité, une ambition audacieuse, la force du collectif et une obsession sans relâche pour nos clients.

Qui vous êtes

Des bâtisseurs. Des résolveurs de problèmes. Des esprits curieux. Des personnes qui avancent vite, adoptent l'innovation et croient que nous sommes plus forts ensemble. Si vous avez confiance en vos compétences et souhaitez créer des technologies concrètes qui façonnent toute une industrie, rejoignez-nous dès maintenant.

À propos de l’équipe

L’équipe IAM (Gestion des identités et des accès) est responsable de l’identité, de l’authentification et de l’autorisation chez nesto. Nous faisons partie de la plateforme centrale : les équipes qui développent des produits à travers nesto sont nos clients, et notre rôle est de leur fournir une base solide en matière d’identité et d’accès sur laquelle elles peuvent bâtir en toute confiance. Notre travail englobe les fournisseurs d’identité, les flux d’authentification, les modèles d’autorisation, l’application des politiques ainsi que les outils utilisés par les équipes produits pour gérer les accès de manière sécurisée. Nous établissons des normes communes et des modèles pris en charge afin que le contrôle d’accès soit cohérent, évolutif et plus facile à adopter pour les équipes d’ingénierie. Notre travail touche presque tous les produits chez nesto et comporte une réelle responsabilité en matière de sécurité et de conformité. Nous avançons rapidement, mais sans jamais brûler les étapes. Notre équipe est encore relativement récente chez nesto, ce qui signifie que notre mode de fonctionnement et la manière dont le reste de l’organisation adopte ce que nous concevons sont encore en train de se façonner. La personne qui dirigera cette équipe aura une influence directe et significative sur cette évolution.

À propos du rôle

Nous recherchons un(e) chef d'équipe d’ingénierie pour diriger l’équipe IAM et contribuer à façonner l’évolution des capacités d'identité et d'accès au sein de nesto. Vous serez responsable des membres de l’équipe, des livrables et de la santé quotidienne de l’équipe, ce qui comprend le recrutement, le coaching, la gestion de la performance et le développement de carrière. Vous resterez suffisamment proche du travail technique pour guider les décisions, identifier les risques et aider l’équipe à évaluer les compromis. Vous n’aurez pas besoin d’être l’architecte principal·e ni de rédiger du code sur une base régulière. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieur·es et les leaders techniques afin de prendre des décisions éclairées et de faire progresser la plateforme. Le travail lié à l’IAM dépasse les frontières des produits et des équipes. Vous coordonnerez les dépendances, clarifierez les responsabilités, gérerez les risques de livraison et veillerez à ce que les équipes restent alignées sur la portée, la séquenciation et les attentes. Vous travaillerez en partenariat étroit avec un·e gestionnaire de produit et un·e ingénieur·e principal·e, et vous relèverez de la gestionnaire d’ingénierie.

Vos responsabilités

  • Diriger et faire évoluer une équipe d’ingénieur·es par le recrutement, des rencontres individuelles régulières, du coaching, la gestion de la performance et le développement de carrière.
  • Créer un environnement où les attentes sont claires, la rétroaction est directe et où les ingénieur·es peuvent accomplir du travail de qualité tout en faisant progresser leur carrière.
  • Assumer la responsabilité des livrables et du rythme opérationnel de l’équipe, en veillant à ce que les priorités, la portée, les risques, les dépendances et les échéanciers restent visibles et réalistes.
  • Collaborer avec un·e gestionnaire de produit et un·e ingénieur·e principal·e pour définir la stratégie, la feuille de route et l’orientation technique de l’IAM.
  • Guider les décisions techniques concernant l’identité, l’authentification et l’autorisation, tout en vous appuyant sur l’expertise des ingénieur·es et des partenaires techniques.
  • Piloter l’adoption des capacités IAM partagées et des modèles d’intégration pris en charge auprès des équipes d’ingénierie de nesto.
  • Coordonner les efforts avec les équipes qui s’appuient sur les capacités IAM ou qui y contribuent, en clarifiant la responsabilisation et en gérant les dépendances en amont et en aval.
  • Veiller à ce que l’équipe développe des services sécurisés, fiables, observables et faciles à maintenir, répondant aux exigences de conformité de nesto.
  • Représenter l’équipe IAM lors de discussions transversales, en traduisant les compromis techniques, les risques de livraison et les décisions pour divers publics.

Profil recherché

  • Plus de 3 ans d’expérience en gestion d'équipe, incluant le coaching, la gestion de la performance, le recrutement et l’accompagnement de la croissance professionnelle.
  • Solide parcours en ingénierie logicielle et bagage technique suffisant pour guider des équipes qui conçoivent des systèmes critiques sur le plan de la sécurité.
  • Expérience dans la direction de projets complexes impliquant plusieurs équipes d’ingénierie, avec un historique éprouvé dans l’alignement des priorités, des responsabilités, des dépendances et des attentes.
  • Solides compétences en gestion de livraison (delivery leadership). Vous savez définir la portée, séquencer le travail et réduire les risques dans des projets comportant de nombreuses variables.
  • Bon jugement technique en ce qui concerne l’identité, l’authentification, l’autorisation, la sécurité et l’architecture de plateforme.
  • Expérience dans la conception ou la gestion de plateformes, de services ou de fonctionnalités partagés et utilisés par d’autres équipes d’ingénierie.
  • Capacité à communiquer clairement les décisions techniques, les risques et les compromis à des partenaires techniques et non techniques.
  • Style de direction collaboratif. Vous savez quand prendre une décision, quand en faciliter une et quand vous appuyer sur les ingénieur·es et les expert·es techniques.

Atouts

  • Expérience de travail dans le secteur des technologies financières (fintech) ou dans un autre secteur réglementé.
  • Expérience dans la conception, la mise à l'échelle ou la modernisation de fonctionnalités partagées d’identité, d’authentification ou d’autorisation.
  • Expérience dans la direction d’une équipe plateforme lors de l’adoption de solutions à travers plusieurs produits ou équipes d’ingénierie.
  • Expérience de partenariat avec des équipes de sécurité, de gestion des risques, de conformité ou d’audit.

Diversité et Inclusion

Chez nesto, nous croyons que la créativité et la collaboration sont le résultat d'une équipe diversifiée. Nous sommes engagés à favoriser une culture de la diversité, de l'équité, de l'inclusion et de l'appartenance, et nous encourageons fortement les femmes, les personnes de couleur, les membres de la communauté LGBTQIA+ et les personnes en situation de handicap à postuler. Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail inclusif et accueillant pour tous. Ce poste est ouvert à tous les candidats et candidates et peut être occupé à distance depuis n'importe où au Canada.

Data Quality

  • A flexible attitude with respect to work assignments and new learning, quickly-learning
  • Ability to manage multiple and varied tasks with enthusiasm and prioritize workload with attention to detail
  • Willingness to work in a matrix environment and to value the importance of teamwork

Knowledge and Experience:

Financial Compliance Analyst – Remote£29,500 per annum + Performance Bonus | 37 hours per week | Fully Remote ProcurePublic is a public-sector framework provider looking for a reliable, analytical and resourceful Financial Compliance Analyst to join our growing team.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Financial Compliance Analyst – Remote

£29,500 per annum + Performance Bonus | 37 hours per week | Fully Remote

ProcurePublic is a public-sector framework provider looking for a reliable, analytical and resourceful Financial Compliance Analyst to join our growing team.

The role offers a £29,500 basic salary plus a performance-related bonus based on income successfully identified and recovered.

Previous procurement or financial compliance experience is not essential. We're looking for someone who is naturally inquisitive, confident with numbers and comfortable communicating professionally with suppliers and clients.

The Role

This is an investigative role combining financial analysis, supplier engagement and compliance.

Our systems capture and organise much of the financial information for you. Your job is to understand what the data is telling us, identify where something doesn't look right and investigate it.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Reviewing financial and revenue data reported by suppliers

  • Identifying trends, anomalies and potential under-declarations

  • Comparing declarations against information from other sources

  • Investigating discrepancies and gathering supporting evidence

  • Speaking directly with suppliers to understand and resolve queries

  • Building positive, professional relationships with suppliers

  • Obtaining information through research, telephone calls and Freedom of Information (FOI) requests where appropriate

  • Following investigations through to a clear conclusion

  • Agreeing corrections and recovering income owed to ProcurePublic

  • Maintaining accurate records of investigations and outcomes


Requirements

What We're Looking For

You don't need to be an accountant or have previous compliance experience. We're more interested in finding someone who is:

  • Analytical – you notice when figures or trends don't look right

  • Resourceful – you're prepared to investigate and find the information you need

  • Numerically confident – you're comfortable working with financial information and spreadsheets

  • Articulate – you can discuss potentially sensitive financial queries professionally

  • Persistent – you're prepared to follow an issue through to resolution

  • Personable – you can build good relationships while still asking challenging questions

  • Organised and reliable – you can manage several investigations at once

  • Commercially minded – you understand the importance of identifying and recovering income

Full training on our systems, frameworks and compliance processes will be provided.


Benefits

Remote Working

This is a fully remote position, with flexibility for the right person. You'll need a suitable distraction-free working environment, reliable internet connectivity and an appropriate setting for business calls and online meetings.

The team meets once a month in the South East of England, and you will be expected to attend.

What We Offer

£29,500 basic salary + performance-related bonus based on income recovered

37 hours per week | Fully remote | Holiday entitlement | Workplace pension | Full training and support

This role would suit someone who enjoys working with numbers, spotting inconsistencies, asking questions and getting to the bottom of things.

If you're naturally curious, commercially aware and enjoy seeing an investigation through to a successful outcome, we'd be pleased to hear from you.

Diese Kanäle baust du aus, und die nächsten baust du auf

  • Newsletter
  • Die LinkedIn-Profile unserer Gründer und unseres Teams
  • Den LinkedIn-Unternehmensaccount
  • Unseren neuen Podcast (im Aufbau)
  • Unseren YouTube-Kanal
  • Unsere Website (Testimonials, Case Studies) und weitere Social-Kanäle
  • Und weitere Experimente mit neuen Kanälen

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entscheidest, auf welchen Kanälen wir wachsen: Du übersetzt Themen in einen kanalübergreifenden Plan, gibst jedem Kanal eine eigene Rolle statt überall dasselbe zu posten, und du sagst uns auch, welchen Kanal wir sein lassen sollten.
  • Du produzierst hands-on: Du schreibst stark, erstellst Bilder und schneidest Videos. Den Großteil davon erstellst du KI-gestützt, aber du bist immer der human-in-the-loop und prüfst alles selbst.
  • Du veröffentlichst und steuerst den Redaktionsplan: was wann wo erscheint.
  • Du baust dir die Produktionsstrecke selbst: Agenten, Skills und Automationen, die Recherche, Rohentwürfe, Varianten pro Kanal und Wiederverwertung übernehmen.
  • Du baust unseren LinkedIn-Unternehmensaccount aus und entwickelst die persönlichen Profile von Gründern und Team weiter – und dein eigenes natürlich.
  • Du sorgst für Markenkonsistenz und Premium-Qualität über alle Kanäle hinweg.
  • Du recycelst Inhalte und spinnst sie weiter (z. B. einzelne Content-Pieces aus unseren Studien-Daten) und holst Kunden-Testimonials & Case Studies ein – für Website und Social.
  • Du baust unsere neuen Formate mit auf: Podcast, YouTube & Co.
  • Du hältst unseren Content-Stack auf Stand: Du probierst neue Modelle und Systeme aus, wirfst raus, was nicht mehr das Beste ist, und gibst dein Wissen ins Team zurück.

Qualifikation

So arbeitest du mit KI

  • KI ist dein Haupt-Arbeitsmodus, nicht dein Hilfsmittel: Du arbeitest den Großteil deines Tages in KI-Systemen, nicht daneben.
  • Du hast deine Arbeitsumgebung selbst angebunden: Mail, Kalender, Ablage, Projekt- oder Wissenstool hängen über Konnektoren an deinem KI-System.
  • Du baust dir eigene Bausteine statt jedes Mal neu zu prompten: Projekte und Skills. Und du automatisierst Wiederkehrendes.
  • Du hast schon mal etwas gebaut, das du eigentlich nicht bauen kannst: ein kleines Tool, eine Seite, per Vibe Coding zusammengesetzt.

Kein Muss sind n8n, Make oder Programmieren. Wenn du das mitbringst, umso besser. Wenn nicht, reicht die Bereitschaft, dir Automationen selbst zusammenzubauen.

So machst du Content

  • Du hast mindestens einen Kanal selbst von null aufgebaut, ein LinkedIn-Profil, einen Newsletter, einen Podcast oder einen YouTube-Kanal, und kannst sagen, was der Hebel war.
  • Du denkst in Kanal-Logiken statt in Content-Stücken: Dasselbe Thema braucht auf LinkedIn, im Podcast und auf YouTube eine andere Form.
  • Du wählst Themen nach Relevanz und Positionierung, nicht nach Suchvolumen. Vieles, was wir spielen, ist so neu, dass noch niemand danach sucht.
  • Du arbeitest im Takt des Themas: Ein KI-Thema ist nach zwei Wochen kalt.

Und das bringst du außerdem mit

  • Du hast ein hervorragendes Gespür für Sprache und Kommunikation und schreibst exzellent auf Deutsch.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, greifst Ideen auf und spinnst sie eigenständig weiter.
  • Du bist schnell, pragmatisch und lieferst – auch ohne dass alles bis ins Detail vorgegeben ist.

Nice to have

  • Automatisierung mit n8n, Make oder Zapier, oder eigene kleine Tools.
  • Visuelles und redaktionelles Storytelling, Fotografie, Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Ein Gründer- bzw. Macher-Mindset.

Was dich erwartet

  • Volle Ownership: Du entscheidest über Kanäle, Themen und Produktion, nicht über eine Freigabekette hinweg.
  • Die Chance, snipKI von Grund auf als Content- und Medienmarke mitaufzubauen.
  • Arbeiten an der vordersten Front der KI: Budget für die Systeme, die du brauchst, und keine Freigabeschleife, um ein neues Modell auszuprobieren.
  • Ein ambitioniertes, nahbares Team, das genauso arbeitet wie du, und kurze Wege.
  • Remote-first mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten; Teilzeit (20–30 Std.) oder Vollzeit möglich.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – zeig uns am besten direkt ein paar Beispiele deiner Arbeit (Content, Profile, Videos, Bilder).

Und beschreib uns deinen KI-Setup. Ein paar Sätze, ein Screenshot oder ein kurzes Video reichen: Mit welchen KI-Systemen arbeitest du, was hast du angebunden, welche eigenen Skills, Projekte oder Automationen hast du gebaut, und was davon hat dir letzte Woche konkret Arbeit abgenommen.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

As Stripe continues to develop innovative products that serve businesses of all sizes around the world, risk will increase in complexity and scale. The User Risk Strategy org protects and advances our business, brand, and mission by building and deploying market-leading policies and practices that instill user and partner trust in Stripe while enabling business growth.

What you'll do

Under the User Risk Strategy org, you'll be part of the Ecosystem Risk Strategy Team, part of our "First Line of Defense" function within the Risk organization, driving the frameworks that dictate who Stripe does business with, on what terms, and how enforcement is executed at scale. The Ecosystem Risk Strategy Team focuses on our positioning and standards within the broader payments and risk ecosystem — including card network supportability, industry-body engagement, regulatory horizon scanning, and the overarching risk framework that governs our standards. Risk Strategists on the Ecosystem Risk Strategy Team work to make sure the User Risk Strategy team is properly calibrated to ensure we avoid (and take) the proper risks. We work with cross-functional partners to monitor and mitigate risk related to card network rules and BIN sponsor requirements. We interact with Risk Partnerships, Credit, Legal, Fraud, and other cross-functional teams to ensure our standards are properly calibrated.

We're looking for someone who is passionate about navigating ambiguity, engaging with internal and external stakeholders, enabling business growth while balancing risk, and identifying ways to improve user experience.

Responsibilities

  • Drive risk strategy for company-level strategic initiatives, including partnering with our product, legal, operations, sales, and partnerships teams to solve risk problems and ensure a positive experience for our users
  • Perform research and analysis to assess our current risk performance and develop and prioritize long-term strategic plans for future growth
  • Enable user onboarding to safely grow at scale, continuously optimizing for efficiency and effectiveness, and staying hyper-focused on a positive user experience
  • Challenge the status quo and provide multiple alternative solutions and key execution criteria
  • Represent Stripe in external engagements with our most critical partners and customers
  • Execute special projects and ad-hoc analyses as initiatives, products, risks, and opportunities are constantly evolving

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of professional experience in financial services, payments, tech, law or policy
  • Experience in a related role (risk, compliance, or product enablement)
  • Experience in developing risk strategies and solutions and working with technical (product and engineering) and operations teams to implement them
  • Ability to distill complex, ambiguous risk and policy problems into clear, concise, and reliable guidance for internal stakeholders and Stripe users
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience influencing product and engineering, sales, data science, and operations teams — with a proven ability to take complex issues and turn them into actionable next steps, hold others accountable, and meet deadlines
  • Demonstrated track record of deriving insights from complex or technical problem spaces and evangelizing actionable product recommendations
  • Familiarity with legal, credit, and fraud risk

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with data querying languages (e.g., SQL) and proficiency in quantitative analysis geared towards drawing actionable insights from complex datasets
  • Advanced degree in law, business, policy, or international relations
  • Experience in translating business requirements to technical configurations
  • Experience in a client-facing role managing relationships with large, global, and complex organizations

Overview

DecisionPoint Corporation is seeking a Mid-Level Database Administrator to support our U.S. Transportation Command (USTRANSCOM) Integrated Booking System (IBS) program. This role is responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of database systems, ensuring optimal performance, security, and availability in support of mission-critical transportation and logistics operations.The Database Administrator will manage relational database environments, including installation, configuration, patching, and upgrades, while ensuring compliance with DoD Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs). This role supports high availability and performance by developing patching schedules, maintaining system health, and resolving downtime or performance issues.In support of Agile development efforts, the Database Administrator will manage database configurations across multiple environments, assist with data migrations (including AWS RDS), and collaborate with development teams to optimize database performance. The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in SQL, database administration, and Linux-based scripting, along with the ability to support both operational and development-focused database activities.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, plan, implement, and administer relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL), including security, access controls, and documentation
  • Establish, implement, and maintain database environments supporting development, testing, and production operations for the IBS program
  • Install, configure, and upgrade database software as required
  • Develop and maintain patching schedules to ensure vulnerabilities are addressed in a timely manner
  • Evaluate and apply DoD Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) to ensure compliance
  • Establish and maintain database high availability strategies (e.g., backups, replication, snapshots)
  • Monitor and resolve database downtime and performance issues in a timely manner
  • Develop and troubleshoot RHEL Linux shell scripts to support database operations
  • Implement monitoring and notification mechanisms for database health and performance issues
  • Support release deployments, including execution of DDL/DML scripts
  • Collaborate with IBS program teams and stakeholders to support data requests and business-driven queries
  • Develop familiarity with data models, relationships, and structures across IBS applications and schemas
  • Support Agile development efforts by implementing database changes aligned with sprint timelines, ensuring quality and performance standards
  • Maintain database configuration control across multiple environments (Development, QA/Test, Government Test, Production)
  • Support migration of databases to AWS RDS (PostgreSQL or similar managed services)
  • Perform routine database administration tasks (daily, weekly, monthly), including performance monitoring, reporting, and data loads
  • Support after-hours production deployments and participate in on-call rotations to address critical issues

Qualifications

  • Active Secret Clearance
  • IAT Level II certification (CompTIA Security+ CE preferred)
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience administering relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar)
  • At least 3 years of experience designing, implementing, and deploying database systems

  • Experience supporting database operations in a Linux (RHEL) environment
  • Ability to work independently and support multiple environments in a fast-paced, mission-driven setting
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills

  • Familiarity with the Integrated Booking System (IBS) or similar freight/logistics platforms
  • Experience in Agile or hybrid Agile environments
  • Understanding of SDLC processes and system implementation lifecycle

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home health clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of our members. We are dedicated to providing care wherever our members call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke, and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Deine Mission bei uns

  • Du erstellst und pflegst technische Spezifikationen sowie Verpackungs-Stammdaten für unsere Marken ESN & More
  • Du sorgst für eine saubere und konsistente Datenpflege über verschiedene Systeme hinweg

Deine Erfahrung & Skills

  • Du bist aktuell an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert (z. B. aus einem technischen, wirtschaftlichen oder naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich) und hast Interesse an Daten und Struktur
  • Du hattest bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit Verpackungstechnik oder ein generelles Packaging-Verständnis, ist aber kein Muss
  • Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und denkst gerne in Systemen

Warum wir?

Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1.200 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken - gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community.
Wir glauben an Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und den Mut, Grenzen zu verschieben. Dabei zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig vom Standort oder Bereich.
Je nachdem, wo du bei uns einsteigst, erwarten dich unterschiedliche Benefits, unter anderem:

Über uns

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead LucentAI, an AI-native litigation operations venture in build at FutureSight.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead LucentAI, an AI-native litigation operations venture in build at FutureSight. This offers meaningful founder equity, not a salary.

LucentAI serves as an autopilot for medical-records and discovery operations in small-to-mid insurance-defence firms. Embedding in case-management systems, it retrieves and reviews records, flags key facts with confidence links, checks billing reasonableness, and chronologically triages discovery. This human-gated system excludes legal drafting, externalizing review capacity so firms can scale case volume without adding headcount.

Market validation through FutureSight’s discovery interviews confirmed strong demand:

  • Operations is the wedge; autopilot is the vision. All buyers wanted managed operations. LucentAI provides end-to-end automation, earning trust incrementally by handling routine work silently while keeping legal drafting human.
  • The pain is in the dollars, not the dashboards. One lead costs the middle phase at ~$1M/year in time and errors; a partner noted only ~$200K of a $1M medical bill was reasonable. With zero AI currently used, the ROI-driven payback case is immediate.
  • Capacity is the ceiling, and the record is the moat. Manual partner review caps case capacity and revenue. Defence records and billing patterns form a proprietary dataset that plaintiff-focused incumbents lack.

Market Context

We target underserved small-to-mid US insurance-defence firms.

The Phase-1 beachhead SAM is $150M–$600M across 1,500–3,000 firms; the full roadmap reaches a ≥$100M obtainable market (SOM ≈ $110M–$360M).

With 71% of legal AI funding flowing to plaintiff-focused companies, the defence market remains underserved, creating a need for technology purpose-built for litigation defence and risk management.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, size-tiered pricing model, and product positioning
  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with managing partners and claims/litigation-operations leads at small-to-mid insurance-defence firms, starting from the confirmed design partner, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion
  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 (records retrieval, key-fact flagging, billing-reasonableness analysis, and discovery triage) and iterate on user feedback; sequence carrier reserving and prediction as a later phase
  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company
  • Demonstrated success in B2B AI or B2B SaaS go-to-market, including consultative, relationship-driven sales and customer engagement
  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company
  • Deep domain expertise in insurance defence or claims operations, including pre-litigation records and discovery, legal billing review, and litigation case management.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Why this role is on the menu

The CX Shopper Vendor Management team at Instacart is dedicated to empowering Shoppers to deliver exceptional service. By providing co-pilot support and leveraging data-driven insights, the team enhances processes, drives innovation, and ensures a seamless experience for both Shoppers and customers. Operating within a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and working closely with a network of BPO partners, this role is what keeps high standards of quality, efficiency, and operational excellence front and center across the shopper support ecosystem.

Without this owner in place, vendor performance gaps surface too slowly and the data informing decisions loses its reliability. A year from now, this person will have tightened the feedback loop between Instacart and its BPO partners, built scorecards the broader team trusts, and brought the operational discipline that lets the team continue to innovate at scale.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • BPO vendor performance is monitored daily, with KPI variances surfaced quickly and root cause analysis driving timely corrective action across the network.
  • Scorecards, dashboards, and operational trackers are maintained and continuously improved, giving the team real-time visibility into vendor health and translating raw data into clear recommendations.
  • Onboarding, milestone tracking, and off-boarding coordination with BPO partners are handled with precision, with complex issues escalated to the right stakeholders at the right time.
  • Quality and training programs are supported through nesting coordination and QA trend reporting, bridging execution with continuous improvement across vendor partners.
  • Cross-team initiatives and Vendor Management strategy projects are advanced through stakeholder materials, process compliance reviews, and hands-on project contributions.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in business, economics, operations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 2 to 4 years of experience in project coordination, customer support operations, or BPO-related roles.

  • Experience supporting multiple executives simultaneously.
  • Exposure to operations, project coordination, or business support functions.

  • Highly dependable with excellent follow-through.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re a proactive Executive Assistant who excels at managing executive priorities, coordinating complex schedules, and keeping operations running smoothly behind the scenes, we’d love to hear from you. Summary:

Plans, designs, develops and tests software systems or applications for software enhancements and new products including cloud-based or internet-related tools. Most companies should be able to match to a specific software development engineer position. Use this position if company does not breakout software development positions such as Software Engineer (Applications) (5141-5146) or Software Engineer (Systems) (5161-5166).

Duties & Responsibilities:

As a Senior System Test Engineer, you will design and maintain system tests for our TM500 Product. The TM500 is a UE simulator for testing wireless networks covering UTRAN/LTE/NR technologies. This role is responsible for working with the software and hardware development teams, analysing new protocol features and producing test plans and test cases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Test Engineer for protocol features
  • Capture and diagnose issues in the TM500/E500 product and communicate them to the development team by providing accurate and analytic technical reports
  • Producing Test Specifications
  • Creating and scripting automated system tests
  • Provide high-level technical support to customers relating to the 3GPP defined protocol behaviour and operation of the TM500/E500 product.
  • Independently resolving problems encountered in the product
  • Working across different teams and with customers to solve problems

Your skills and qualifications will ideally include:

  • Degree or equivalent in a Telecommunications, Electronic Engineering or a Software Engineering discipline
  • Possess a good understanding of mobile telecoms for at least two technologies from NR (5G), LTE (4G),
  • Proven experience in protocol feature analysis and the creation of test plans
  • Proven experience in protocol test development
  • Analysis captured data against expected outcomes
  • Previous experience of writing test Scripting (Python) is desirable but not essential
  • The ability to produce good technical documents
  • Experience of IP based data applications (e.g., FTP, HTTP, RTSP, VoLTE, VoIP)
  • Ability to solve various issues using a variety of methods and techniques
  • Proven ability to work with very little input
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Proficient collaboration and team working skills, with the ability to develop and maintain strong productive relationships
  • Proven communication skills, both verbal and written
  • The ability to work within multiple projects simultaneously to meet deadlines, both independently and as part of a team
